"If there are flowers that follow the sun, surely there must be flowers that follow the moon."
As if possessed, a man set out to prove this notion. He sought rare seeds, planted exotic flora, and eventually sold off all his possessions—yet he never found it. Afterward, he withdrew into the forest, still tending to his plants.
One night, a fierce storm struck. Worried for his flowers and trees, he went to check on them, only to lose his footing and tumble to the bottom of a ravine. There, however, bloomed a lotus slowly turning to follow the moon. Half a lifetime of obsession had finally borne fruit beneath the moonlight.

Deep resonance always arrives as an "echo." Sound, by nature, has no form—yet neither does the wind. Still, when you watch blades of grass sway in unison across a meadow, you see the "shape of the wind." What, then, of sound? Whispered words seeping into the heart and spreading outward like ripples—that very sensation must be the "shape of sound."
Lost in that thought, a young girl yearned to one day meet someone whose heart would resonate with hers. She drew that longing into a pattern and entrusted it to an artisan.
And so, this dress came to be.

An artisan once chanced upon a kingfisher. Enchanted by the hue of its plumage, he began raising it with utmost care, always giving it finer food and shelter than he allowed himself.
Yet when someone jokingly asked if he meant to turn those jade feathers into ornaments and sell them for a high price, he suddenly began to doubt his own heart. "Is it not the kingfisher I truly love, but only its beautiful plumage?" Unable to shake this uncertainty, he one day forgot to latch the cage door, and the kingfisher flew away.
An empty void opened in his chest—yet at the same time, he noticed a quiet sense of relief.
Days later, while sweeping the room, he found two jade feathers beneath his desk, their colors as vivid as ever. From those feathers, the artisan fashioned a pair of earrings, entrusting to them a silent resonance.

There once was a collector who amassed countless masterworks, cherishing each one like his own child. One day, entering his storehouse as usual and raising a lantern to survey his treasures, he suddenly realized that even all these riches were merely entrusted to his keeping for a fleeting time.
From then on, he grew pensive, wishing to craft something with his own hands that future generations would treasure and pass down. After long deliberation, he chose the hardest, most wear-resistant stone and began carving a set of ornaments. Yet heaven granted him too little time, and he passed away before they were finished. His child, and then his grandchild, carried on his wish, polishing the stone until the set was finally complete. Unadorned though they were, the pieces became treasured family heirlooms.
This earring is one of them. Simple in form and quiet in hue like cold stone, it feels warm in the hand, carrying an unmistakable weight beneath its modest appearance. Named "Stoneheart," it commemorates an unyielding spirit and resolve untouched by the passing years.

1495519: A headpiece worn by noble ladies at tea parties and balls. Exquisite and beautiful, yet never ostentatious.
1495521: A choker of soft white ribbon and silver chains resting along the neck. Adorned with droplet crystals and tiny gems, it emits a clear glow like ripples spreading across still water.
1495523: A ring crafted by linking pebbles of varying shades. The blue-green gem set upon it speaks of an exquisite gift from the forest.
1495525: An exquisite bracelet. Jeweled blossoms bloom atop fine goldwork, crafted so masterfully they could be mistaken for real flowers.
1495527:
A lightweight cloak in crystal-clear hues, embroidered with stars, clouds, and wind.
Stand high and gaze far into the distance, and you will realize: what seemed to vanish fleetingly never truly disappeared, but continues to revolve along an unseen, endless orbit.
1495529: Brightly colored boots that bring a lighthearted spring to the wearer's step.
1495531: Earrings braided from supple twigs and layered leaf ornaments. Aside from a few emerald pebbles, they bear no ornate craftsmanship, yet naturally radiate a fresh, lively aura. Many gather materials in the forest to weave these as gifts for children, wishing them healthy growth.
1495533: A hair ornament of interlocking rings shaped like the sun and moon in gold and silver. The way the inner and outer rings intertwine and revolve evokes the unbroken succession of day and night.
1495535: A bracelet woven from assorted leaves, twigs, and natural pebbles. Though simple in appearance, countless people venture into the forest to gather materials and braid one as a gift for children, wishing they grow up healthy and strong.
1495537: A bracelet woven from deep indigo and silver-white threads, scattered with tiny star motifs. Peeking out just slightly from a maiden's sleeve, it looks as though waves of stars are hiding there, mischievously watching.
1495539:
A vibrantly colored coat that feels as if the fierce, ceaseless winds of a journey were tied directly to one's shoulders.
Its wearer likely cares little whether it suits a drawn-out battle. All that comes across is a desire for someone to catch a glimpse of that undying, burning exhilaration.
1495541:
Slightly exaggerated boots crafted for display.
What the maker wished to preserve was not victory itself, they say, but the feeling of clashing time and again, honing oneself, and finally returning in triumph...
1495543: A necklace modeled after sharply sculpted sea spray. Its outward-flaring layers capture the exact moment a cresting wave crashes violently against a cliff and curls back upward.
1495545: A simple chain necklace with a heavy pendant shaped like a mountain range, as though a single peak were suspended against the chest.
1495547: A wide bracelet crafted from cold white silver and deep indigo filigree. Its undulating edges depict fierce waves crashing against the shore in crisp, sharp lines. Worn on the arm, an unstoppable torrent seems ready to burst forth—as if the next instant would reveal waves shattering stone before your eyes.
1495549: A heavily built ring. Fine fissures are etched across its surface like mineral veins slowly spreading deep within the earth.
1495551: A slender spirit staff cast in pale gold and silver-white, crowned with a brightly gleaming crystal core. Radiating around it are light motifs like the morning sun breaking through clouds, lending it a splendid yet solemn bearing. It is said to be named for gathering the very first ray of heavenly light bursting forth at the end of a long night onto its tip.
1495553: A slender spirit staff crafted from ebony and dark gold. Writhing patterns like night vines twine up its shaft, while dark floral ornaments bloom in layers at its crown—the very image of an eerie flower opening quietly in the depths of pitch-black night. Glossy and cloaked in an uncanny stillness, its profound, ghostly beauty seems to seal within it the dark night, lingering obsession, and uncanny light that bursts in an instant.
1495555: An odachi with a blade over seven feet long. Its edge gleams white as snow, while its guard and scabbard fittings are adorned with red copper. Legend says that once drawn, its flash sears the eyes like the scorching noon sun over the wasteland. Though said to house a majestic, fierce grandeur, records of it ever being drawn are exceedingly rare.
1495557:
A heavy spirit staff. Its shaft, combining rock-hued timber and inlaid gold castings, is etched with fissures resembling fractured mountain ranges or shifting riverbeds, with an ochre crystal set into its head.
Grasping it fills you with a fierce might capable of snapping mountains and cleaving great rivers.
1495559: A rugged spirit staff fashioned from rock, inlaid here and there with sea-colored crystals said to have been harvested where tides crash morning and night. Listen closely, and the roar of the tide rings clear.
1495561: A spirit staff cast from dark gold and blue silver, with sharp lines and motifs like coursing lightning. A jagged cluster of dark purple crystals rises high at its tip, as though bolts of lightning were on the verge of bursting forth. Brimming with swift, untamed ferocity, a single swing calls down thunder from the nine heavens to cleave mountains and shatter peaks.
1495563: A slender straight sword with an exceedingly long, razor-sharp point. The instant it is drawn, a flash of light pierces the sky—a single strike truly like lightning.
1495565: A broad-bladed, thick-spined greatblade. Yet when swung, it feels weightless, singing like wind rushing through clouds. Its rising and falling resonance sounded both like a roar and a chant, earning it this name.
1495567: A pair of twin blades forged from crimson iron and dark gold, their edges faintly tinged with searing firelight. When a master wielder swings them in ceaseless alternation, the blades' trails link in light, appearing as an inextinguishable flame burning on and on.
1495569: A six-foot-six spirit staff cast from silver-white and frost-indigo iron. Fine patterns like spreading ice branches run across its surface, crowned with a snow-white crystal core. Even from afar, its chill sends shivers down the spine. Legend says it can summon snow to seal mountains and ice to freeze rivers.
1495571: A dagger steeped entirely in pitch black. Its thin, icy blade occasionally catches a dull glint along its edge, evoking silent bloodlust lurking in the dark of night. Utterly unassuming, it boasts no vain ornament over its bare edge—yet once within striking range, a quiet, lethal intent awakens to sever a foe's life.
1495573: An aged tome bound in a simple, archaic deep-brown cover. Unlike ordinary pages, leaves and small stone shards inscribed with unknown characters are tucked within, concealing ancient incantations said to awaken the power of all trees.
1495575: A greatsword with a broad blade cast in silver-white steel, etched with golden patterns like fractured trails of light. Even a seasoned warrior must wield it with both hands. When swung, the blade's markings shine like dawn breaking suddenly through a rift in the night, cutting down all dark clouds and transgressions with majestic radiance.
1495577: A mysterious old tome with a deep blue cover bound by silver-white cords. Set upright on a desk, layered ripples emerge along its spine; turn its pages, and you can hear the ebb and flow of ocean waves.
1495579: A broad greatsword with a blade as cold and unyielding as iron. Long ago, amidst a horde of ferocious beasts, a nameless hero stood alone and swung this very blade.
1495581: Long drop earrings. As the curtain of night falls, the inlaid gems reflect the fiery glow of the setting sun.
1495583: A wide band ring. Its former wearer swore an oath of loyalty unto their final breath—and all future generations know that oath was kept.
1495585: A longsword whose hilt has worn smoother than its blade, polished by its owner swinging it day after day.
