1498186: An ever-confident, mischievous girl. She rushes straight to wherever she catches the scent of treasure, claiming it with her eccentric martial arts and mechanical contraptions. There is no goal she cannot achieve—and even if there were, she would always find a way through with cunning tricks and a bit of coin.
1498189:
A kung-fu-obsessed Pammy who knows a thing or two about martial arts.
A regular at Jiyi Pavilion in Jinghua Cape. As Peipei's best friend, she is always looked after by everyone around her. Rumor has it she once lived the life of a wanderer.
1498192:
A panda Pammy who dreams of becoming a great martial hero. While training diligently every day, she is also the poster girl of Jiyi Pavilion, captivating countless diners across Jinghua Cape.
Yet Peipei seems completely unaware of just how many patrons she draws to the restaurant—or how much Primordial Yin-Yang Qi actually flows within her body...
1498195:
"The season of blooming peach blossoms has come around again...
I wonder what troubles everyone has been carrying lately?"
Hidden among the swaying petals, the young maiden gently plucks a pale pink letter.
Though still in training, as one called an "Immortal Fox," she must answer the wishes entrusted to her—
Whether the bond be deep or fleeting, she will always guide everyone's feelings toward harmony.
1498198:
A young knight as pure and innocent as a freshly bloomed white flower—bright, energetic, and ever-optimistic.
"I'm still only a squire for now, but if I keep walking this path, I'm sure I'll grow stronger!"
Wiping the dirt from her shield and brushing the dust from her shoulders, she raises her lance high—its tip gleaming with a radiance as dazzling as her golden hair.
1498201: A young woman who runs a weapon shop in a quiet corner of Reeve. She is known for her remarkable marksmanship and unique aesthetic in weapon design. However, her shop—filled with avant-garde art and resembling a gallery—is often overlooked by those who actually came looking to buy weapons.
1498204:
A daughter of a warrior clan who left her homeland alone, bearing a heavy duty. Gentle and composed, she possesses a maturity far beyond her years.
The katana she never lets leave her side has carved open every path she has walked thus far. One day, its flash may even sever the very threads of fate.
1498207:
A wood elf maiden with an ever-warm smile, as gentle as a spring breeze.
In her homeland of Roslantha, she was recognized as the finest archer of the new generation and entrusted with guarding the village as a rising star.
Even now, as she walks a new journey bearing her mission, the blessings of her homeland and kin remain beside her like a gentle breeze.
1498210:
A garden nestled deep within a valley beyond the lush green forest.
Much like its guardian, the place remains serene and beautiful through the long passing of years, seemingly untouched by change.
"The more precious something is to protect, the more worthy it is of enduring through time."
1498213: Despite her innocent, youthful, and adorable appearance, this girl exudes a dragonkin aura so potent that animals hesitate to approach and freeze in terror. Yet beneath her expressionless face, she only ever worries about one thing—what she's going to eat when she gets hungry.
1498216: A lively wolfkin girl and the darling of the village. She bounds through the mountains and valleys every day, never yielding to any hardship. Simple-minded and straightforward, she doesn't have a deceitful bone in her body. Her candid nature has earned her the affection of everyone in Charlulu Village.
1498219:
A young shaman as delicate as a budding flower.
Guided by the spirits, she listens intently to the prayers of the villagers.
What is it that this girl, growing ever stronger as she faces adversity, wishes to protect—?
1498222:
A proud winged-folk archer hailing from Windveil Crag.
Though still young and free of heavy responsibilities, she devotes herself to daily training, and her zeal for scouting and hunting rivals even the tribe's elite.
"W-What's your problem?! Even if I can't fly, I'm going to become the greatest warrior! ...You'll see!"
1498225: An earnest, gentle, and simple-hearted villager of Charlulu Village. Raised with the affection of those around him, his relentless training forged a formidable body, though his heart is still young and growing. Still, there is no need to worry. This "Raw Timber," heir to the will of the Crooked-Horn Clan, will one day become the mightiest "Shield."
1498228:
Graceful and dazzling swordsmanship, impeccable poise—the image Moren presents to the world is always flawless and radiant.
Only the twin blades that dance beside her through dawn's gloom and dusk's twilight know the hidden effort the heir of the Hakuon family pours in to uphold that image.
1498231:
A young knight serving directly under the Elven King. Not only does she ride the fierce pegasus Roire with ease, she effortlessly wields a heavy lance that few in all of Avarian can even lift. She is also deeply respected among her fellow knights.
"If she's several times stronger than us, does that mean she eats several times as much...?"
What started out as a joke has now become a well-known fact: she has a bottomless appetite.
1498234:
Ever since ascending as the 17th Hawkmaster, Falanta has been constantly lost in thought—weighed down by the heavy responsibilities of leading her tribe.
The safety of her kin, the survival of the village, the growth of the young hawks... Hiding her loneliness and anxiety, she continues to confront every challenge.
And on sleepless nights, to relieve her stress, she sits alone and silently devours mountains of red chili peppers.
1498237: A beastkin from the Rosia Empire who works as a maid at the Fleece lord's estate. No one has ever seen the shackles removed from her wrists, hinting at a dark past—though she never speaks of it herself.
1498240:
A warm, gentle, and compassionate nurse at the Carnon Sanatorium. She provides attentive, impartial care to everyone,
though when patients refuse to listen, she isn't above resorting to somewhat forceful methods.
Despite her youth, she is remarkably dependable.
1498242:
A girl whose origins are shrouded in mystery.
Though a little dense at times, she possesses an unyielding spirit and never wavers from her convictions.
Despite having lost her memories, she sets out to explore the world, hoping to uncover her past and find her purpose through adventure. Before she knows it, reliable companions have gathered around her.
1498243:
A boy whose origins are shrouded in mystery.
Though a little dense at times, he possesses an unyielding spirit and never wavers from his convictions.
Despite having lost his memories, he sets out to explore the world, hoping to uncover his past and find his purpose through adventure. Before he knows it, reliable companions have gathered around him.
1498246: One half of a traveling Pammy explorer duo. Making a living by surveying ruins, excavating ore veins, and hunting for treasure, she has a deep love for anything shiny. Despite her tiny frame, she effortlessly lifts hammers and pickaxes nearly as big as herself, handling most of the mining and dismantling for the expedition. She communicates with short phrases and gestures, judging everything by simple, bold instincts. Always acting on the very first thought that pops into her head, she frequently surprises those around her—and keeps her worrywart partner constantly on edge.
1498249:
A girl clad in an archaic robe with a mysterious talisman affixed to her forehead.
Her gloomy aura and pale skin send a chill down the spine of anyone who meets her.
In truth, however, she is usually the one startled into jumping out of her skin whenever a stranger approaches.
1498252:
The famous poster girl of the Adventurers' Guild in the city-state of Fleece—Maple!
With boundless energy, a cute "Kitty Punch," and an extraordinary memory, she delivers the liveliest, most professional service to every visitor.
She truly is like an indispensable ray of golden sunshine.
"Oh, right! If you ever have questions about Kibo Fight, just ask Maple anything♪"
1498258: After bumping into Xiaoyu in Fleece, a suddenly appearing thread of fate leads the two of you toward a cry for help.
1498259: Unlocks at Tushan Xiaoyu Bond Lv. 3
1498262: As you follow the intertwined threads of good and evil and press on with the investigation, the hidden truth gradually comes to light.
1498263: Unlocks at Tushan Xiaoyu Bond Lv. 6
1498264: Unlocks after clearing prerequisite Story Quest
1498266: Once the commotion settles for the time being, a new encounter born of fate awaits you and Xiaoyu.
1498267: Unlocks at Tushan Xiaoyu Bond Lv. 10
1498269: Following a chance afternoon encounter, you decide to tag along with Char and search for another way to fill your stomachs together.
1498273: To learn the authentic flavors of Fleece, you and Char embark on an earnest—and hectic—journey of culinary training.
1498276: While the troubles surrounding the dish and its flavor refuse to resolve, an unexpected commotion erupts, quietly derailing your plans.
1498279: You only meant to take a leisurely stroll through town together, but a peculiar booklet found along the way sparks a brand-new training regimen.
1498280: Unlocks at Minamoto Chiyo Bond Lv. 3
1498282: To break through the wall in her training, Chiyo invites you to a waterfall to temper and strengthen the mind.
1498283: Unlocks at Minamoto Chiyo Bond Lv. 6
1498285: A Yokai Merchant from Yuki Island has arrived in Fleece. The challenge Chiyo has long awaited is finally at hand.
1498286: Unlocks at Minamoto Chiyo Bond Lv. 10
1498288:
Han Youyou is always dashing off to interesting places—disguising herself as a maid to slip into the crowd so she can sneak off to the bazaar behind her family's back, or stealing out in the dead of night to hide in the bamboo grove for a secret treasure hunt.
Because of this, her aging father is constantly clutching his head in despair.
"Sigh... If only that girl put half as much passion into her studies, she would have been a great scholar long ago..."
1498290: Training Is What You Make It
1498291:
From a young age, Han Youyou was steeped in poetry, classics, etiquette, and music. Yet as she grew older, her patience wore thin, and she could no longer bring herself to faithfully follow those "teachings."
Meanwhile, without anyone ever teaching her, her knack for all kinds of mischief only grew sharper...
1498294:
Neither a sprawling manor nor strict family rules can stop the "nimble-fingered" and "freedom-loving" Han Youyou.
Slipping out of windows, scaling walls, or sprinting across rooftops is a piece of cake for her. With a swing of her grappling hook and a toss of her mechanical kite, no estate in the world can keep her locked inside!
1498297:
In Han Youyou's mind, everything in this world falls into one of two categories: things that can be moved, and things that might just transform if you tinker with them.
Whenever she pulls something out, it is almost never what it appears to be, always hiding another mechanism inside.
Take that square trick box of hers—once you press the tiny button, there is no telling whether fireworks, firecrackers, or a little wooden puppet that bites people will pop out!
1498300:
Every now and then, Han Youyou pulls out her compass and looks around. Its quivering needle points toward the location of the next treasure.
Of course, the compass only indicates a rough direction, so crossing mountains and valleys along the way—falling into pits or getting snagged in trees—is an everyday occurrence.
Even Han Youyou doesn't know what will happen once she finds every treasure the compass points to, yet that very unknown is what makes treasure hunting so thrilling and worthwhile.
1498303:
"If you wanna scare 'em, you gotta show off your strength! Raise both paws like this and pounce right in front of 'em! How's that?! Super intimidating, right?!"
Because he looks far too adorable, no guest has ever lodged a complaint over this kind of prank.
1498305:
Crisp Aipples are Pompon's absolute favorite, though he never passes up other tasty treats either. Whenever a feast is laid out before him, Pompon always stuffs his cheeks to the brim. And whatever he can't finish...
"This stuff... I'm taking it to go! Phew~"
1498307: All of Pompon's technique names sound heroic, grand, and super tough. Yet no one could have imagined that in "Dragon Playing with a Pearl," the role Pompon plays is the "pearl"!
1498309: Truth be told, Pompon has never formally studied kung fu, and his actual skill is pretty hit-or-miss. Fortunately, thanks to his adorable Pammy looks and rare flashes of quick wit, he always manages to pull through in a pinch. As Pompon puts it, "That's just how skilled I am!"
1498311: "They say if you train hard enough, even a clumsy guy can get good... Not that Pompon is clumsy or anything! More importantly, I gotta go scout out what my rival is up to!" No sooner were the words out of his mouth than Pompon stopped whacking the wooden dummy and set off on another day of sticking his nose everywhere.
1498313: Though a tiny Pammy, she harbors a grand dream of kung fu in her heart. Raised in the mountain forests since childhood, Peipei chanced upon two kung fu masters sparring one day. Captivated by their nimble footwork, she resolved to study martial arts—not only because the moves looked cool, but also because they made picking bamboo much handier.
1498315: Wandering into town without a clue and stepping into a theater, Peipei watched a dazzling wuxia play she barely understood—and fell head over heels for martial-arts dramas. Whenever a new show premieres at the theater, you can always find Peipei sitting in the audience with sparkling eyes, having spent every last coin she saved on a ticket.
1498317: Ever since being entrusted with bookkeeping and waiting tables at Jiyi Pavilion, Peipei could no longer set aside long hours for training like before, so she forged a new path—when Peipei unleashes her Sunflower Ledger-Tapping Hand, a customer's bill is settled in the blink of an eye.
1498319: Peipei makes a habit of rising early. She prepares Jiyi Pavilion for business and squeezes in time to practice the fundamentals of martial arts. To make sure she never oversleeps, she made a promise with Pachi to wake her up whenever she is still fast asleep in the morning.
1498321: Even after gaining plenty of experience at Jiyi Pavilion, Peipei still gets nervous rather easily. When her nerves go into overdrive, she switches into high alert: the stray tuft of hair on top of her head droops flat, her eyes go completely lifeless, and out of her mouth comes a razor-sharp, dead-on remark.
1498323:
After crying for nights on end over storybooks, Xiaoyu finally couldn't hold back any longer and longed to journey through the mortal world.
The elder, however, wore a puzzled look and said, "Tushan has no rule requiring you to go out and train... Oh, very well. Do as you please."
1498325: "Right after I arrived in Jinghua Province, my true identity nearly got exposed, but luckily there was a peach grove nearby where I could hide. Now that's fate, right? Then, to restore my spiritual power, I ate the sweets people had left in the peach blossom grove as offerings for good luck. Since I accepted their wishes, I obviously have to help solve their troubles, don't I? That's just how karma works."
1498327:
"Fate cannot be forced. Those meant to meet will meet, and those meant to part will part."
Xiaoyu treasures fateful ties, yet she does not obsess over granting the wish of every visitor who comes to the peach grove seeking love. For if one clings endlessly to a thread already severed, one will only miss the new ties waiting ahead.
1498329: They say fate is a wondrous and mysterious thing—yet after dashing around for three days straight without a wink of rest to reconcile quarreling couples, reunite estranged friends, and return lost love letters to their owners, even this Maiden of Matchmaking can't help gazing skyward and crying out, "Just once, I want to live a quiet life!"
1498331:
Mortal socializing is surprisingly deep. In addition to gathering fresh happenings every day so she always has a conversation starter ready, Xiaoyu has picked up a few tricks to delight everyone—like making paper origami bloom into flowers...
Who knows? Perhaps that helps hone her transformation arts, too.
1498333: To become a true knight, Lily left her hometown and embarked on a journey of trials. She still doesn't know where her journey will end. Though she carries her share of worries, her smile remains bright and cheerful, and she lends a helping hand with all her might to anyone in need.
1498335:
"Temper mind and body, stay true to your word, protect the weak, remain humble and prudent... And then, be just, courageous, and uphold honor... um..."
She still stumbles when reciting the Knight's Code from memory, yet Lily already puts it into practice in her everyday life.
1498337:
During her knightly training travels, she often has to camp out under the open sky.
Yet whenever her coin purse runs low, someone inevitably comes along to offer money, supplies, or food—under excuses like "a quest commission," "wanting to buy flowers," or "contributing to society."
1498339:
When she was little, whenever she cried, her mother would often play "Guess Where the Peppy Candy Is" with her.
Now, she has long since figured out the trick behind how she always won—and the Peppy Candies in her pocket have become a magical tool for soothing children.
1498341: Lily's Griffa, Heidi, has remained stuck in the juvenile Wingriff stage for a long time, showing little sign of growing up. Yet Lily isn't impatient at all. As she puts it, just as those around her gently nurtured her own growth, she will nurture Heidi's in turn.
1498343:
Ever since she was little, Rubina thought firearms were the greatest toys around. She was always deftly taking apart and reassembling her grandfather's old, intricately engraved gun.
Marveling at the delicate clockwork mechanics inside a firearm was one of the greatest joys of Rubina's childhood.
1498345:
Rubina once saw a traveling troupe's magic show—an art born from the fusion of magic and magitech.
Its breathtaking, moving display showed Rubina that even someone poor at magic could craft an entire world of their own, opening the door to her awakening in magitech.
1498347:
To chase her dream, the girl went to live with her grandfather, who ran a weapon shop.
After she ruined three gun barrels in a row, her grandfather grimly dug a dusty blueprint out from the back of the shop.
"No matter how artistic your ideas are, first you've got to learn to do things properly!"
1498349:
No matter how many pieces she creates, she never forgets the name of a single "art piece" she has crafted.
"And you know, important anniversaries, or things someone special said to me... I remember every single one! Oh, right! You haven't forgotten our promise to go shopping together, have you?"
1498351:
"Any weapon can bloom with its own unique beauty!"
By now, the girl has become a fairly well-known weapon artist. Yet to bring that belief to life, she deliberately simplifies the custom activation incantations she programs into her weapons.
1498353:
Theories about the girl's true identity abound.
One widely accepted guess is: "She's so flawless in every single respect that there's no way she's an ordinary person."
As for the girl herself, she doesn't seem to have ever given a straight answer on the matter.
1498355:
Her schedule is packed tight every day, just like an honor student's.
Things don't always go according to plan, however. When she tries to earn money street performing, she gets hauled off for operating without a permit the moment she starts. When she takes a commission to find a lost Kibo, the Kibo has already wandered back to the Guild on its own. That's just how it always goes.
1498357:
Chiyo is not the Minamoto family's only daughter. According to her, there are four sisters in her generation of the Minamoto clan.
Whenever the topic turns to her eldest sister, a rare look of embarrassment crosses the girl's face. Apparently, her sister used to tease her back when she was little...
1498359:
Well-versed in flower arrangement and the tea ceremony, she calms her mind and nurtures her spirit by arranging blossoms and brewing tea.
Surprisingly, Chiyo's Kibo has a taste for the tea's bitterness and joins her to sip tea while admiring the flowers.
"A Leisurely Tea Break" refers to these fleeting moments of tranquility.
1498361:
Ever since she left Yuki Island alongside Oborokage, an unimaginable burden has rested upon the girl's shoulders.
Even so, she did not show the slightest hint of wavering back then.
"I am well aware of my duty as a daughter of the Minamoto family."
1498363:
Given her past way of life, Symphoria was hardly accustomed to eating meat.
"Wait—you sear it in the fat rendered from the meat itself, and then use the meat juices as a sauce?!"
Witnessing beastkin cooking methods for the first time left Symphoria utterly shocked.
1498365:
Because Symphoria is earnest to a fault, she doesn't always realize right away when people are just joking around, and sometimes ends up genuinely worrying about the "victim."
When she realizes she's the one being teased, she shows a rare expression—a mix of embarrassment and indignation.
1498367:
She knows a great deal about the many plants of her homeland, and knows everything there is to know about the Whispertree in particular.
Its leaves are widely known for their special power to carry whispers between people far apart, whereas its flowers are largely ignored.
Yet Symphoria adores these flowers and always keeps one with her.
1498369:
Always by Symphoria's side is a fairy named Lumi.
Lumi calls herself Symphoria's guardian, yet whenever Lumi causes trouble, it's invariably Symphoria who ends up cleaning up the mess.
1498371:
Symphoria had never traveled so far from the homeland where she was born and raised.
Late at night, when all falls silent, she sometimes feels lonely and homesick.
Only after experiencing countless farewells across their long lives do elves come to understand the true meaning of a journey.
1498373: Metsa grew up in the forest from a young age. Influenced by Wood Elf ideals, she rarely interacted with the outside world. Yet having walked every corner of the woods and watched each plant grow, she believes the forest can welcome far more than most people think.
1498375:
Before leaving her homeland, Metsa was bestowed the title of "Verdant Crown." It was proof that her abilities were recognized, and a symbol of her duty to protect Evergarden.
After the investiture ceremony, she set off for an unfamiliar valley. Over the years, both her homeland and that honorable title faded into the past.
1498377: At first, Evergarden was nothing more than a barren wasteland with only a cutting of Yggdrasil growing there. Beneath the moonlight, she spent countless nights sleeping among the treetops. Then one night, a flower seed fell from the feathers of a passing migratory bird—and that sparked her resolve to build a garden on this land.
1498379: Metsa is used to living alone. Even so, the Kibo of the forest show her their affection and trust in their own ways—bringing her flowering branches and tree seeds in their mouths, letting her pet them docilely, or crossing forest streams together...
1498381: Though Evergarden has now become a garden blooming with rare flowers, Metsa still calls herself its guardian—its "Gardener." The dreams and duty she held took root alongside the plants, becoming part of this land, past and future alike.
1498383:
"The first thing a child does to satisfy their curiosity is reach out."
The first time she saw a Rubitz, she poked the ruby on its back with her fingertip and knocked it off. She tried playing with it to make up, though it didn't go very well.
1498385:
Back in Roslansa, Abby couldn't understand the eating habits of the Wood Elves living nearby. As far as Abby was concerned, eating nothing but meat was plenty.
Still, Abby is a good girl, so she obeyed their instructions and dutifully ate the special "supplements" extracted from Yggdrasil as well.
1498387:
Once Abby awakened her sense of self, she started eating "snacks" alongside her beloved meat—like crunching up a huge Jadefiber Stone like hard candy and swallowing it whole.
Maybe Abby would actually get along well with certain Kibo...
1498389: When Abby was little, her long list of offenses—"snacking on precious gemstones off the ground," "snapping tree branches in her sleep," and "bullying Kibo into playing with her"—got her flagged as a high-priority watch target.
1498391: Azdran are a subspecies of dragonkin, though not all of them can shift freely between human and dragon forms. Abby's ability to take human form is considered a form of atavism. Abby herself, however, doesn't seem particularly bothered by what makes her unique.
1498393: All the villagers say the same thing: "When she plays with the kids, she gets even more into it than they do." Terara is the universally beloved ringleader of the neighborhood kids—and she's proud of it. "That just means I'm the best at playing, right?"
1498395: The horn hanging at her hip is Terara's proudest trophy. When she first drove off an attacking Kingraga and protected the village's peace, Enkaku crafted its broken fang into a horn for her. It marked the beginning of the legend of the "Strongest Hunter."
1498397:
Ever since she was little, Terara has shared everything she eats with her dear partner Uru—and the sweets every kid loves were no exception.
The old man who looks after the village's Kibo never did figure out why Uru had a cavity.
1498399: Having raced through valleys and forests since she was little, Terara has a sturdy constitution and rarely gets sick. Still, she hates the saying "fools never catch cold"—because she is definitely, 100% NOT a fool!
1498401: Whenever Terara takes a nap, she unconsciously hugs her big fluffy tail—it's warm and comforting. Of course, when she wakes up half-asleep, she sometimes forgets she was holding it, steps right on it, and tumbles over.
1498403:
Blessed with extraordinary spiritual sensitivity from a young age, she could already recite shamanic prayers fluently while other kids her age were still babbling.
As Luruka herself puts it:
"I learned to speak first, too. And then..."
1498405: Having taught herself medicine for the sake of the villagers' health, Luruka accidentally stumbled onto all sorts of bizarre herbal brews while mixing remedies. Curious villagers often feign illness just to ask for one of her homemade concoctions—only for their curiosity to vanish along with their sense of taste the moment they drink it.
1498407:
"I want to be someone my big sister can lean on, too."
That was Luruka's wish when Terara took her in outside the village. Still, constantly fretting over her scatterbrained big sister... is that really what it takes to make her wish come true?
1498409:
Shamans believe the Sacred Drum is a microcosm of the universe, and every strike of its drumstick echoes the footsteps of all aura marching across the cosmos.
More than the drum itself, Luruka treasures the drumsticks passed down through generations and the feeling that her ancestors' spirits are right beside her.
1498411:
The days she wandered the forest with white wolves now feel like a distant memory.
The shy, sensitive girl now has plenty of dependable family of her own. Yet she never takes off that necklace filled with cherished memories.
1498413:
The bow Mity uses for hunting is one she built herself—gathering the materials on her own and modifying an ill-fitting, mismatched bow to suit her.
"Hmph, I'm a proper warrior. Of course I can handle something like this myself. I'm not going to bother a blacksmith over a mere weapon..."
1498415:
In truth, Mity's archery skills surpassed everyone else her age long ago. The only thing keeping her from hitting the target is her own nerves.
Most of the prey she brings down are close-range encounters where she draws on pure instinct before she even has time to worry about whether her shot will land.
1498417:
Mity would never admit it out loud, but deep down she genuinely wants to help others, and whenever someone thanks her, her wings start fluttering before she can stop them.
To anyone who isn't Wingfolk, though, it's impossible to read her true feelings from the movement of her wings.
1498419:
To overcome the nightmare of her past and learn to fly, Mity has been secretly training for a long time.
"Inspired" by a hymn praising the Hawk God, she once even tried taking off in the middle of a thunderstorm to ride the raging updrafts... only to be stopped and given a thorough scolding.
1498421:
When Mity learned that, strictly speaking, Wingfolk are a branch of Beastfolk, the look on her face made it seem as though the sky were falling.
"How am I supposed to accept that?! It's like being told the neighbor you've never even spoken to is suddenly your distant relative..."
1498423: After long months of training, Katal can now lift a massive shield effortlessly with both hands. Still, she refuses to stop her daily drills—because if she trains hard enough to wield a shield in each hand, she'll feel way, way safer!
1498425: The adults of Charlulu Village teach the children, "The Great Spirit is always listening," so they must never tell lies. Yet one day, Katal lied to cover up that Terara hadn't eaten her vegetables. Afterward, unable to bear the guilt, she apparently knelt before the Great Wolf statue for quite a while to confess.
1498427: Her great-grandfather slew a Kingraga, her great-grandmother fought a Spitehorn to a standstill, and her grandfather once took on five Schnellfs barehanded... Meanwhile, Katal still jumps in fright just from an Igneep suddenly dashing up to her. To grow as strong as her family, she still has a long way to go.
1498429: Katal believes the aura of her clan's ancestors dwells within their wooden carvings, so whenever something important happens, she reports it to them—though she doesn't treat every carving the same. For instance, only her grandmother's carving knows about how "that Starborn who recently came to the village has really been on my mind."
1498431: Both mind and body grow with time, and worries puff up just like cotton. Lately, Katal's biggest worry is growing a little too well—she's shooting up so fast that she no longer fits behind her greatshield, leaving her tail and horns poking out.
1498433:
"Your Highness Moren, please sign these documents."
"Leave them there."
Moren's desk is piled high with official paperwork, keeping her buried in work late into the night every day.
"A gentle breeze sets the flowers free. But if you want to move forward, you have to stir up a storm."
1498435:
"I don't need this or that. Wrap up everything else."
Whenever Moren goes shopping, she picks out what she doesn't want first, then buys the rest.
And without fail, she pulls out a gemstone so valuable the shop can't possibly make change for it.
1498437:
Moren often sees the Starborn landing in all sorts of predicaments. Usually, she doesn't step in right away, preferring to watch from the sidelines first. Her real intention is to gauge the Starborn's capabilities, though to any onlooker, it looks suspiciously like she's just enjoying the show.
"Don't mind me. Carry on."
1498439:
Moren shows no mercy toward needless extravagance. Even when it comes to magic gemstones supplying energy, she cannot stand pointless drain.
So when she noticed the door to her estate's cold storage room had been left wide open, she instinctively reached out to shut it—thankfully remembering right before it clicked closed that the Starborn was still inside...
1498441:
House Hakuon is deeply particular about teatime.
"Warm the teapot, then add the tea leaves—just shy of one spoonful per person. Use freshly boiled water and let it steep undisturbed for five minutes."
And at the very end, pour the milk first, followed by the black tea. That is Moren's way of brewing tea.
1498443:
Because of her deep affinity with nature and her gentle, refreshing demeanor, she is often mistaken for a Wood Elf.
Char herself doesn't seem to mind. "Wood Elves are wonderful, too. I really admire how agilely they dart through the forest."
1498445:
She makes a habit of carrying emergency rations at all times, and packs twice as much whenever heading into battle.
Not just for herself, but for Loiley too.
She knows very well that you can't seize victory on an empty stomach.
1498447:
Just like the momentum of her lance charge, Char's line of thinking is almost entirely straight to the point.
When solving a problem, she draws a direct line from goal to result and executes it calmly and steadily.
1498449:
Char never judges others with malice. Yet she is remarkably sensitive to malice directed from others, much like a pegasus.
Because she can also keenly sense the hostility of fierce beasts, she has saved the knightly order from dire situations many times on missions.
1498450: To the Ends of the Sky
1498451:
In her free time, she loves flying aimlessly across the skies with Loiley—so much so that she often realizes they've wandered far away from where they started.
Reaching untrodden lands and beholding sights never seen before is a longing she has quietly cherished in her heart.
1498453: Falanta is the youngest Hawk Lord in history, and many expected her leadership style to be carefree and unconventional—yet the opposite proved true. She honors Wingfolk traditions, reveres strength, and is herself the strongest warrior in the tribe.
1498455: To others in the tribe, Falanta seems somewhat aloof toward Mity, never showing the warmth one might expect toward a younger sister figure. Yet that is only because Falanta's father was strict—she isn't being cold to Mity; she simply doesn't know any other way to show care.
1498457: During molting season, the wings on Falanta's back begin shedding feathers, forcing her to spend ages every day tending to her clothes. Somehow, the black feathers always end up neatly stuck to her white boots, while her black shawl gets covered in white ones.
1498459:
Falanta once declared she had no need for hobbies. Her life leaves virtually no time outside her duties as chieftain—save for her extraordinary obsession with red chili peppers.
Whenever she needs to relieve stress, she reaches for them almost unconsciously.
1498461:
"Lady Hawk Lord's stomachache has flared up again. Even while under treatment, she went and ate a huge pile of red chili peppers. On top of that, she endured it for three days again before finally giving in to the pain and coming to me for medicine.
...O Hawk God, please watch over Lady Hawk Lord's health."
—Excerpt from a Wingfolk shaman's journal
1498463:
Under the head maid's instruction, Cathbelle's manners and work ethic have become immaculate.

However, as for her sharp tongue repeatedly striking where it hurts and sending people fleeing with their faces buried in their hands... even the head maid seems unable to correct that.
1498465:
Cathbelle's Beastfolk blood granted her immense strength, and the tragedy of her past taught her how to unleash it.
"That said, embedding a flyswatter into the wall just to swat a tiny bug... poses quite a problem in the line of duty," the head maid remarked.
1498467:
Food ought to be cherished. That's why Cathbelle cannot understand why everyone hesitates in front of her nutritious, delicious "Shrimp Gratin Ice Cream with Young Herb Sauce," prepared with all her heart.
Honestly, what terribly picky eaters.
1498469:
Hardly anyone notices how Cathbelle occasionally freezes mid-task while working, a faint flicker of pain rarely seen crossing her face—
The delicate duties of a maid demand ever greater focus on self-control. To perform her job flawlessly, Cathbelle pushes herself even harder...
1498471:
Cathbelle serves guests with utmost courtesy, yet earning her genuine trust is no easy feat.
Still, if she shields you behind her back while swinging her axe and firing off merciless sarcasm... no greater proof of trust is needed.
1498473: Anise believes sweets are a miracle cure for easing pain. To stock up on candies to comfort her patients, she often visits the Shine Candy Shop. Having become a familiar face, the shopkeeper always sends her off with extra samples of new treats—never realizing that she doesn't actually have a sweet tooth herself.
1498475:
Anise is always gentle with every single patient. Yet when faced with someone who refuses to cooperate with treatment, she shows an entirely different side of herself.
"I still have nightmares about the smile Anise wears when she's making you take your medicine..."
1498477: All the children know an all-powerful magic spell. Whenever they've done something naughty and want to say sorry, or when a scrape hurts and they want to be pampered, just calling out "Mommy!" gets big sister Anise to give them a tight hug. Still, you mustn't forget to properly apologize when you've been bad, okay?
1498479: As a young girl, Anise was entrusted with caring for a little Crodime named Kaea. She looked after this tiny resident of the sanatorium like a mother—gently bringing food to its mouth and tucking it under a blanket in the dead of night. Raised in such affection, Kaea grew into an exceedingly gentle, mild-mannered Kibo that showers love and care on everyone...
1498480: Where Does She Hide It All?
1498481: Thoughtful as ever, Anise always carries around little odds and ends "just in case." Gauze, bandages, medicine, hair ties, handkerchiefs, and even candies—practically anything can come out of her pockets. Still, how on earth does all of that fit inside her skirt?
1498483: "I'd always wanted to leave the village and see the outside world, you know, but my wish only really came true after meeting them... They've got this unstoppable momentum about them. Of course, I'm not losing to anyone either!"
1498485: "The conditions for growing Whisperleaf are so strict, yet you managed to raise it properly on your very first try... As expected of the Starborn. What kind of technique could you have used...?"
1498487: "Hehe, from a star in the boundless sky to a tiny life descending upon the earth... Have you ever pondered the meaning behind the name 'Starborn'?"
1498489: "Even I have no way of knowing where souls go after death, for the illusions the living hold of the afterlife are not the truth. Yet that person... perhaps they might be able to touch upon the truth..."
1498491: "Strong, makes yummy food, and plays with Abby. And also... always finds the best hiding spots right away when sneaking in a nap... Huh? Was I not supposed to say that?"
1498493:
To Nono, a hammer is an exploration tool first, and a weapon only as a bonus.
She always wants to swing it to unearth glittering treasures, though whenever huge boulders, mechanisms, or enemies block her path to the loot, she never hesitates to unleash a full-force strike.
1498495: "This month's earnings are just enough to cover the damages Nono caused. Yep, I guess you could say the books are balanced in a way? A-haha..." —From Titi and a heart forged remarkably strong by endless pounding.
1498497: "Is that... really a Boaraga? I've never seen a Boaraga with such a gentle look on its face, happily rolling around in the mud. Whoever's taking care of it must be... uh, a pretty simple, pure-hearted kid." —From an astonished passing nomad.
1498499:
Nono takes sleeping just as seriously as she takes exploring.
The joy of finding treasure in her dreams becomes the fuel that drives her once she wakes up—
She has never thought too deeply about why the treasure always ends up in the exact same spot she saw in her dreams.
1498501:
The memento that sparked her very first expedition sits at the bottom of a chest alongside the treasure she found back then.
Rather than hoarding her riches like a miser, Nono would much rather set out on a journey in search of new shiny things.
1498503:
Through the divine power of the Jade Bi fragment, even after living through more years than an ordinary human lifetime, Lan Xiangzi's memories have never faded—in fact, they have only grown sharper.
In the Chen Dynasty, people teasingly say, "Once it passes the throat, the heat is forgotten," yet for Lan Xiangzi, such forgetfulness is a release she can never hope to attain.
1498505:
Normally, dim, cramped places untouched by sunlight cast a gloom over people's spirits, yet Lan Xiangzi gladly tucks herself away in them.
If she ever vanishes out of nowhere and you want to know where she is hiding, just track down Umi and ask—
1498507:
Lan Xiangzi tried to steel herself before leaving the mine shafts. Even so, out here in the wider world, strangers still fill her with intense anxiety.
If you approach her too carelessly, she might freeze up completely in fright and stop breathing altogether.
1498509:
As a mystic, Lan Xiangzi is well-versed in all manner of protective charms, and whenever she grows uneasy, she papers a circle of talismans all around herself.
To ordinary folk, however, those bizarre sigils look far too eerie, which only ends up drawing the very attention she wanted to avoid...
1498511:
Having shut herself away from the world for so long, Lan Xiangzi occasionally grows nostalgic for the meals of those who walk under the sun.
Still, if she ever brings you a "porridge" simmered with lotus leaves, bamboo leaves, and colorful glutinous rice, you would do well to politely decline—unless you feel like joining her in a coffin...
1498513: Maple firmly believes that the color blue brings her good luck. Because of that, she always wears blue accessories—hairpins, ribbons, bow ties, and the like. By the same token, she even puts a matching bow tie on her Kibo partner, Velvet.
1498515: One look at Maple's plush, fluffy tail tells you she has mastered a brushing technique all her own. The Kibo around her wholeheartedly agree. Simply lining up and passing beneath Maple's comb-wielding hand guarantees an irresistibly fluffy coat—making them not only extra adorable, but heavenly to pet as well.
1498517: She may look like a lively young girl, but whenever she meets younger visitors or someone in need of looking after, her big-sister side naturally shines through. Her tone softens as she frets over little things—"Make sure you tie your shoelaces tight," or "Don't forget to drink water after training!"—and she will even straighten out a crooked collar on a young Kibo Fighter.
1498519: Maple keeps a thick notebook stamped with a cat's paw print on the cover. It is a special ledger where she records the traits, habits, and growth of every Kibo Fighter she has ever met, along with their Kibo partners. Even so, she never shows off this rumored "Ultimate Treasure of Kibo Fight" lightly, believing that keeping it private is how she honors every fighter.
1498521: Truth be told, Maple is the Grandmaster of the Fleece Kibo Fight Association, and she has an unconscious habit of sizing up the potential of everyone in front of her. Even watching someone pass by with a Kibo makes her mutter, "Their stride's in sync, though their bond could use a little work... Ah, sorry! My occupational hazard is acting up again, nya!"
1498523:
Hey, hey! Behold, I am Han Youyou~!
Hm? Where am I from?
Aw, c'mon, don't sweat the small stuff!

More importantly, if you ever catch wind of some ancient treasure, let me know right away, okay?
Even if there's some crazy trap waiting there, I'll take care of every~ single~ bit of it!
1498527: Don't underestimate me too much, okay?
1498529: Look, look! This is my latest creation!
1498531:
Hm, surprised at how good I am at haggling?
Hehe, it's not like I'm just trying to score a bargain...

Because I know mechanisms inside and out, I have to be able to judge what something is truly worth.
That's all there is to it.
1498533:
Mechanisms are a total blast to build and to solve!
Still, contraptions that are just hard without any originality are no good—they're boring.
Something like that isn't even worth the time to pick apart. Better to just blow it sky-high with a big boom!
1498535:
The Starborn, huh... You can never get bored hanging around them.
They're always getting swept up in interesting things.
I bet I'm not the only one who thinks so, right?
I mean, even folks who couldn't have cared less at first end up gathered around them before they know it!
Hehe, you don't see that happen every day!
1498537:
The situation the Starborn is facing might be more intricate than any mechanism I've ever seen... Just what is it that keeps pushing them forward?
I'm super, super curious!
1498539:
City walls stand so tall and sturdy, just looking at them gives you peace of mind, right?
Personally though, I think the Guardian Lions leaping and dashing around while patrolling the city are way cooler!
1498541:
In mechanism design,
things that serve people are called "ingenious," while things without use are called "clumsy."

Yet when you look at the beauty of nature, full of things that seem pointless at first glance, maybe true "ingenuity" looks "clumsy" on the surface...
1498543: If you promise to keep it a secret, I might just tell you a whole lot more!
1498545:
Feast your eyes on this grand spectacle!
Wheee—boom!
Ever seen fireworks this flashy?
1498546:
An intro-duck-tion?!
Don't tell me you don't know Ponpon?!
I'm the martial arts world's super rookie, future number one under heaven, Kung Fu Master Ponpon!
Ponpon's name echoes across dojos all over the world, yet... looks like you still need plenty more training!
1498547:
Good, you're here!
Keeping up with your training today?
1498550:
Ponpon's picky about food too, you know!
For example, this Gold-and-Silver Bowl is best seared until it gets a light char.
And this Fresh Caltrop Soup won't bring out its sweetness unless the water caltrops are freshly picked.

Hey, you! Pass that Hibiscus Tofu over here!
Or else... I-I can't reach it...
1498551:
Ponpon's traveled all across the Chen Dynasty to challenge kung fu masters!
I've been to lots of places, but... Jinghua Province is still the best! The food here is delicious, and there's a place to sleep...

Grr, you say you can find that anywhere?!
No way! There's nowhere better than Jiyi Pavilion!
1498552:
They look ordinary enough, but they're surprisingly alright.
I'll put 'em near the top of Ponpon's "Folks You Can Count On" rankings.
...N-Not that I'd be lost without 'em or anything!
Ponpon's a kung fu master! I don't need their help! Ha-ha-ha!
1498553:
Right now, they can't even hold a candle to Ponpon.
They've got talent, though!
If they practice their inner qi every single day and inherit two of Ponpon's moves...
No, even just one, they're bound to make a bit of a name for themselves!
1498554:
Mistflower Valley? Yeah, I've been there.
...The flowers and butterflies look real pretty, yet somehow every single one of 'em is venomous.
Plus, the folks living there are all total weirdos.

A kung fu rookie like you shouldn't go alone. Even if something happens, Ponpon won't be able to bail you out!
1498555:
I haven't been to any super far-off countries yet, but...
once I get famous at the Summit Showdown,
challengers for Ponpon are gonna show up from foreign lands too!
When that happens, I'll travel to all sorts of countries and try all kinds of food!
1498556: The legend of Ponpon has already spread across the whole world!
1498557:
Kung fu is...
Calm! Sharp! Unleash the strike!
This is Ponpon's true power!
1498558:
Ahem. I'm Lily, an apprentice knight traveling to hone my skills. I'm still short on experience, but I live by the code of chivalry!
If there's ever anything I can do, don't hesitate to ask!
I'll be happy to help!
1498559: Oh, did you come to see me? I'm so glad!
1498560:
My plans after this?
Hold on a sec, let me check my schedule!
1498561: Apprentice Knight Lily, ready to give it my all for you!
1498562:
I might be a little slow at improving my spearwork, but healing just sort of clicks for me...
I've got to cherish my strengths while sharpening my spear skills even more!
I'll swoosh-swoosh the monsters away to protect everyone, and become an awesome knight who can patch up their wounds too!
1498563:
My reason for fighting?
Ehehe, why, because lances are super cool, of course!

Huh? That's not a good enough answer?
Hmm... I just hope that as we keep traveling, we each reach our own goals in the end.
Still, you can't avoid fighting along the way, right?
1498564:
The Starborn?
Being around them feels so comfortable and reassuring!
Plus, whenever someone's in trouble, they always lend a hand... That's the kind of person they are.
I hope I can be the one to help them out someday.
1498565:
Sure, their past is shrouded in mystery, but I'm not going to pry.
Everyone has a secret or two, right?
1498566:
Fleece's "Scars of War," huh.
Nowadays there are only traces left scattered about, yet you can still feel how fierce the great war must have been...
Just imagining it makes my heart race!
1498567:
If I ever get the chance, I'd love to visit Eldenland up north too.
Yep, the very birthplace of knights!
Seeing it with your own eyes has got to teach you way more than just reading history books, right?
1498568:
Do you like stories too?
Then let me tell you a few!
1498569:
Time to take a stand...
Tempest, kneel before me!
Phew... nailed it.
1498570:
I am Minamoto Chiyo, hailing from Yugishima.
At present, I am nothing more than a wandering ronin.

Hm? You would like to know my hobbies as well?
Very well.
Let me see... I enjoy the tea ceremony and flower arrangement.
They bring calm to the mind.
1498571: Never letting my composure waver—that is my secret to victory.
1498572: A blade possesses sharpness. The same holds true for a person.
1498573: I swear to conduct myself in a manner worthy of the Minamoto name.
1498574:
I favor an orderly way of life.
What matters is not cramming every day with endless tasks, but forming a plan and seeing each step through steadily...

Even when plans go awry, so long as one responds calmly, everything can swiftly be set back on track.
And when mistakes occur, one can properly reflect upon them as well.
1498575:
As a daughter of the distinguished Minamoto clan of Yugishima, I was educated from a young age not only in the martial arts, but also in etiquette and arithmetic.

Etiquette serves to refine the spirit, while arithmetic teaches one to perceive the world with reason.
Looking back, even those days spent buried in study feel fond to me now.
1498576:
"Traveling through an unknown world without a clear purpose"—in that respect, we are alike.
...Perhaps that is why I feel a sense of kinship toward them.

Even without companions at our side, I believe we can overcome any hardship through our own strength.
May both their journey and mine proceed smoothly.
1498577:
Whenever I contemplate my next step, their face always comes to mind.
Could it be from experiencing so much together at their side? Thanks to the Starborn, there are so many new things I wish to try.

Hehe, they truly are mysterious... and remarkable.
Even to an oni like me, it is a little enviable.
1498578:
After leaving my homeland, I traveled south through Federation territory and passed through the lands ruled by the Wood Elves.
The great tree I beheld there, guarding Roslansa since ancient times... remains etched in my memory to this day.

I am sure their homeland awaits the elves' return at any hour.
...Though not every bird that takes flight can return to its original branch.
1498579: I have yet to grow accustomed to airships... There are no tatami rooms, nor any genmaicha to soothe the spirit...
1498580: If we are to join hands, we must first come to understand one another deeply.
1498581: Foul impurity... I shall purge you here! Begone!
1498582:
I am Symphoria, from Roslansa.
At the moment, I am in the midst of an important long-term mission...

Um, accompanying you is part of my mission as well.
So... please don't stray too far from me, okay?
1498585: It seems our journey still has a long way to go.
1498586:
My past?
I don't think it is all that different from any other Wood Elf's...

Eh? Did you hear something from Lumi?
She tends to exaggerate a little, so please don't take everything she says at face value.
1498587:
I have taken part in many missions at the Queen's command, yet this is my first time away from Roslansa for so long...

Ah, pardon me. At a time like this, I really ought to keep myself together...

—Eh? You don't mind?
Hehe, I'm relieved to hear that.
1498588:
Ever since word spread that the prophecy was finally coming to pass,
everyone around me could talk of nothing but the Starborn...

Truth be told, I was curious to see what sort of person you might be as well...
...Hehe. To think you would be so kind. What a relief.
1498589:
The Starborn... is a companion I can truly rely on.
Prophecies and duties aside, that is how I feel from the bottom of my heart.
1498590:
My missions have taken me to many places, yet staying in a beastkin settlement was a first for me.
Like two trees that bear no resemblance to each other,
the customs of Charlulu Village were worlds apart from those of my homeland.
Even so, the sincerity and warmth of the villagers are truly wonderful.
1498591:
There is always something new to discover in Fleece's market. It truly lives up to its reputation as a city-state of diverse cultures.

Seeing people from so many different backgrounds living together in peace would never be possible without the dedication of those who govern this land.
I wish the entire world could be like this.
1498592:
You wish to know about my past?
It is rather a long story, though...
1498593:
This is the trees'—
final warning!
Scatter to the wind!
1498594:
I am Metsa, Gardener of the Evergarden.
The title "Verdant Laurel" was bestowed upon me when I departed Roslansa, so I am rarely called by it...

Would you mind calling me Metsa instead?
Hearing my name brings back memories of days long past.
1498595: Oh my, you've come to visit.
1498596:
Gentle sunlight filtering through the leaves...
It reminds me of distant days long gone...
1498597: Whenever you grow weary from walking, come rest in my garden.
1498598:
Branches of Yggdrasil are scattered across the entire world.
I am merely one of the "Gardeners" entrusted with tending its cuttings.

Elven prosperity exists thanks to Yggdrasil's blessing. Even if I were to offer up my very life, I could never repay that debt in full...

Guarding a bough of Yggdrasil is my calling—and my highest honor.
1498599:
I have spent many long years here...
Yet I was not simply waiting idly for time to pass.
This garden stretching out before you is proof that I fulfilled my dream...

I wished to cultivate a garden brimming with life.
Here, listen closely. Though plants cannot speak with words, each one carries a wealth of feelings within.
1498600:
That child is as fresh as a newly sprouted leaf, as supple as a growing bough, and blessed with a courageous heart...
And following where that heart led, they saved this forest...

Hehe, I am certain that on the journey ahead, the forest itself will lend them its strength.
1498601:
Every time I spend a moment with that child, I realize that the "prophecy" does not tell the whole story...

Just like a growing tree, the path they walk... every trace etched alongside their growth is proof that no two lives are ever the same.

If only...
until they reach the end of that arduous road, they never forget the feelings they held on the day they set out.
1498602:
When migratory birds fly toward the Chen Dynasty, they steer clear of a stretch of land on the outskirts of Fleece.
Long ago, two great heroes are said to have waged an endless battle there...
Perhaps the shadow cast by the past is so dark that it has become forbidden ground, where every living creature hesitates to set foot.
1498603:
Long, long ago, at the edge of the forests and mountains, there stood a tall tower connecting the sky and the earth.

It's a story I heard from the elders when I was little... Though whether it was mere legend or something that truly existed, there seems to be no way to know for sure anymore...

No, it isn't the truth that bothers me.
It's just a little saddening that the past has been lost.
1498604: Can you hear the whispers of the forest?
1498605:
O wind blowing through the forest—
Paint the earth in green!
Until life blooms in full...
1498606:
Name's Abby.
Hm? My real name?
You mean that really long one?

I can't say it right now...
I can say it when I'm a dragon.
But everyone probably wouldn't understand it anyway.
1498607: If I'm hungry, I can't fly.
1498609: Abby had a dream... What was it about again?
1498610:
Abby likes snoozing up in the trees.
Where I used to live, there were lots of trees.
It was quiet and super comfy.

But one time, while I was snoozing, the branch suddenly snapped...
Did Abby do something bad?
1498611:
Abby's a dragon. Of course Papa and Mama are dragons too.
But everyone always said Abby was different from the others...
What's different about me? That Abby's claws can turn into human hands?

I think... um, they called it "pasta-vism"?
No, "atavism," that's it.
What does that mean...?
1498612:
Starborn is nice.
Gives me lots of yummy food. Plays with me.
And also... hmm... smells really good!
1498613:
You promised we'd play together,
but lately, you haven't paid any attention
to Abby at all...
Still, Abby's a good girl, so I'll come help you!
That way, we'll be together forever... and I can protect Starborn too.
1498614:
The big sisters back home love fruit. Even though meat tastes way better... I wonder why?

Hm? Abby's fine. I chewed my food properly, nom nom.

Back there... there was a super, super giant tree, big enough to live on top of... As long as we had the "food" growing from that tree, our tummies were always full.
1498615:
Big Sis Metsa's garden has lots of flowers I've never seen before. She started collecting them after coming here, and she said it took a loooong, long time.
So there are even flowers that have "disappeared" elsewhere.
Flowers that only exist in Big Sis Metsa's garden, and nowhere else.
1498616: I know. Abby will be good.
1498618:
I'm Terara!
Born in Charlulu Village, and the best hunter around!

You're one of us now,
so I've got your back, heh!
Well? Makes you feel super safe, doesn't it?
1498619: Hey there! Fancy seeing you again.
1498621: Don't worry, I'll look after you!
1498622:
The secret to staying healthy?
That's obviously "eat lots of meat and train hard"!

Every day, I do three patrol laps around the village...
help carry luggage, go hunting in the forest...
and when I get back, I eat a ton!

Oh, I know! Starting tomorrow, you're training with me too! Lack of exercise is no good for you!
1498623:
You think I act way too impulsively?
Look, if there's something you want to fix, you gotta make the first move yourself, right?
Besides, if someone takes the lead and acts, it might give the others a little courage...

Hey, what's with that look?!
Don't tell me you thought I was just some airhead who never thinks things through?!
1498624:
When I first found that one, I wondered where on earth they even came from.
Collapsed all alone in the forest... and all banged up too...
I didn't know why they came here or what kind of person they were,
but come on! There's no way I could just leave 'em lying there!
1498625:
They really are an odd one.
Even without properly knowing their own past, they still fight desperately to protect others.
I think that takes serious guts.

Meeting a Starborn like that is the exact reason I decided to head out into the wider world.
...Heh, changing isn't always a bad thing, huh!
1498626:
You know that huge, gorgeous blooming Blue Crystal you see right as you leave the village?
I'm talking about the massive one in the valley!

Animals get super lively around it, so I often take Uru out there to hunt.
Oh, and if you ever head into that crystal lake, make sure to invite me along too!
1498627:
Sure, there are folks out there with wings, but I'm not jealous of that at all!
If I just jump super high, I can see the exact same view they do!
1498628:
Wanna know more about me?
Sure thing! So, where should I start?
1498629: Anyone in my way... gets sent flying! Learned your lesson yet?!
1498630:
I'm Luruka.
I'm a member of the Wolf-kin of Charlulu Village, and I serve as the village shaman.
I still have much to learn, but I'll do my very best!

...Um, whenever you need my strength, I'll come running right away!
It's a pleasure to work with you!
1498631: If anything is troubling you, please feel free to talk to me anytime.
1498632: I will give my all to protect everyone.
1498633: No matter what, our feelings will always connect us...
1498634:
My hair color... I was born with it.
It's different from everyone else's in the village, though it doesn't really bother me.
My big sister complimented it, saying the color reminded her of a sunset.

Although... when she said that, I felt like she hesitated for a split second...
Maybe the first thing that came to her mind when she saw this pink color
was actually undercooked meat.
1498635:
Though I'm a shaman, I also treat illnesses in the village.
As for medicinal herbs... there are ones passed down in the village for generations, and others I learned from the animals of the valley...
Beyond that, I've expanded my knowledge little by little through trial and error.
Thanks to my experience and my shamanic powers,
even if I ingest a small amount of poison, it barely affects me.
1498636:
When I first met the Starborn, they were so covered in wounds it was a miracle they were even alive...
I couldn't even begin to imagine what had happened to them...

Yet what surprised me even more
was how they recovered in just three days from teetering on the brink of death.
Perhaps that sheer vitality is a mysterious power unique to the Starborn.
1498637:
With their mysterious power and wisdom, the Starborn gave us the spark we needed to clear away the doubts in our hearts.

We had been struggling with our troubles for so long...
And it was all thanks to the Starborn that we were able to overcome them.

I pray... that the future of the Starborn who saved us shines as brightly as the stars.
1498638:
The Auras that endlessly flow across this land are also a part of nature. From them, I learned the importance of courage, wisdom, humility, and reverence.

When communicating with them, your voice, your dance, your gestures, your feelings... everything becomes language.
There is no right or wrong way to commune with them.

I communicate with them through ritual chants and hand gestures, but how do you do it, Starborn?
...Oh, how about dancing along to the beat of a drum?
1498639:
I heard from the village chief that
in the far northern lands, there are three great mountain ranges, and a dragon dwells upon the highest peak of each.

Those dragons, unlike any we know,
are said to be rulers of dragonkind with power enough to shake the world.
Though at least half of that might just be a tall tale.
1498640: Your heart will surely guide you to your true self.
1498641:
O eternal Auras of the forest...
Lend me your strength!
To preserve all life!
1498642:
I'm Mity. Hey, see these wings?
That's right, I'm one of the Winged Folk.
No prey can ever escape from us.

Just so we're clear: if you insist, I'll lend you a hand. But don't expect me to play nice with you.
1498643: As if a warrior of the Winged Folk would back down so easily!
1498644: Let me show you how it's done!
1498645: My bow is the finest of its kind, you know!
1498646:
Time to start today's hunt!

...Huh? Where's the prey?
How should I know?!
We're going out to look for it because we don't know!

Honestly, an amateur like you has a mountain of things to learn.
Make sure you keep up!
1498647:
The wound on my wing?
That was just a little graze.
It's already healing up, no big deal.

...W-Well, I suppose I'll say thanks anyway. Since you bothered to worry about me and all!
...Anyway! Don't worry, I'm fine!
1498648:
Ever since they showed up...
the valley's gotten even livelier.
It wasn't all that peaceful to begin with, so everyone was super wary of them at first,
but in the end, I guess it wasn't all bad.

...Wait, something's weird here. Why is everyone talking about them nonstop lately...?
1498649:
They might not have wings, but they're pretty sharp.
Look, whenever a problem pops up, they always come up with a bunch of ways to solve it.

...I-It's not like I'm praising them or anything!
I'm just analyzing them as a subject of observation!
1498650:
The winds of the valley are one of the ways we gather information. Depending on the altitude, the winds carry different tidings.
Even on the day you appeared in the valley, I noticed the restless shift in the wind right away.
Well? The keen senses of the Winged Folk are beyond what you imagined, aren't they?
1498651:
Listen, for your own good, I'll give you one piece of advice.
Watch your step when walking through the forest.
Especially those mushrooms growing in damp spots—they can actually move!
Ugh, the way they squirm... Just thinking about it gives me the creeps.
1498652:
W-What are you staring at...?
It's not like I'm doing anything wrong!
1498653:
Take this...
Assault Thunder!
A gift from the skies.
1498654:
Inheritor of the Hakuon Sword Dance—
Some call me the "Maestro of the Blade Soul" or "Born of Wind and Thunder."
However, since you share my ideals, I'd like you to simply call me Moren.

There are people loyal to House Hakuon all across the world.
If you join hands with me, they'll lend you their aid wherever you go.
Well? Not a bad deal, right?
Though of course, I'll expect proper compensation.
Let's see... how about granting three of my requests?
1498655: Listen closely to the sound of this blade slicing through the wind.
1498656:
I'm Moren, next head of House Hakuon.
That said, I am myself, and my house is my house.
There's no need to be so formal.
1498657: If we're comrades who share the same ideals, I wouldn't mind telling you more.
1498658:
Avarian prides itself on its Four Sword Saints.
Two of them happen to be my parents.
From my father's sword I learned strength and courage; from my mother's, grace and sharpness.

However, my dual-blade style is different from both.
I will walk a path that is mine alone.
1498659:
My tone gets a bit stiff sometimes, you say?

*Sigh*. Every day, mountains of documents arrive from all across Promilia...
When you focus on checking each and every one so there are no mistakes, you naturally end up speaking like this.

More importantly, Starborn.
When are you going to start lending me a hand?
1498660:
Many High Elves get an immediate gleam in their eyes whenever they see something unusual... To be blunt, I used to think it was rather unseemly, but...
After meeting that person, I feel like I understand how everyone feels a little better.

After all, someone unbound by convention
never gets boring to watch, and naturally draws your heart in, don't they?
1498661:
Both their abilities and strategy are undeniably second to none.
If House Hakuon can secure the Starborn's aid, our strength will become even more unshakable.
That just goes to show how extraordinary the Starborn truly is.
1498662:
Along the coast of Rosrantha lies a vast Golden Coast.
There's a chilled drink you can only get there, said to be the most delicious in the world.
The traditionalists may be stubborn, yet they seem to put real effort into creative product development.
It just goes to show that no matter how much knowledge you have, you still need to broaden your horizons.
1498663:
I've heard an eerie old tale from my clan's elders about the Red Desert of Tharsis.
They say that during a fierce battle, countless lives stained that desert crimson.
Still, you can find similar stories anywhere, so it's best not to take them at face value.
1498664:
You want to know about me?
Hmm, well, fine. I don't mind telling you.
1498665:
Listen well...
to the "Magnificent Movement of Blade and Thunder"!
Until nothing remains!
1498666:
Easy now, Roirei. Calm down.
...Phew. My apologies for letting you see such an embarrassing display.

I am Char of Avarian's Pegasus Knights.
And this is my partner, Roirei.
The two of us would be delighted to lend you our strength.
1498667: I have been awaiting you, Starborn.
1498668: Is it my turn? I await your command.
1498669:
I thought it was you.
I could tell right away from Roirei's reaction.
1498670:
Many elven children admire the Pegasus Knights.
Unfortunately, however, a knight's duties are not nearly as glamorous as children imagine.
Patrols, checkpoints, mediating disputes... They all seem like trivial tasks, don't they?
Even so, I joined the order believing that if there were people I could help, it would be worth it.
1498671:
