1501788:
At the sanatorium, I sometimes look after sick Kibo as well...
That's why I want to understand them as much as I can. That way, I can give them even better care, right?

...Hehe, did you know? When Kibo don't want to take their medicine, they make the exact same face as human patients...
1501789:
When this little one first arrived at the sanatorium,
it was still so tiny and terribly thin—so fragile that a single gust of wind looked like it could knock it over.

But as I cared for it, it grew stronger bit by bit, and now it even helps me look after the patients.
Whenever I'm in trouble or need a hand, it's always the very first to rush to my side.

Hehe, I'm sure it's trying to protect me too...
1501790:
Fleece draws people from every corner of the world... It's an open city that embraces diversity. That must be why it welcomed both my mother and me.

I don't hold any grudge against my mother. It's true she left me behind at the sanatorium, but... I truly love this city.
Now, I'm actually grateful she chose Fleece for me.
1501791:
I had never left Fleece before, you know.
Long ago, the director earnestly encouraged me to try looking for my mother, too, but I didn't want to intrude on her new life...
I believed she must be somewhere far away, living just the kind of life she'd always dreamed of—and that alone was enough for me.

But now, while working at the sanatorium, I'd love to travel around and see this world together with you, Starborn.
1501792: The medicine and bandages are all ready.
1501793:
I'm Anise, a nurse dispatched from Carnon Sanatorium.
Please leave everyone's care to me—hm? I don't need to be so formal? Oh my, is that so?
1501794:
Taking care of the patients, tending to their wounds...
And making sure they take their medicine on time...
Now then, how should I get them to listen to me?
1501795: Oh my, is this a new medicine?
1501796: Hehe, my treatments have gotten even faster.
1501797: Now I can take even better care of everyone.
1501798: To think this much power can be drawn out from the soul...
1501799: Hehe, what a good little one. Let's get along.
1501800: If it's something you chose for me, there's no way I could go wrong.
1501801:
Oh my... I rarely wear anything other than my sanatorium uniform, so...
It feels a little embarrassing...
1501802: My wish to heal everyone hasn't changed a bit.
1501804:
I've barely told anyone that I like this, yet...
You really do pay close attention to me.
1501805:
Oh my, thank you.
I'll tuck it safely away in my pocket.
1501806:
Hehe, that's a relief.
In a place this comfortable, I'm sure you'll get plenty of rest, "Starborn"...
Hm... no? Wait, did you actually prepare this room for me?
1501807:
Have you ever seen the message board at the sanatorium?
When patients are discharged, they leave notes about how they felt during their stay. Reading them lets us know what was on their minds each day and what they wished for.

Things like wanting a wider variety of meals, or wanting to sunbathe after lunch... that sort of thing.

Sometimes, though, there are notes I don't quite understand.
...Like "I want Nurse Lulu to scold me" or "I want to take my medicine while Anise glares at me"...
Hehe, patients really do have all kinds of thoughts, don't they?
1501808:
Are these flowers catching your eye...? I'm planning to put them up at the sanatorium.

All the patients there had to leave their familiar daily lives behind to come receive treatment, you know. Even if they look fine on the outside, their hearts are full of anxiety—especially the little ones.

That's why I want to make the place even a tiny bit more comforting for them...
Wouldn't it be wonderful if we could care not just for their bodies, but for their hearts as well?
1501809: To build a healthy body, you need a balanced diet every day. From now on, I'm going to strictly supervise all three of your meals... No, don't give me those puppy-dog eyes, it won't work.
1501810:
Fluffy things are just wonderful.
Kibo, body pillows... if it's fluffy, I want to bring it back to my room and hug it tight...
Yes, that includes you too, Starborn.
1501811:
I like flowers. I like fluffy body pillows, too. And taking care of everyone is—eh?! Oh my, why are you standing there?

Um... well, you see...
You told me once before, didn't you, "Starborn"?
You wondered if I'm always staying close to others without ever tending to my own feelings. So I reflected on it a little and started practicing saying the things I like out loud—so I can properly express how I feel.

Who do I want to tell, and what do I want to say...?
Oh my, that's still a secret. Though someday... I hope I can tell you...
1501812:
This looks somehow just like Kaea, doesn't it?
Are you sure it's alright for me to keep it in my room?
1501813:
Hehe, happy birthday.
For today at least, do whatever you want to your heart's content and spend the day just the way you like.
I'll even let you eat licorice candy all day long.
On one condition: make sure you brush your teeth properly before bed. Understood?

May you always stay healthy and spend every day filled with excitement, Starborn.
I don't know what kind of past you have or what mission you carry... but from the bottom of my heart, I'm grateful you were born into this world.
1501814:
On my birthday, I can't help but think about my mother...
When I was little, I used to wonder why she didn't take me with her, or why she even gave birth to me...

But now, I feel like I understand.
I think I was born into this world to make someone happy—and to be happy myself, too.

When do I feel happy? Hehe... times like this, when you celebrate my birthday with me. Right now, I'm soooo happy.
1501820: Got you. Honestly... what a naughty little one.
1501821: Hmm, hmm... Everything seems normal with your body.
1501822: When I walk, the candies rattle around in my pocket.
1501823:
...It looks like the Kibo have been sneaking licorice candies out of my wrapper.
Should I give them a stern scolding?
1501824:
Rest is important for healing injuries, too.
I think it's good to have more quiet moments like this.
1501825:
Still haven't decided where you want to go?
Why don't we sit down together and think it over?
1501826:
Would you like a massage?
I just learned how to do one recently. It might hurt a little, but it should take your fatigue right away.
1501827:
I started this journey to walk beside you, after all...
I'll follow you anywhere.
1501828: Ooh, I wonder if everyone's listening and wearing their hats...
1501829:
I like... all Kibo, really.
B-But, still... I think Gayak and Gadori are my favorites, maybe?
They're so sturdy and dependable... Watching their backs as they live up to everyone's trust makes me feel so safe. Even how they sneakily nibble on everyone's jackets... is cute, right...!
I-I really like them... so I hope they never end up hating me...
1501830:
The Starlink between us and Kibo is a bond watched over by the Spirits—a connection of wholehearted, mutual trust. I admired it so much that I studied the "Starlink Guidebook" and challenged Kikugi to a duel.
But... that little one just kept sunbathing and wouldn't fight at all. I didn't know what else to do, so I sat down beside it and stared blankly up at the sky...
And while we were basking there in the warmth together, before I knew it, we'd become partners bound by a link...
Hmm...? So you can form a bond even without fighting.
1501831: Oh, y-yes! I'll... come with you.
1501832:
O Great Spirit... if... if Starborn actually chooses me, then I—
Huh...? M-My wish... came true? T-This isn't a dream?
S-Starborn...! I'll... I'll treasure this feeling... forever, okay?
1501833: I-I'll do my best! I can do it too... probably? Mmm...
1501834: Are you... giving this to me?
1501835: Curving horns... ever harder, ever sharper!
1501836: Maybe... I can feel a little more confident now?
1501838: I'll take... good care of you!
1501839: I feel so... so safe and relieved...!
1501840: An outfit like this... is, uh, embarrassing...
1501841: Even heavy weapons... I can wield them...!
1501842: Mmm... the atmosphere feels weird... I-I'm getting nervous...
1501843: Th-Th-Th-This...?! F-For me?! Th-Th-Th... Thank you!
1501844: R-Really? Is it really okay for me to have this...?
1501845:
...Can I really live here? You didn't mix me up with someone else, did you...? W-Wait, does that mean I'll be living with you, Starborn...?
Ah! I-I said something weird again... didn't I...
1501846:
Not too close to you, not too far either...
This spot is... just right. It makes me feel so at ease...
*Yawn*... I'm already getting sleepy... Would it be okay if I just... fell asleep here... *sigh*... zzz... zzz...
1501847:
I-I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!
I brought a whole bunch of food here... I-Is that okay?
Being here calms me down so much that out of habit I just... O-Of course, if you ever want some too, Starborn, please don't hold back!
This one's Lechilf, which makes you smarter if you eat it. And over there are freshly picked Youthberries... I like how bitter and tingly they are...
1501848:
Ah, Starborn! Y-You're the real Starborn, right?
I kept picturing you just now... ah, um! By "picturing," I mean I was thinking about you—like, your face suddenly popped into my head...
Wait, no, now that I think about it, it wasn't sudden at all... I think I've been thinking about you this whole time...!
Ah... did I just phrase that weirdly again...?! Wahhh... putting things into words is so hard...
1501849:
I want you to tell me more about yourself, Starborn...
Like your favorite foods, or the things you like doing...
I don't have the best memory, but once I go over something enough times to remember it, I never forget!

Um, don't laugh, okay...? Before, I couldn't even look you in the eye, but now, I just want to keep looking at you... When I look into your eyes... I feel so safe.
1501850:
I... I fell in love with someone...
I already told my grandpa and grandma up in the sky about it, and my great-grandpa and great-grandma too...
I want to tell my mom as well... I want her to know that I found someone I truly care about...

A-And also...! I have to tell you too... Um, the person I like is... well...! Ow, owie, wahh! I bit my tongue...!
1501851: Is it... really okay for me to take this...?
1501852:
Today is the day you were born... right, Starborn?
Since it's such a special day, we have to celebrate lots and lots!
I'll give you... my blessing too!

Thank you for coming to Charlulu Village.
...May you burn warmly like fire, move lightly like the wind, stay pure like water, stand steady like the earth, and grow strong like the trees and grass... There, I put all my wishes into it...
1501853:
Huh...? Y-You remembered the day I was born?
I-I'm so happy... Every new moon on this day, I make a wish beneath Tana's light.
Until now, I always prayed for everyone in Charlulu Village, but this time... I'm going to pray for you, Starborn...
Would that... b-bother you? B-But I really... want to pray... that your journey goes well...
1501861: Gasp—did something move? ...M-Maybe it's just my imagination?
1501862: Wahh... I'm so sleepy... No! I have to pull myself together!
1501863: Being alone makes me a little nervous...
1501864:
Ooh... I want to eat some Youthberries... Just one bite...
No, I can't! I have to hold back...
1501865: I wonder if the Earth Aura is secretly dozing off right about now too...
1501866: I wonder when Starborn is coming back...
1501867: I can wait as long as it takes! I'll be... totally fine!
1501868: Whenever I think about stuff like this, m-my head... Ooh~! I'm getting dizzy...
1501869:
Kibo? U-Um... to be honest... I'm not really sure.
Those lively, endlessly varied, mysterious creatures
seem like beings from a completely different world than mine...
1501870:
That little one is very, very well-behaved.
It likes teasing people, yes,
but it never tries to scare me on purpose...

Besides, if it weren't for that little one,
my coffin would have been found by overly curious adventurers
long ago...
1501872:
I-I-I'm Lan Xiangzi.
I know how to use a few talismans...
At least enough to give someone a little fright...!

Um, I-I promise I'll
d-definitely be useful to you!
So please, please, please don't
forget about me! I beg you...
1501873: Um... did you happen to see my talismans?
1501874: I would never complain about anything you give me...
1501875: My joints have become much more limber.
1501876: Life and death find harmony right here.
1501877: I will engrave it upon my heart.
1501878: Ah, w-w-wait, please don't bite meee—
1501879: With this, I can be of even greater help to you, Lord Starborn.
1501880: The measurements look like a perfect fit. Um... should I change into it now?
1501882: Eek?! U-Um... do you need something from me?
1501883:
Could someone like me truly be worthy
of receiving such a precious gift...?

N-No! I'm not doubting your kindness, Lord Starborn.
It's just that I, um... well...
Ooh, even in death, I will repay this debt!
1501884:
I-I thank you from the bottom of my heart!
I never imagined someone like me would ever receive
a gift. I will treasure it—truly, deeply treasure it.
1501885: I-I won't get in anyone's way, I promise...
1501886:
Um, you really don't need to go to so much trouble on my account...
Just digging a hole outside and burying me with my bedding would be plenty.
That's how I've always slept, after all.

Huh, that would actually cause more trouble?
I-I see. Then, I'll gladly accept your kindness...
1501887:
Thanks to all your help,
I've gradually grown more used to life in this mortal world.

My memories of the past have never faded,
and I used to feel detached from this world, as if none of it were real...
Yet now, I feel almost as though I've reclaimed the right to "breathe" again...
1501888:
Sometimes I wonder... as I am now,
am I truly alive, or am I dead...?

Yet more than that...
All the memories lingering in this body—the sorrow and joy, the life and death...
If I were to forget everything from that precious past that made me who I am,
would I cease to be myself?

I'm such a coward, aren't I... Even more than not being human,
"losing myself" is what frightens me most...
1501889:
Through all those long, lonely years, I had nearly given up.
I wanted to stop thinking, forget my reason for lingering in this world,
and cast aside this body endlessly battered and tormented
by waves of memory.

Had you arrived even a moment later,
I surely would have...

But then you appeared like a "miracle."
I'm so glad I managed to hold on...
1501890:
If someday I should fall asleep once more,
please remember that I was here.

You don't need to do anything earth-shattering
to awaken me.

I only want you to know...
In life or in death, as long as we hold each other in our hearts,
we will never truly be parted.
1501891:
Th-This is...! Are you giving this to me?
Um, when I'm alone, I like passing the time with this—

N-No, wait! If you don't mind, though,
I also know how to play it with two people...
1501892:
H-Happy birthday!
Ever since I learned when your birthday was, Lord Starborn, I've been preparing for today.

I drew this whole bundle of talismans by hand.
There should be plenty to last you until your next birthday...!
And when that day comes again...
Um... w-well, please, please accept them!
1501893:
Huh? You're celebrating... my birthday...?

N-No, I'm happy, truly. It's just that, by the customs of the living,
wouldn't it make more sense to observe the anniversary of my death rather than my birthday...?

Ah, w-w-wait, um, never mind that!
I really must reflect on my words...!
Please excuse me while I head back into my coffin first...
1501897: Was I... able to be of help?
1501898: I-I'm sorry. After all, someone like me...
1501899: Ugh, just leave me alone for a bit... Hm?
1501900: U-Um... wahh, th-there are so many people... ooh...
1501901:
Eek?! Oh, i-it was just you...
My heart nearly jumped out of my chest...
N-No, not literally, I assure you...
1501902:
Y-You haven't forgotten about me, have you?
Phew, thank goodness... Then I can feel at ease even when I'm alone.
1501903:
To think you would willingly spend time with someone like me.
You must be... quite the eccentric yourself, aren't you?
1501904:
If there is ever anything you wish to talk about, I will listen anytime...
I will guard your secrets with my life.
I'll take them all the way into my coffin with me...
1501905:
Since being by your side,
I've stopped thinking of myself as just a walking corpse.

It feels almost as though something has begun
beating deep within my chest once again...
Could this, too, be a blessing
you've brought to me?

If so... it makes me very happy.
1501906:
Staaar...booorn... Huh?!
Wh-Why are you staring at me... You scared me...
1501907:
You know, Maple grew up right alongside Kibo!
So to Maple, Kibo are precious friends—just like family...

Kibo are suuuper smart, aren't they?
Whenever you ask them to do something, they listen right away...
I bet it's because they're like that that Kibo Fight was born too!

Wait... huh~? What was Maple talking about again?!
1501908:
That little one... stayed right by my side the whole time.
Even during my hardest moments, never leaving me once.

I'm so happy we've been able to spend this much time together...
I hope we can stay together forever and eeever.
1501910: I'm Maple! Nice to meet you~!
1501911:
Ehehe~ I'm here!
Were you waiting for Maple?
1501913: Just what you were hoping for, maybe?
1501914:
Ehehe. Well? How do I look?
Did I get even cuter?
1501918: Well, well? Does it suit me? Does Maple look cute?
1501919: What is it, what is it? Show me, show me!
1501920:
You're giving this to me? Really?
Whoa, thank you! Adventurer, I love you so much!
1501921: Ehehe, a present from Adventurer! Thanks!
1501922: There are sooo many Kibos here, right?
1501923:
There are sooo many Kibos here too!
They all look so happy—I love the vibe!

Still, some of them are pretty sensitive to their surroundings,
so you've gotta take reeeal good care of them!

That way they'll grow up healthy and unleash even more amazing power!
Like... oh, right! In that Kibo Fight the other day...!
Hey, wait, wait! I was just kidding!
1501924:
Hey, hey, lately...
you've been secretly training for Kibo Fights, haven't you?

Leave it to you, Adventurer! Just don't forget that resting is important too, okay?
Every top fighter knows how to take a proper break!

And... if you ever run into trouble, come talk to me, okay?
When it comes to Kibo Fights, I'm your "senior," after all!
1501925:
Huh, something I'm hiding?
...Yeah, even I have a secret or two!

Back in the day, I didn't really like living like this.
But after going on a wild, earth-shaking adventure, the Maple you see today was born!

Wait, what kind of "grand adventure" was it? Hehe... that's a se-cret!
1501926:
Lately, I feel like I've been telling you everything, Adventurer.

Happy things, sad things,
and even stuff I've kept secret for ages...
I can tell you anything at all.

Hey... do you think you'd want to
get to know me even better, nya?
1501927:
You know, I loooove stepping into the Kibo Fight ring.
That heart-pounding tension, that unstoppable rush of excitement... it's honestly unbeatable.

I hope I get to stand in the same ring as you someday, Adventurer.
Let's keep aiming even higher together!
1501928:
With this,
I can relax even more in my room!
1501929:
...Happy Birthday♪
Huh? You've never heard this song before? Well of coooourse you haven't!
Be-cause! This is a special song I wrote
just for you, Adventurer~!
1501930:
If I keep getting older like this,
will I start acting more grown-up too?
Or maybe... I'll just get even cuter?!
...Ehehe, hey, wanna eat some cake together?
1501931: Watch closely! See what Maple's made of!
1501935:
Whoa~! I caught one!
That wasn't so hard after all, nya.
1501936:
It's okaaaay, it's okay♪
You'll definitely catch one next time!
1501937:
Hmm-hmm-hmm~♪
Ehe, well? Feeling cheered up yet, nya?
1501938: Go, go, go! Big smiles all around! Maple's cheering for you, nya!
1501939: Is there anything Maple can help with, nya~?
1501940:
Hey, let's chat for a bit!
I wanna know more and more about you, Adventurer!
1501941:
Adventuring is important!
But you've gotta take proper care of yourself too, okay?
1501942:
Am I just way too cute?!
If you stare at me like that... I'll get embarrassed...
1501943: Let's keep going to all kinds of places together, okay? Promise!
1501944: Hehe... good girl, good girl~ Ehehe, that tickles, nya~!
1501945:
They're everywhere—sooo many of them!
Cute ones, and rowdy ones too!
1501946:
Everyone says Bamboo Cats are cowards,
but Zhubao isn't like that at all.
Zhubao is super brave—way braver than me!
1501947:
Jinghua Cape is suuuper huge, and it's full of delicious food!
There are so many new dishes I've never even seen before.
One day, I really want to try rock-sugar bamboo shoots...
1501948: Yes, Peipei will do as you say.
1501950:
Huh? A customer already?!
Please wait just a moment! I'll tidy this right up...!
1501951: Do you think Peipei can get stronger?
1501952: Hup, hup! Hard work never betrays you!
1501953: I've gotten stronger! Wanna try arm wrestling?
1501954: Does this mean I'm one step closer to being a true "martial hero"?
1501955: Kibo, let's do our best together!
1501956: I'll do my best to master using this!
1501957:
New clothes, right? Ehehe...
Oh! I need to say thank you properly...
Thank you very much!
1501958: Peipei will make sure to prepare a gift in return!
1501959:
Ehehe, I'll put them all in my bag...
and take them home to keep safe.
That way, whenever you want to see them, Starborn,
I can bring them right out!
1501960: Ehehe! I have to keep every single one safe and sound!
1501961: Is this Peipei's new home? Whoaaa...
1501962:
Big Sis Dingxiang gave me this bag.
She said she made it to look just like me!
Do you think it looks like Peipei too, Starborn?
1501963:
When I first started learning martial arts, I practiced by looking at picture scrolls.
No matter what I did, though, I couldn't copy the martial heroes' moves...

While I was worrying about it, everyone told me,
"Why don't you try stopping with the picture scrolls?"
After that, I improved by leaps and bounds...
Hmm, I wonder why...?
1501964:
I collect lots and lots of heroic tales
and martial arts novels!
Some of them are kinda like ghost stories, though,
and I get the shivers after finishing them...

I-It's not like I'm scared or anything! Peipei wouldn't lose to a story...

Huh? You'll read them with me?
Uuu... You really are the most dependable person ever, Starborn!
1501965:
Some folks seem to think it's weird for a Pammy to learn martial arts.
But you're different, Starborn.
You never laugh at me or my dream.

I feel like I can talk to you about anything...
I'm so glad to have you around, Starborn!
1501966:
At checkout, there's someone who always squishes
my cheeks before leaving.
Do you think... I had something on my face?

No? Just because I'm cute? But I'm...

Huh? You want to squish my cheeks too, Starborn?
Mmph... Fine! But after you're done squishing, you have to
tweed Peipei to tanghulu, pwease!
1501967:
You're giving this to Peipei?
Whoaaa! With this, training will be so much easier!
1501968:
Birthdays are for making wishes, right?
You can make a wish to Peipei if you'd like!
If it's something I can do, I'll try my very best to make it come true!
1501969:
Birthdays are meant to be spent with everyone you care about.
Ponpon, Big Sis Dingxiang, Master... and you too, Starborn.
Still, you're really busy, so if you don't have time...

Uuu, no, even if you're busy,
I still want to spend my birthday with you, Starborn...
1501970: Peipei will give it her all!
1501975: Will you leave the next one to Peipei too?
1501976:
Zzz... zzz...
Wah! D-Did something happen?
1501977:
Um... mm... Yep, nailed it. Hyah! Haaah, phew!
Whoa there... Peipei kept her balance!
1501978:
This is for Peipei too?
I'm so happy! Oh, just a little bit is plenty, okay?
1501979:
If I don't practice my kung fu whenever I have free time,
I feel like I'm gonna forget it all...
1501980:
Would you like to go play together?
Peipei knows some really fun places!
1501981:
Tanghulu... one for Peipei too...
Gasp! I dozed off...
1501982:
Just spacing out together like this
is more than enough... ehehe...
1501983:
Nom! Nom! Mmm, one more... hyah—nom!
I ate it all up.

1502032: Delicate patterns adorn the collar, cuffs, and hem, exuding understated elegance. Every bow and every gesture while serving tea and sweets is utterly impeccable.

1502036: Here, the light of myriad stars converges.

1502065: A pickaxe forged from Windcopper Ore. Sturdy and easy to handle, it performs reliably in a variety of situations.

Slightly increases Astral Charge recovery efficiency for the entire team's Astral Skills based on the number of <color=#d2915d>Wind Marks</color> held.

1502077:

1502891:
An exploration handbook received from the Village Chief.
It supposedly records the customs and cultures of various regions, yet several bold, sweeping handwritings overlap throughout, making it terribly hard to read. Looking at the crooked script somehow fills you with a strange, carefree feeling.
1502894:
May you always have scissors on hand when opening gifts, Starborn. May the things you want never be out of stock when you shop.
May you never have to wait in line at Meimei House, and may every Aple you eat be the sweetest one.
May gathering always yield a 100% chance of bonus drops, and may a short stroll in the wild bring you nothing but Radiant Kibo.
May every breeze you meet be just the right temperature, and may every "one more try" end in good fortune.
1502896:
May you chance upon freshly made Peach Blossom Cakes as you stroll down the main street.
When you stay at an inn on a rainy night, may there be warm water waiting to wash away the weariness of your journey.
May every departure be blessed with a wonderful season.
And whenever you look back, may there always be a road home, while new paths forever stretch out before you.

1504864:
Lately, I've been stationed at the campsite near the Giant Tree Ruins to keep an eye out for anomalies, but something weird is happening.
It seems like the daily rhythm of the Kibo living in the ruins is completely messed up!
They're quiet during the day, but go completely wild at night. They seem to be letting out all their pent-up energy, and it's so noisy I can't get any sleep...
Somebody, please, just go calm those guys down!
1504868:
I found something really wonderful over at those ruins. If we manage to bring it back safely, the village chief might be able to study it!
However, there are Kibo in our way, and to bring it back safely, we need to chase off those overly curious Kibo.
I'd like to ask you for this favor. They're a handful, so bring as many companions as you can.
1504871:
The soil around the Giant Tree Ruins is fertile and ideal for plant growth. So, dreaming of a bountiful harvest, I cleared a field for medicinal herbs... but...
That beautiful dream was ruined because of the Kibo. Eating grass, breathing fire, stirring up winds, digging up the ground, making ice...
And since they're eating the medicinal herbs too, they're even more energetic than usual.
I'm not mad at all, really. I'd just be super happy if you could teach them a thorough lesson!
1504873:
The Kibo in the ruins are surprisingly holding a grudge. The other day, while they let their guard down, I did some investigating there and took away a few treasures. Now they've blocked the path so we can't go deeper inside.
But I can't give up here. So I want you to use your strength to chase them away.
1504877:
The sight of a Morphole dancing is breathtakingly beautiful. But if you get mesmerized by it, you'll become its prey.
There must be a secret to that dance that hasn't been discovered yet.
If anyone has fought one, I want you to tell me the poses and movements it showed during battle... you catch my drift, right?
1504878: Help Out While You're at It
1504880: I tried to gather some wood near the Giant Tree Ruins for smoking fish, but a Granzaros was prowling around the forest. Honestly, that thing's a bit scary, so would someone mind helping me clear it out? I'll treat you to something warm when you get back.
1504883:
You might find this hard to believe... but two Boarlargas around here were arguing over who was boss, and they had a fierce fight.
Well, once the fight ended, they both took off... leaving behind a completely wrecked battlefield...
To protect nature and for the sake of the innocent Kibo passing by—please, find them and put a stop to it!
1504886:
Word has it that an unusual Kibo has appeared deep within the Dragonman Ruins. This is the golden opportunity to gather medicinal materials, right?
I know it's a bit dangerous, but you should be able to handle it.
1504889: I just wanted to climb over the wall and play in the ruins, but I accidentally stepped right into a lizard nest! Trimandas kept chasing me the whole time, and Skyhawks were keeping watch from above! Right now, the ruins are in total chaos. Someone help me before things get out of hand!!!
1504893:
Reporting the confirmed situation. From the underground ruins entrance all the way to the main passageway, there are way too many butterfly-type Kibo. They're blocking the line of sight.
If possible, I'd like to join the subjugation party!
1504896: I went to the Giant Tree Ruins to collect charcoal, and the moment I hoisted the bag onto my shoulder, a Harcha pounced and stole my hammer! Even if I want to chase it, I can't catch up! But my master stopped me from going to look for it alone because it's too dangerous inside... Someone help!
1504899:
The wild boars probably just wanted to protect their young. But their numbers keep growing. At this rate, someone's going to get hurt.
All we need to do is scare them a little and keep them away, could you help us out?
1504901:
I'm currently working on developing a new medicine, which requires some rare materials. You can get them from the Kibo operating deep within the Dragonman Ruins.
I believe you have the power to stand against those Kibo, so I'd appreciate it if you could gather them for me instead. I'm counting on you, thanks.
1504904:
This might sound selfish, but I really want to visit the Dragonman Ruins.
I know it's dangerous over there, but I also know you're amazing. So, how about taking some companions and escorting me?
All you have to do is clear the path and take care of those dangerous Kibo.
1504908: The Kibo around the Giant Tree Ruins have been a bit rowdy lately. Reconnaissance is already done. The prey is ferocious, making it a great warm-up. If you want to show me your true skills, follow me.
1504911: The area in front of the ruins is densely overgrown with vegetation, with Senzalus and Trimandas frequently active, and Skyhawks flying overhead, which is already affecting our regular routes... The mission objective is to secure the safety of the regular routes. Don't pursue them too deep.
1504914: ...When the wing powder of that butterfly Kibo falls on mushrooms, it turns into a very pretty color. I wanted to pick some mushrooms, but there are too many Kibo and I can't get close. If you chase them away a bit, I'll secretly give you a discount next time you come by.

Someone go take care of those pests already!

1504944: I Was Just Trying to Gather Seagrass
1504945:
...I wanted to go down to the island shore to gather some seagrass that goes well with fish soup. But my path was blocked by a pack of wild boars.
If you clear them out for me, I'll give you a secret discount.
1504947: Listen up, pay close attention! The Dragonman Ruins are no place for children to wander around blindly! Misphels and Darks are prowling around in there. If we don't clear them out quickly, it'll turn into a major disaster sooner or later! Dispatch a few people to handle this immediately!
1504949:
Those wolf-type Kibo were originally docile, but they started acting up after Shadowblaze appeared.
If you're going to subjugate them, please defeat that fierce beast first. I hope you won't hurt the innocent Kibo. Thank you in advance.
1504951: The sunlight is so warm, the breeze is so pleasant, and the air is so clear, so why—why are the Kibo always making such a racket?! I just want to sleep, why won't they leave me alone? I even ran all the way out here... Anyone, please, help me. I just want to sleep soundly!
1504953:
Dangerous Kibo have appeared in the ruins! Lately, villagers found collapsed in the ruins have been reported one after another, and the cause turned out to be none other than Cheshabatt! This is way too dangerous! We cannot leave such a dangerous Kibo wandering around outside.
They must be driven back deep into the ruins where no one visits! If you accomplish this commission, I promise to give you a solid reward!
1504955:
There is an issue with the environment of the High Elf Forest.
Since the Goddess of Abundance's active range is expanding, subjugation must be carried out with caution. The goal is route restoration, not making a big commotion. Seeking capable hands. Generous rewards offered.
1504957:
This morning, when I hauled up my nets and returned to the island. When I tried to dock the boat, the entire pier was wrecked by those boars.
I hate to be a bother to everyone, but if you can take care of those Kibo, I'll treat you to some freshly caught fish today.
1504960:
Each Kibo has its preferred weather. Being in the right environment can even amplify their power.
There's something I'm particularly curious about right now: do Ragas become even stronger after a thunderstorm?
I want you to check it out right away! Of course, I've prepared a generous reward for this request!
1504962:
Each Kibo has its preferred weather. Being in the right environment can even amplify their power.
There's something I'm particularly curious about right now: do Ragas become even stronger after gusts of wind or lightning strikes?
I want you to check it out right away! Of course, I've prepared a generous reward for this request!
1504963: Little pig, don't bump into me
1504965:
Help me~! When I tried to go to the island to pick up pretty stones and seashells, little pigs suddenly rushed out and almost knocked me into the sea! All my seashells got trampled on, too!
Quickly chase those little pigs away!
1504967:
I was just playing around by poking those boars a bit with a branch. I never expected they'd still hold a grudge and gather to squat on the island.
Anyway, could you clear the path? For my... I mean, for everyone's sake.
1504969: Lately, the Boar Ragas on the island seem to be getting pretty cocky. My hands were just itching for a fight—anyone want to compete with me? Let's race to see who can knock down the most! I bet you anything, I'm definitely winning!
1504971:
A dangerous Kibo has appeared in the underground ruins! Suddenly, they attacked a passing villager!
This is just too awful; we have to teach them a lesson somehow!
I promise you, if you complete this request, I'll make sure you get a solid reward!
1504972: First, let's drive away the swarm of butterflies
1504974:
A large number of Halsys have appeared in the underground ruins, and they're starting to block the main passageways. If left unchecked, it will affect the militia's patrols. Those confident in their skills are requested to head out and exterminate them.
Postscript: Those with scale powder allergies should not accept this request.
1504976:
A dangerous Kibo has appeared in the underground ruins! A weak Kibo lured by the dangerous Kibo was about to enter the depths of the ruins together with it!
If they really enter the depths, there's nothing those little ones can do. The threat attacking them must be eliminated!
I promise you, if you complete this request, I'll make sure you get a solid reward!
1504978:
Additional report: Butterfly-type Kibo are swarming in the place where light filtering through the gaps in the ruins gathers.
Because of this, visibility is poor and passage is hindered. It is recommended to form a team and eliminate them section by section.
1504979: Ugh! I was teased by Morphole again! This time I couldn't bring back ores or hammers. I'm so mad!! Starborn must be very powerful. Please help me! That Morphole is truly hateful!
1504981: Morphole at night is far too dazzling. The target has been confirmed. Requesting backup.
1505051: Illusionary Dream Dancing in the Woods
1505062: Increases the probability of hatching individuals with higher traits.
1505064: Hatches an individual with higher traits.
1505067: Increases the probability of hatching an Aberrant individual.
1505072: Increases the probability of hatching a Radiant individual.
1505077: Increases the probability of hatching an Astral Color individual.
1505097: A Kibo that has the habit of acting in groups. With a sturdy build, it excels at masking its presence. Only those who become the 'Head of the Family' earn the qualification to command other Schnhelfs.
1505098: It has a crest that looks much like leafy greens. When startled, its crest may fall off, but it quickly grows back to normal. The crest is not just decoration; it's also an important emergency escape method, allowing it to fly through the air by spinning at high speeds.
1505099: Isgal has a sharp sense of smell and agile movements. Its body is equipped with numerous sharp icicle-like objects. Wild individuals always act in groups, helping one another and orderly obeying the alpha wolf's orders. On the other hand, domesticated individuals are deeply loyal and agile good partners, able to execute instructions calmly and swiftly.
1505100: A notable feature of Finwolf is something icicle-like growing on its back like wings. It is not picky and is suited for group activities. For example, by communicating and working together—such as blocking cold winds with proper formations and keeping warm to spend the winter—it can overcome harsh natural environments.
1505101: It loves aquatic environments, floating about and trying to blend into lakes, mountain streams, and rainwater. Although it ends up failing, it bravely continues to try over and over again.
1505102: Rainel is skilled at manipulating water. It has high affinity with all kinds of liquids, capable of manipulating and shaping water currents like its own limbs.
1505103: In a sense, Tydarest can be said to be the incarnation of the will of water. Having gained formidable power, Tydarest's gentle nature remains unchanged, preferring a kind disposition and a harmonious atmosphere.
1505104: Active and curious, it loves lively atmospheres. It might look angry, but actually it's not really that angry.
1505105: It can emit flames to control the temperature of itself and its surrounding environment, but since it's not yet used to it, the temperature changes irregularly.
1505106: In a sense, Ignest can be said to be the incarnation of the will of fire. Its flames are eternal and never-ending. Its personality becomes more fierce and relentless; once a conflict starts, you must be prepared to fight to the finish.
1505108: Weak as individuals, they are ferocious beasts whose sheer numbers make up for it. Acting in packs without intelligence, they move as if wearing down the enemy's stamina is their very reason for existence. It seems almost no one has ever seriously considered why such weak enemies are exterminated countless times yet never go extinct.
1505109: Tsumo yearns to know the world around it and go on adventures, with the light of curiosity sparkling in its eyes. It has a congenital high affinity with plants; by touching plants, it can grasp their growth status and interact while determining what they need and their condition.
1505110: Versatile and graceful, Trilyf has a pale yellow flower on its head and always holds a vine harp in its hands. Its personality is cheerful and friendly, playing beautiful harp melodies and loving interaction with surrounding living creatures. On good weather days, taking a walk in the forest while playing pleasant tunes is its favorite pastime.
1505111: Tsurunefi has a relatively calm personality. It likes to play music while taking walks, though usually it just wanders around places it likes. Playing tunes while borrowing the power of the wind, it carries pollen falling from the fluff attached to its branches. You can tell immediately because its favorite plants grow right after Tsurunefi passes by.
1505112: Airo's tail is encased in a hard orb. Generally walking on two legs, its personality is docile. However, the hammer on its tail becomes an important weapon later on when fighting its own kind, and its destructive power even at this stage cannot be underestimated.
1505113: Trimanda's body is equipped with hard, triangular-pyramid-like fists. Its appearance is very intimidating, possessing extraordinary combat prowess, and its hard outer shell serves for both offense and defense. If made an enemy it's troublesome, but if made an ally it's extremely reliable.
1505114: True to its intimidating appearance, Giganshaura combines extremely powerful ATK and DEF, and instinctively loves combat. For them, fighting is both a means to resolve conflicts and a form of communication and play.
1505115: Belongs to the ancient Kibo 'Pterosaur'. Wise and sharp-witted. It prefers dry places and tries to drive out Water Elemental Kibo that enter its territory.
1505117: A Schnhelf that suffered irreversible erosion and became a ferocious beast. A fraction of its instincts remains, and it sometimes moves according to its past behavioral patterns. However, the nature of its life has completely changed, and it can no longer be treated as a normal living creature.
1505118: A cute little lamb with a small flame lit on its tail. Flame's wool is a precious and practical textile material. Adding just a little bit of Flame's wool dramatically improves the heat retention of clothing and blankets.
1505119: A sturdy Kibo with hard horns and hooves. It can run effortlessly across steep mountain ranges as if they were flat ground. With a domesticated Ignip by your side, you'll be able to challenge even tough enemies.
1505120: Characterized by bravely curved giant horns and dense fur covering its body. The fierce flames raging across its body are the manifestation of Fire Elemental Astral Pulse energy. With training, its output can be adjusted so it no longer causes massive damage.
1505121: Halwu loves sleeping and spends most of the day asleep. It has pure curiosity about everything in the forest and is usually very quiet and docile. However, if disturbed while sleeping, it gets extremely in a bad mood and reveals its aggressiveness.
1505122: Halsy is the grown form of Halwu, and its wisdom and understanding of its surroundings are richer than when it was a Halwu. Territorial awareness necessary for survival has also sprouted, and it even launches minor attacks. There's no major danger, but it plays pranks to drive away anyone who enters its territory without permission.
1505123: It is thought to be a fairy living alongside the forest. Because it communicates while dancing in circles, unusual anecdotes such as 'Fairy Dance' are even whispered about it. Such misunderstandings stem from Halcyon's intense vigilance and territorial awareness toward outsiders. If you carelessly step into its nest, you might be counterattacked with special magic that only Halcyon can use.
1505124: Roccolo's body surface is very hard. Its head carapace is shield-shaped, and spikes protrude from all over its body. Nocturnal, when attacked it curls up on the spot to defend, leaving opponents unable to do anything. When driven into a corner, Roccolo body-slams enemies with its hard body.
1505125:
Senzaro's horns and carapace are tougher, allowing it to withstand not only basic physical attacks, but also some magic attacks. This enables it to survive in various harsh climates.
True to its name, Senzaro's sharp horns and hard claws easily pierce through enemy defenses.
1505126: Granzaros excels at treasure hunting, capable of unearthing precious metals and rare gems from deep underground. Taming one and building a friendship may lead to unexpected wealth. However, sometimes the treasure it seeks is merely a piece of junk that caught its eye.
1505127:
A fantastic and graceful dragon species with a very close relationship with Wood Elves.
Due to their draconic lineage, not only Kibo, but even some intelligent races instinctively feel a sense of awe when facing Azdran.
1505128: A Kibo that looks just like leafy greens. It prefers spending time underground and has a calm disposition. When angered, it may bump into people, but it has zero lethality. The vegetable part of Cabbecco cannot be separated from its main body. Forcing it off reportedly causes it to never wake up again.
1505129: Chonoko has an adorable appearance and is not aggressive. However, just because you spot a cute Chonoko doesn't mean you should act rashly. Nearby, a large army of Boaraga might be watching over Chonoko's safety.
1505131: An individual that was the pack leader before being corrupted. Even after becoming a fierce beast, it continues to lead the Mistelf in a frantic hunt. Deigalm often uses a single Mistelf as a vanguard for reconnaissance and as bait to lure enemies, hiding in the shadows and waiting for the moment to launch a surprise attack.
1505132: Mofunga is always full of energy. It loves playing tag, but young Mofunga cannot control their speed and often slip and fall on the ice. While they can adapt to frigid icy environments, they dislike strong sunlight and will suffer from heatstroke if left in high temperatures for too long.
1505133: Hokul's feathers are very fluffy, and its split tail and crest in particular can sensitively perceive changes in airflow. When flapping its wings to take off, it can use these 'gatherers' to catch the wind direction and maintain balance.
1505134: No matter how poor the weather, Skyhawk loves flying straight through intense airflow changes. When sleeping, it takes only brief rests among the clouds.
1505135: Pyong-lu's body is flat and smooth, with a thin, short tail. Its young wings are not yet fully developed, and its most important missions are practicing flight and learning techniques to maintain balance in the air. Being still young, it tires easily after flying for a while and rests huddled on the ground.
1505136: Flyley's wings are long, and the tip of its tail holds water elemental crystals that store toxins. Although it looks like it is smiling, you must not underestimate its poison.
1505137: A Kibo that can not only glide for long periods with widely spread, tough wings, but also freely scatter venom to attack enemies. When excited, it unconsciously scatters poison, but victims only suffer paralysis or fainting with no danger to their lives.
1505138: A large herbivorous Kibo inhabiting various locations. It moves slowly, dislikes conflict, and gets along well with other Kibo. So peaceful that to most, it is merely part of the scenery.
1505139:
A bizarre Kibo that resembles a mantis in appearance, but whose structure is more akin to clockwork.
Little is known about this Kibo, and it was once even thought to be an ancient relic of the Dragonian civilization. However, subsequent research revealed that it merely replaces the structures used by other Kibo for mimicry with inorganic metal. The specific reasons behind this unique evolution remain shrouded in mystery.
1505140:
Electricutter's entire body is covered in sturdy, cold exoskeleton armor. Its front limbs have further evolved into a chainsaw structure capable of manipulating plasma, conveying an immediate sense of oppression.
"When Electricutter captures a bio-cicada, does it realize that a mechanical yellow sparrow is targeting it from behind?" someone once voiced such a question. However, Electricutter shows little interest in organic food. Aside from self-defense, the primary use of its heavily charged front limbs is digging energy-supplementing minerals out of rock layers.
1505141: Glifa's wings are small and soft, hard horns have not yet grown, and its fluffy touch is comforting. Many Glifa have bright personalities, and with patient companionship, you can eventually build a friendship with them.
1505142: The Griffin has sharp claws on its front legs, strong limbs, a supple tail, and possesses sensitivity and affinity towards the wind. Usually tame, it only displays a chest-puffing gesture when victorious.
1505143: Wingriff has rich, beautiful feathers and powerful wings that allow it to fly high and long for extended periods and distances. Its personality is gentle, loyal, and graceful. As a companion Kibo, Wingriff is immensely popular among knights.
1505144: Nono's companion Kibo. More innocent and adorable than a typical Chonoko. However, it retains the troublesome habit characteristic of Boaraga: disliking baths and preferring to roll around in the mud.
1505145: Snowbow excels at leaping and is very sensitive to sound. Highly cautious, it flees immediately upon hearing any sound resembling danger. With fur coloring resembling its surrounding environment, it can skillfully mimic its surroundings.
1505146: Snowmey's cheeks are covered in dense, fluffy fur capped with icicles, giving it ears that resemble soft-serve ice cream at first glance. However, the two ears on top of its head are the real ones.
1505147: Charlbit is agile and possesses the ability to manipulate ice. The soft-serve ice cream-like features on both sides of its face are fur covered in thick ice, and the true ears are actually on top of its head.
1505148: Lycaumo's entire body is covered in thick fur. Despite its sluggish appearance, its movements are agile and energetic. Usually peaceful, it never initiates attacks against other Kibo. However, once angered, it transforms into a moving fortress with broken brakes.
1505149: A Kibo whose outer skin is covered in armor. With vacant eyes, it might easily be underestimated. However, through its understated demeanor, sturdy carapace, and occasional bursts of flame from between its bone plates to intimidate enemies, it has established a stable position in the ecosystem.
1505150:
Armaro's defense wards off most predators, allowing it to spend more time on itself. Digging holes and rolling around might not seem like a very interesting lifestyle to other Kibo.
However, much like the bone plates blocking attacks, Armaro's mind is resilient enough to shrug off whatever anyone might say.
1505151: Magmaros has poor eyesight and often bumps its head into rocks. However, the rock is always the one that cracks. If human tribes or Kibo tried to throw stones at Magmaros out of teasing, the stones would bounce off its hard shell straight back into their own faces. That is how hard Magmaros's carapace is.
1505152: Sweega's body is supple and its movements are swift. It is a common type of Kibo in the wilderness. Although it doesn't look young and strong, its habit of hunting in packs places it in the position of a terrifying predator.
1505153: Mellowmey is timid, docile, and has a very misleading appearance. Viewed from the front or sides, it appears to have two pairs of long ears growing in different positions, but in reality, those are all just clumps of fur. The real ears are right above them and are very small.
1505154: A Kibo often seen in dim places. Its jelly-like body is covered in thick smoke. Despite its vacant appearance, its entire body is poisonous, and being attacked leaves one feeling depressed.
1505155: A Kibo that wraps itself in dark purple fog and likes to stay still in dim, cool places. It looks a bit dull, but its poison makes enemies feel depressed and lose their fighting spirit.
1505156: A typical elemental creature. Not strongly aggressive, but perverse and prefers dim, cool places. While it won't actively attack other creatures, meddling with it might leave you soaking wet.
1505157: To intimidate other creatures, it gathers materials like stones to build a new body. It does not initiate attacks, but once hostility is directed at it, you will be attacked with water vortices capable of crushing even rock walls.
1505158:
Still in the stage of trying to understand the world, it can get along with various Kibo. 
Although young, it can fly skillfully and plays by performing various acrobatics.
1505159:
As it grows, Lazaduna begins to develop curiosity about the outside world and craves adventure. 
Its flight and self-defense capabilities increase, and its dragon-like intimidation begins to gradually manifest, causing other Kibo to feel an instinctive fear.
1505160: Icy's personality is aloof and cold, and at times it erects walls of ice to keep everyone away.
1505161: Iciel is adept at manipulating ice and is the most reliable source of cold air among elemental spirits, but gaining its favor requires being accepted by Iciel, which is generally considered extremely difficult.
1505162: Frosets is, in a sense, the embodiment of the will of ice. It is the symbol of all stillness and cold, and no heat can melt its body, making it considered the most perfect and ruthless elemental incarnation.
1505163: Kilimy is often active at night, with its primary goal being to collect as much starlight as possible. The absorbed starlight is stored in the chest orb and becomes the source of its magical power. However, Kilimy's orb is still small, so it stores little starlight and its magic runs out quickly. Even so, starlight aids in its growth, not only smoothing its fur but eventually making its tail glow.
1505164: Starmiy's tail is fluffy and long, scattered with star-shaped patterns. Since it can store more starlight, it doesn't need to bathe in starlight every night like Kilimy. When its chest orb is filled with starlight, it shines brightly, and its tail emits a faint glow like a river of stars. It can freely manipulate ice magic, but its magic storage still has room for growth.
1505165: Hacha has a docile personality, a sturdy body, and is very smart. Since it can understand simple words, it enjoys eavesdropping on conversations between other intelligent races. It is fast and has high stamina, but its combat power is very low, so falling into a crisis might cause it to panic.
1505166: Fumo is very light and nimble, usually drifting aimlessly on the wind. It apparently sometimes gently bumps into passing Kibo.
1505167: Graceful Freelyf is the grown form of Fumo, with flowers growing from its head shaped like wind chimes. The seven-string lyre condenses wind-attribute star-pulse energy, and when played, produces a gentle tone resembling the whisper of a breeze.
1505168: Fulnefi's appearance is as lovely as a wind sprite. It rarely shows itself, and when it appears, its voice is heard before its form. A refreshing fragrance remains after Fulnefi passes by on the wind, and this fragrance reportedly conditions the body and refreshes the mind.
1505169: Windy likes to wander capriciously on the wind without a set destination. The direction the wind blows can be said to be where Windy wants to go.
1505170: Windel excels at manipulating the wind, and its personality is as light as the wind. Its movements are graceful, and anyone who sees its nimble figure cannot help but admire it.
1505171: Tempest is, in a sense, the embodiment of the will of wind. Its capricious demeanor makes it seem elusive to others. Overflowing with the courage to explore the unknown and constantly changing its course toward new adventures, it is the adventurer among elemental incarnations.
1505172: A Kibo that loves sleeping, enjoys very good sleep quality, and is not easily awakened by noise or other disturbances. It makes a "homie homie" sound whether awake or asleep, hence it was named 'Homie'. At night, its tail glows so companions can know its whereabouts even when it is fast asleep.
1505173: As it grows, its fluffy fur gradually falls out, and its tail and physique elongate slenderly. Highly active and possessing high leaping ability, it sometimes sneaks into intelligent race territories to snatch snacks and quickly escapes. Due to its nimbleness, catching it is quite difficult.
1505174: Gourmunc has a slender physique with agile limbs and is filled with a sense of presence. Its long, curved tail features distinctive black and white banded markings. It often bears the responsibility of protecting the pack, and upon encountering hostile intruders, intimidates and drives them away with its huge body and cries.
1505175: An omnivorous bird. It often fails when pecking at food, and its repeated pecking posture is endearing. Because it often calls "Duru", it was named 'Duru'.
1505176: A Kibo that looks like a moving ball of fur at first glance. It loves wrestling with companions, making it very gluttonous to compensate for intense exercise. Young Gadori cannot yet properly distinguish food, so funny sights of them nibbling on each other's fur are often seen...
1505177: A large herbivorous Kibo inhabiting various locations. Docile in personality, but a huge glutton. Strong as it looks, and not difficult to tame. Provided you have the financial means to cover its food costs, of course...
1505178:
Buron's brown fur is covered by a large, hard shell. Wrapping around its streamlined back, this carapace provides high defense, making its still-soft bones during youth less susceptible to damage.
Buron has a gentle personality and occasionally emits a falling rock-like sound, "buron buron". This is actually caused by resonance in its chest cavity, which is also the origin of its name.
1505179:
Blormol's movements are relatively swift among Kibo of the same build. Entering combat stance, it repeatedly executes rapid dashes in a short time to break defenses and press the opponent before they can recover their posture.
It also excels in load capacity, lightening the burden of accompanying companions by taking on luggage. However, when faced with unforeseen circumstances, it prioritizes protecting its companions over the cargo it carries.
1505180: A very shy Kibo. Its reactions are slow, and it basically never attacks. Sensing danger, it curls up and protects itself with its hard shell. It has a habit of eating gems, making it a headache for miners.
1505181: A warm Kibo that stores fire elements in gems and feels prickly to the touch. Highly sensitive to the presence of gems in mineral veins. When a mineral vein is mined, if there are empty holes, you can be almost certain they were made by a Ruby Beetle.
1505182: A Kibo that basically operates underground or in dark places. Its eyesight has mostly degenerated, but in return, its ears have become very sensitive, allowing it to hear distant sounds from minor vibrations transmitted through objects.
1505183: Full of energy and gentle in personality. Woody's body is composed of green leaves and emits a refreshing plant-like fragrance resembling fruits and flowers. Getting close to it is very therapeutic.
1505184: Woodel excels at manipulating plants and has nimble movements. The two trefoils on its head bob up and down with its head movements, drooping and wilting when it lacks energy. It looks much softer than ordinary plants.
1505185: Bindest is an envoy of nature and the most approachable among all elemental spirits. It always strolls through the forest and loves nothing more than spending time mingling among the plants.
1505186: Peachy's fiery red neck feathers extend all the way to its wings. Despite its small size, it can stun enemies by rubbing its claws together to generate sparks.
1505187: Melppo has tight, long eyebrows above its eyes, giving an imposing impression. Its feathers become fluffier, and its sharp claws can not only start fires but also firmly grasp prey. Its flight speed is fast, and its aggressiveness and scouting capabilities have also grown dramatically.
1505188: Scarlek has beautiful feathers like burning flames and mysterious patterns on its tail feathers. Upon encountering an enemy, it spreads its wings, intimidating the opponent with its huge figure. Flapping its sturdy wings, it can utilize air currents to generate vortexes of flame.
1505189: Leemo's down is very fluffy, scattering electric sparks and summoning lightning. Its personality is finicky; just when it seems drowsy or in a good mood, it can turn aggressive the next moment.
1505190: Rulyf is aloof and proud, and the tunes played on its seven-string lyre are crisp and passionate. With a style reminiscent of 'heavy metal', it can make the surrounding air vibrate.
1505191: Lurnefi has an imposing personality full of a sense of justice. Its lyre grows into a bag-like shape, filled inside with thunder-attribute star-pulse energy. Seeing the weak being bullied activates its 'heart of justice', summoning lightning to deliver 'punishment' regardless of who the opponent is.
1505192:
Small in size and limited in attack and defense means, Rafau must either be protected by adult kin or avoid danger itself.
Extremely cautious towards unfamiliar environments, it becomes aggressive. Wrapping its body in electric charge serves as its means of self-defense and intimidation, but it rarely harms others on its own accord.
1505193:
Radiva has a gentle personality and mature temperament, maintaining high independence even when forming bonds with intelligent races. That might stem from a proud nature, but at its core, it is extremely loyal and dependable.
Its power to manipulate thunder elements is flawless, combining power and attack technique with agile movements to deal massive damage to enemies. Due to its outstanding combat power, it has made a name for itself as a threatening presence on the battlefield.
1505194: Two small orbs float above its head. These are the main organs for discharging electricity and bob up and down with its movements.
1505195: Able to attract and manipulate the power of thunder. Disliking calm atmospheres or unchanging environments, it seeks to break the tranquility with sound or dazzling light.
1505196: Voltest is, in a sense, the embodiment of the will of thunder. Possessing a solemn personality, its inherent thunder element symbolizes the danger of storms. The power of thunder and its disorderly ferocity inspire awe toward the forces of nature.
1505197: A hot-tempered small Kibo that prefers dark, quiet places. Its stamina is low and its movement speed is not fast. Flight depends entirely on magic power, and the small wings on its back are used solely for combat and maintaining posture.
1505198: A short-tempered Kibo very sensitive to light and sound. Capable of sustained hovering flight. Realizing another Kibo is approaching, it quietly sneaks behind them and startles them with its creepy 'smile' while they drop their guard.
1505199: A Kibo inhabiting dim regions. Capable of sustained hovering flight and acting without making a sound. Upon noticing the approach of another Kibo, it first tries to intimidate and drive them away, but if that fails, it gets angry. In that case, the smile vanishes from its face, and it resorts to rough methods such as directly inflicting harm.
1505200: Blueeda has poor balance, its limbs and feet always moving incoherently. Just when you think it's swimming on the water, it plunges headfirst into it. However, it has a kind heart and loves sleeping in the sunlight on the lawn, sometimes even giggling "gwaku-gwaku" in its dreams.
1505201: Like the dreams of a young Blueeda, the adult Bluesigna has transformed into a very magnificent form. Puffing out its chest proudly as if its dream has come true, it has become even more optimistic. Occasionally, it lets out a laugh that secretly reveals its true "gwaku-gwaku" nature, but overall it is a graceful Kibo.
1505203: A Kibo with a very gentle personality that inhabits various parts of the world. It excels at carrying loads and loves putting found food or interesting things on its back. However, it is always troubled because it drops them while carrying them.
1505204: Contrary to its docile and elegant appearance, Kinoka is very active. Its body is agile and powerful, allowing it to dash freely through the forest. It often walks around the banks of forest streams.
1505205: Bloudy has a pair of giant, beautiful horns that are sharp and sturdy. Its plant tissue is layered, with vibrant patterns emerging on it. This layered structure acts as a shield to protect it when moving.
1505206: With beautiful blue-green fur, its gait while walking through the forest is full of lightness and elegance. It is said that most Foundys can understand Elven language, so when push comes to shove, they will stand shoulder to shoulder to fight enemies with you.
1505207:
Rockfray is a common elemental creature whose appearance resembles a brazier.
Tame Rockfrays are prized among travelers as natural illumination... though be careful not to let them get too close unexpectedly if you're curious, lest you get burned.
1505208: Fearock inherits the calm personality of the Phydro era, never attacking others on its own. However, if provoked, it instantly transforms into a dangerous figure, manipulating countless rocks imbued with high-temperature flames and hurling them at enemies.
1505209:
Gururu's tail looks just like a mushroom; it is edible and regenerates.
It tastes delicious, but has no particular nutritional value. Except when sleeping, it is always dizzy in circles, wandering aimlessly along fixed routes and bumping its head into the ground.
1505210: Monya has a slightly mischievous personality, preferring to play when it has free time. Its vigilance is low and its aggressiveness is minimal, but its footwork is extremely brisk, allowing it to perceive and avoid most dangers relying on its sensitive ears. While skilled at hiding and escaping, its combat prowess is not particularly high. The small flame on its head is only useful as a light source or fire starter with low lethality, so it mainly relies on its teeth and claws in battle.
1505211: Melareed has high explosive power and excels at cornering prey. It wraps flames around its forehead as well as the tip of its tail, dealing a certain amount of damage to enemies in combat. Its biting and scratching techniques have also been further refined. Compared to its youth, it has grown more cautious, but its curiosity toward the unknown remains strong, showing innocent playfulness only when safety is ensured.
1505212:
The adult Leobernd is an extremely ferocious Kibo with high agility and very fast running speed.
Its fur color is darker, flames spread from its forehead to its back, and the tips of its limbs and tail are burning fiercely. Just running creates a massive amount of flames, raising its danger level to an entirely different tier.
It conceals its presence to ambush prey, finishing them off in a single strike with its sharp claws and teeth. If you encounter a Leobernd while exploring the field, you must be careful.
Highly independent, it shows strong vigilance toward approaching creatures and has a habit of treating its active area as its own territory.
1505213: A Kibo with an extremely small population and behavior as mysterious as a ghost. Its body is adorned with beautiful patterns. It possesses a unique aesthetic sense, believing that the smoother the curving lines and the more regular the edges, the more beautiful it is.
1505215:
Exploring the ruins of the Dragon King era, you might find yourself targeted by this construct before you even notice.
With sharp senses and fast movements, when at a disadvantage, the Maze Keeper pretends to retreat, calling upon other constructs from the darkness to surround you.
1505216: Momo has a straightforward personality with justice in its heart. Though small in stature, whenever other Kibo are in trouble, it runs over without hesitation to help them with its innate strength.
1505217: Having grown stronger, Freimo can help even more Kibo. It finds joy in being needed and is happy to lend a hand with just a little praise. However, upon learning it has been deceived, it displays fierce anger, using the sharp horn on its head to relentlessly knock away the one who fooled it.
1505218: Taurick possesses a massive physique and mighty strength to match. Its personality is as steadfast and calm as a mountain, no longer just rushing forward blindly like in its youth, but thinking before acting. Yet, a passionate heart still beats within its chest. Seeing those suffering from injustice compels it to lend a hand, but it hurries away once the job is done so its giant stature won't frighten smaller Kibo.
1505219: Frau has a small, oval-shaped body covered entirely in fluffy fur. When resting, it curls up to hide within that fur, looking from a distance like a small, flying ball of fuzz.
1505220: Bollmaw has an active, mischievous personality and loves playing practical jokes. With its developed ears, its hearing is extremely keen, allowing it to accurately read the number and positions of enemies even in pitch darkness. It is a true hunter, anticipating movements, hiding, and watching for the timing of a surprise attack.
1505221: Beneath the fur around Fluofous's neck lies a specially structured layer of hair that rapidly expands to form a ring when catching sufficient airflow. The shape resembles a donut, fluffy and soft. Contrary to its adorable appearance, its slender, thorn-covered tail is a secret weapon concealed by Fluofous.
1505222: Chiko is tiny and cute, just like a pure white rice dumpling. A faint magical power drifts from the rounded ice crystal at the tip of its tail. Highly vigilant and timid, it spends most of its time inside caves, making it extremely rare to spot in the wild.
1505223: Teega has grown sharp fangs, and its tail condenses faint magic into a sharp icicle. Its snow-white fur is speckled with ash-blue patterns, giving it a sleeker and more slender physique. Its claws and other parts are still in the growth stage, but it already displays agile footwork and excellent hunting skills.
1505224: Named Galtiger for its long, sword-like fangs. Its extremely sharp claws are retractable, and its front paws and neck are covered in sturdy bone-like tissue, enabling a blend of offense and defense in combat. It has a fierce temperament and strong territorial awareness, launching attacks without hesitation upon encountering enemies.
1505225:
Leafho is active and excels in jumping power. It can easily leap two to three times its own height, and always bounces around when walking normally, making it extremely nimble.
Being overly active, Leafho often makes mistakes—jumping into holes and getting stuck.
1505226: Frater has high jumping power and fluffier fur. On its back are small leaf-like wings. Though unable to fully open, it can use them to glide after leaping, landing very gracefully.
1505227: Crownneck possesses an elegant appearance. Its crown-like horns are proof of complete maturity. It treasures its horns dearly, and the shinier they are, the more it is admired by other Kibo. When Crownneck walks with its head held high, it is showing off its horns.
1505228: Billiver's small head is packed with countless questions. With a shy personality, it lacks all confidence in its architectural skills, always worrying that a half-chewed piece of wood will topple over onto it. Consequently, it cannot let go of a seashell to ensure its safety. Its greatest dream is to build a dam nest by itself and sleep soundly inside it every day.
1505229: Waiver travels the world in search of materials that should be used for its signature masterpiece. It has strong opinions on architecture, building different nests and dams depending on the environment. As its abilities improve, Waiver develops confidence and pride, refusing to easily compromise.
1505230: Also called "Meister," the title of Mastiff is not self-proclaimed, but an honorary title "bestowed" upon it by the Kibo of the area through enchanting them with its creations. Its appearance grows more majestic and calm, yet its nature remains gentle and humble. When it spots a Kibo without a suitable nest, it crafts a beautiful, exquisite dwelling fitting for that Kibo.
1505231: Bomark has a fierce temperament, flocking with companions for fun to attack boats on the water. If it accidentally trips or receives a heavy blow, the energy inside its body becomes unstable, causing an explosion. Although it suffers almost no injury from the explosion, nearby Kibo are easily caught up in the blast.
1505232: Rayjark is powerful, featuring sharp fins and sturdy hind legs, with an extremely fast swimming speed and an imposing demeanor. It loves the sensation of speeding through the water at high velocity, sometimes getting so carried away that it crashes into boats on the water, piercing holes in them with its iron-like head. Unlike its youth, it no longer intentionally rams things for fun, but it still causes heavy damage to those traveling on the water.
1505233:
Notorious for its ferocious habits, Mailjark swims at a speed unbefitting its giant body, boasting top-tier swimming capabilities among aquatic Kibo.
Its instincts as a fierce hunter are also sharp, accurately sniffing out the direction and distance of scent sources with its astonishing sense of smell. Once it locks onto a target and launches an attack, fierce flames ignite on its sturdy arms, unleashing a devastating strike at tremendous speed that finishes off the enemy in an instant!
1505236:
Cook is shy and easily startled, but also possesses strong curiosity. It often hides behind cover to secretly observe, but flees quickly if spotted.
Though its eyes are large, its vision is not very good, and it relies on its split tongue to sense scents in order to gather information.
1505237: Bright, active, and free-spirited, Cookle dashes here and there like the wind. It possesses an excess of energy it cannot use up, driven by curiosity to perform all sorts of strange actions.
1505238:
With a massive increase in weight and height, and a sharper look in its eyes, Cooklelk.
Along with its growth, it has more sources of trouble than in its youth, and as if embodying a matured inner self, its cry has also changed to a cool "coo".
1505240:
Royray is the fiercest young Pegasus in Avallion's Pegasus Knight Order. Boasting pureblood pride, graceful demeanor, and supple footwork, ever since coming to act alongside Char, it has learned to use its power for protection.
Royray is cool toward others, but gentle with Char, and never betrays those it acknowledges as partners. If anyone doubts Char's glory, it will raise an angry neigh on the spot.
1505241: A Kibo with an extremely small population. Its personality is innocent, optimistic, cheerful, and full of curiosity, and it loves to play. It always floats around aimlessly, light on its feet and as swift as an uncapturable light.
1505243: Laughing Hannya is a moody creature that prefers to haunt dim places, breathing fire while laughing and playing tricks on children. It is overjoyed when startling someone and has a strong playful streak. However, if the target doesn't notice it, it sulks and flies into a rage!
1505244: Warting Demon's surroundings are constantly drifted by ghost flames. Possessing a fickle and laid-back personality, it loudly denounces anyone who goes against it. Its voice is bustling as if mixed with various sounds. As long as the sound can be heard, its presence can be recognized even from afar.
1505245: Demon Mask has a stubborn personality, dislikes being approached, and attacks anyone who trespasses into its territory without hesitation. Its gigantic form is eerie, oppressive, and filled with explosive power. Part of its ghost flames have turned into arms, and the entangling chains seem to hint that parts of its intense emotions are bound up.
1505246: Schlark seeks stimulation and has a strong attachment to victory. It competes with others in every aspect: speed, endurance, movement difficulty, and environmental interference. Winning energizes it, while losing droops its spirits—yet that only lasts until news of the next competition arrives.
1505247: A very sharp nocturnal Kibo. Although it appears to have no means of self-defense, it actually uses its clever brain to contend with various powerful natural enemies, sometimes even stealing prey in return.
1505248: Neetole teaches various skills to young Nyaho, receiving rewards in return from the prey captured by Nyaho. Neetole's students sometimes include Kibo of other races.
1505249: Its body is astonishingly light, ready to take flight the moment the wind blows. Rumors say some individuals achieved a continent-spanning journey in their youth, drifting out to sea on the sea breeze and eventually reaching the ends of the world.
1505250: A Kibo whose entire body is covered in fluffy down. Rather than simply being swept by the wind like Popoti, it can float in the air under its own power and control the direction of its flight.
1505252: Pikarin is born in dense jungles, possessing the property of absorbing and emitting light through its tail. This luminescence is the defining trait of Firefly. Timid and shy by nature, it is easily startled by the slightest noise. Therefore, it often hides deep among leaves and grass, enjoying quiet time undisturbed by anyone.
1505253: Fiar is the grown form of Pikarin. Having gone through the forest exploration period of its youth, its personality has become cheerful and it no longer hides its curiosity. When it spots visitors to the forest, it proactively approaches them in a friendly manner, flying around them with great interest. While observing their reaction, it conveys wishes of friendship through its tiny light and dance.
1505254: Most Speeckles inhabit the depths of dense jungles. They are also often thought to be a type of fairy that coexists with the forest. It is said that being acknowledged by a Speeckle is proof of having a pure heart, allowing one to join the circle of forest fairies and dance together with them.
1505255:
Piad is known for its purity and friendliness, always drifting freely and slowly toward various regions.
When music is played around it, Piad's eyes light up vividly as it joins in the performance.
1505256: Optimistic and bright-hearted, Frogoole is friendly to all living creatures that love music. Whenever someone is feeling down or negative emotions are detected, it plays music to cheer them up.
1505257: Frogley is extremely confident, capable of manipulating the flow of surrounding sound waves to create a powerful audio field. Within this field, no music produced by anyone can drown out Frogley's sound—it always uses this bold method to announce its arrival to the surroundings!
1505258: Mokyun is a balloon-shaped Kibo, commonly seen within the city-state of Fleece as the mascot of the Ozzy Brigade. Its body is hollow and rounded, naturally floating in the air. Its personality is mild and approachable, having lived alongside wise races for a long time.
1505259: Clodyme has a docile and straightforward personality, leisurely in most cases. When exposed to mortal danger or harboring worries, its emotional changes are clearly visible.
1505260: The very first thing Grainy does upon birth is thoroughly conceal its own traces and search for a Greaterg's territory. Due to its weak strength, Grainy must hide everywhere to avoid being spotted by natural enemies. Once it reaches a Greaterg's territory, Grainy receives a certain degree of protection. However, it loses its freedom thereafter, running about all day gathering grain grains and the like for the Greaterg.
1505261: Grenard has a slender physique and agile movements. Possessing a certain level of combat capability, it no longer needs to hide around.
