It secretes mucus from its tail, which helps it stick and carry found wheat. In times of emergency, it can sever its tail, leaving the wheat behind to escape. Thus, it advances to fight, retreats to disguise itself as wheat ears to hide, and flees swiftly when it cannot win.
1505262: Greaterg has shifted from its former swift and active personality to a leisurely one. It is often seen sitting beside its mountain of grain, serenely waiting for tributes from Grainys and Grenards. The scale armor covering its chest is densely adorned with carefully selected, large grains of wheat, and Grainys and Grenards frequently let out gasps of admiration at its collection. Each time, Greaterg proudly puffs out its chest and wears a boastful expression.
1505264:
Exploring the ruins of the Dragon King era, you might encounter this construct face-to-face right around a corner.
Some tried to decipher its former name from ancient texts and control it with modern magic, but all such attempts failed. The commands at the foundation of this construct were as sturdy, hard, and unshakable as the stone forming it.
1505265: A gentle and friendly Kibo that rarely gets angry. Composed and reliable, it won't kick back even if its hind legs are touched. When stroked on the head or shoulders, it happily neighs. When happy, it taps its toes in a light-footed step known as the "Ponyro Step." Its adorable movement is often imitated by other Kibo.
1505266: A Kibo of magnificent stature boasting sturdy muscles, excellent horsepower and stamina, and astonishing weight. It possesses exceptional memory, remembering even the taste of the grass it ate most during its youth.
1505267: Squeak's hands are made of tree branches. In its juvenile stage, it cannot yet freely control its body and flits between wheat fields, looking like a scarecrow bouncing all around. From a distance, some mistake it for a real scarecrow, but observing closely reveals sensory organs on its face—stitched, crooked eyebrows and eyes, and an eternally unchanging smile.
1505268: Automit's eyebrows and eyes always point downward, giving it a sad expression. Although its expression never changes, that doesn't mean it is always sad. It expresses emotions through body language, and attacks targets that may pose a threat to the farmland with great persistence.
1505270:
A taciturn and elusive long-range archer of the Red Scorpion Band, usually acting alone.
Some Red Scorpion Archers apply poison to their arrowheads, but this lowers the resale value of prey, potion costs are no small matter, and missing means a total loss. That is why they hoard it and rarely use this method.
1505272:
The most lawless member of the Red Scorpion Band. Not only quick to pick fights, but also skilled in strategy.
Respected for their actual strength, they always bring back mountains of loot whenever they go out on a job. Because of this, how to make such unruly outlaws submit serves as a touchstone for measuring a leader's capability.
1505274:
A member of the Red Scorpion Band who specializes in close-quarters combat. Naturally possessing a very sturdy physique, equipping metal defensive carapace has made them even less afraid of swords.
While their martial prowess ranks among the top two in the organization, their extreme fondness for violence causes even their comrades to keep their distance. Consequently, they are often assigned only the role of a bodyguard.
1505276:
A swift-moving member of the Red Scorpion Band. The two scimitars in their hands are used not only as weapons, but also for picking locks, digging dirt, and demolishing houses.
However, despite possessing sharp blades, they dislike frontal combat, preferring ambushes and overwhelming numbers.
1505277:
Woody has a lively personality and loves playing in the forest, but when it's time to rest, they always return to the guardian sapling of their choice.
What Woody cares about most is the growth of the guardian sapling, carefully wiping dust off the leaves with their characteristic fluffy tail. Woody has forged a special connection with the forest they live in. Perhaps because of this, those who bully Woody reportedly meet with bad luck in the forest.
1505278: Grown Lindy's ability to manipulate wood elements has increased significantly. The young sprout that was on top of its head during childhood has grown into something resembling a hat. This is also part of Lindy's body, and only those who open their hearts to it can touch this part. The "Wooden Staff" in its hand was made by raising a young branch of the tree it guards, and is Lindy's most cherished possession.
1505279:
Upon reaching maturity, the sapling guarded by Foley grows into a towering tree piercing the sky. Then, it builds a simple wooden hut at the top of the tree it guards, spending most of its time there observing and protecting the surrounding forest.
With a calm personality favoring a quiet environment, it reacts with intense anger toward those who intentionally ruin nature, hoisting them up onto tree branches with vines and refusing to let them down until they admit their mistake.
1505281: A Cabard completely eroded by Sunya. While its appearance retains some features from before the erosion, along with partial former habits, personality, and memories, its mode of life has completely changed. In all aspects, it exhibits characteristics almost identical to native Fierce Beasts.
1505283: A formidable enemy that forms the backbone of the Fierce Beast army, maintaining numerical superiority while improving combat effectiveness. Dark Knights have neither mind nor emotion, but from their agile and sharp attacks, a faint "fervor" unfearful of death can be felt—what they seek is the complete destruction of all things, including themselves.
1505285: The type with the highest combat power among general Fierce Beasts. Boasting immense, violent, and overwhelming physical strength. When appearing on the battlefield, they care not at all about sweeping up advancing Darks. On the contrary, they may even absorb useless Darks as their own energy, truly making them ruthless and strict commanders.
1505287: Scouts and sentinels of the Fierce Beast army that continuously track the traces of all prey without sleeping or resting. Taking the form of irregular floating spheres in the air, they swarm weakened or off-guard enemies and concentrate light beams to annihilate them. If the enemy is too powerful, they secretly signal to summon the Fierce Beast army and engulf them with a fierce tide.
1505289: A general believer of the Evolution Cult participating in combat. Wearing a leopard-woman mask on her face and the cult's standard, easy-to-move women's combat uniform. When activating power, circular Karma magic circles appear on both wrists.
1505291: A general believer of the Evolution Cult participating in combat. Wearing a bear mask and the Evolution Cult's close-combat combat uniform. Their solid build and the heavy hammer strikes delivered from it form the lowest-tier workforce of the Evolution Cult.
1505293: Elite troops of the Evolution Cult. Wielding giant swords eroded by Sunya, wearing wolf masks, and fitted with Sunya cores on their chests. These are entities that evolved during the Evolution Cult's exploration of how human races can utilize Sunya. Although their bodies sometimes fall into an uncontrollable state, their power has reached a realm far higher than before.
1505294:
Neroalba is a special Kibo born in the dim places of Kyokashu, consisting of two entities as one. Possessing the property of not being able to separate beyond a certain distance from each other, the two alone continue playing all day without getting tired of it.
With high learning ability and boundless curiosity, they observe passersby with intense interest. As a result, the opponents get frightened and scurry away in a panic, but thanks to this, they were able to learn various expressions. Also, for a long time, they mistook the word "Ghost!" shouted by fleeing people as their own name.
1505295: Just like in their juvenile stage, Kurosiro Muon cannot separate far from each other. Liking the dark attribute, they often stay in dim places, searching everywhere for "malignant thoughts" and devouring them. Because of this, their expressions have gradually grown dark and gloomy. However, they do not quite understand why intelligent races have gradually grown to fear them. Sometimes, when trying to show a friendly expression, they end up making the other party cry even harder instead...
1505297:
Chofuko has a valorous and curious personality, liking to charge around everywhere.
When stimulated, it releases scorching flames from inside its body, burning the hair on top of its head and parts of its body to intimidate enemies.
1505299:
Fiaraga is not only good at charging, but also possesses a blazing mane, enabling it to inflict severe burns on enemies. Furthermore, after it charges, a trail of burning flames temporarily remains.
Meanwhile, in a non-combat state, they often gather near rocks, mingling the decreasing residual heat of their bodies with geothermal heat. That leisurely sight is unimaginable from their berserk state in battle.
1505300:
Rydon has a pair of sharp bull horns on its forehead, four hooves covered in thick fur, and is always full of vitality. When running through mountainous rocky areas, its sturdy hooves step on rocks making a crisp thumping sound, which is the origin of its name.
Perhaps because it is still young, it adventures everywhere without fear, and even when meeting a Kibo much larger than itself, it does not flinch in the least.
1505301:
Mephy's back and head are covered in long, soft fur. When crouching down on all fours, its appearance becomes identical to a Clodime, leading Clodimes to mistake Mephy for one of their own.
Mephy often hides within Clodime herds, grazing on green grass and drinking spring water with the Clodimes during the day, but revealing sharp fangs and claws at night. However, Mephy's power is so weak that even when trying to leave the herd to go hunting, it is often pushed back by the head of a guard Clodime...
1505302: Mephon operates near Clodime herds during the day. Seeing it engrossed in eating grass, many small Kibos let down their guard and come close to Mephon to play together. However, at night, Mephon's ferocious nature is exposed. If one remains defenseless against Mephon, they will instantly become prey. However, it seems that among inexperienced Mephons, some have dulled fangs because they ate too much grass during the day...
1505303:
Megarum has long hair that covers its eyes and claws. Because of the dangerous aura emitted from its body, many Kibos fear and avoid approaching it. At night, Megarum reveals its true form, with its long, silky fur standing on end, exposing vicious eyes and sharp claws. Its claw strikes are terrifying, and those designated as prey can hardly escape.
Curiously, even a Megarum this ferocious never attacks Clodime herds near its habitat.
1505304:
Mimics are cunning yet cowardly Kibos that live by possessing treasure chests. They wander around various places where treasure chests appear, collecting things dropped by explorers like diligent scavengers.
Even "trash" that has no value in the eyes of others is a precious collection to a Mimic. Occasionally taking them out to gaze at or toy with them, they let out eerie chuckles of satisfaction.
1505305: With a rounded build and often sitting side by side in flocks, Tweet is known as a talkative little bird. Its short, rapid chirps ring out incessantly, and its expressions are rich. Its beak moves constantly, whether for interacting with companions or catching the attention of other Kibos and intelligent races. The only times it is kept quiet are probably during meals and sleep.
1505306: Homilow has a large body, with fluffy, wide-spreading feathers developed on both sides of its cheeks and more flamboyant tail feathers. Storing plenty of fat in its body, it can adapt to harsh long-distance flights. Being good at remembering routes, many intelligent races enlist Homilow's help to deliver letters and cargo. When making deliveries, Homilow enters a state of extreme concentration, reaching its destination without being distracted by any external factors. However, some think it's just zoning out.
1505307:
Seika's Young Fox is small with soft fur. Its most distinctive feature is the flame-like pink hair tuft at the tip of its tail.
During its juvenile stage, Seika's Young Fox is at its most active and mischievous period. A playful foodie, whether it's slowly falling peach petals or steaming hot pork buns in a steamer basket, it immediately fixes an eager gaze upon them. If Akahana's Spiritual Fox or Mugen's Nine-Tails weren't keeping a watchful eye, it would cause trouble one after another in no time.
1505308:
Akahana's Spiritual Fox has grown more supple and graceful through maturation. Its fur is denser, its tails number three, and its scarlet fur is increasingly vibrant. These are proof that its power has grown stronger.
In front of Seika's Young Foxes who admire it, Akahana's Spiritual Fox displays mature, composed, and graceful behavior. But once away from the little foxes, it suddenly reveals a mischievous side—though the cuteness of a kit is gone, it does not yet seem fully mature.
1505309: Only a tiny fraction of Akahana's Spiritual Foxes can evolve into Mugen's Nine-Tails. This is because, besides long training, mysterious "destiny/bonds" are indispensable. Every bond, emotion, and happening in the world serves as an opportunity to support the Nine-Tails clan's training. Even after becoming Mugen's Nine-Tails and acquiring transformation arts, the days of weaving bonds for training never end.
1505311: Fast as lightning, ferocious as lightning, and noisy as lightning! Its physique is far larger than its kind, equipped with a golden-glowing mane and recurved sharp fangs. An unquenchable lust for battle—behold King Laruga. The absolute king reigning at the pinnacle of all Boarlarugas.
1505313: A Halcyon completely eroded by Sunya. While its appearance retains some features from before Sunya's erosion, along with partial former habits, personality, and memories, its mode of life has completely changed. In all aspects, it exhibits characteristics almost identical to native Fierce Beasts.
1505315: A Trimanda completely eroded by Sunya. While its appearance retains some features from before Sunya's erosion, along with partial former habits, personality, and memories, its mode of life has completely changed. In all aspects, it exhibits characteristics almost identical to native Fierce Beasts.
1505317: A Lykaumo completely eroded by Sunya. While its appearance retains some features from before Sunya's erosion, along with partial former habits, personality, and memories, its mode of life has completely changed. In all aspects, it exhibits characteristics almost identical to native Fierce Beasts.
1505319: A Scareck completely eroded by Sunya. While its appearance retains some features from before Sunya's erosion, along with partial former habits, personality, and memories, its mode of life has completely changed. In all aspects, it exhibits characteristics almost identical to native Fierce Beasts.
1505321: Once the most loyal and brave subordinates of Ludaris, they have now turned into its most ferocious and cruel claws and fangs. Following Ludaris and committing atrocities, while they still remain by Ludaris's side, they no longer act for mission or loyalty, but solely for pure destruction and slaughter.
1505323: Red Scorpion Band squad leader. Called "Boss" in the squad. Committing robberies against wealthy merchants, but actually using the seized money and goods to help those living at the bottom, especially children. Weapon is an explosive pile bunker. While single-target instantaneous damage per shot is high, it cannot output sustained firepower. Reloading gunpowder is required to use it again, and some time must pass for it to cool down.
1505325: A member of the Red Scorpion Band skilled in magic. Using magic to create mid- to long-range weapons and attack nimbly, they usually prefer using a magical long whip. While other members target people, Red Scorpion Eye Sorcerers target Kibo. Of course, showing no mercy regardless of who the target is, they swing their magic whips and strip away treasures completely.
1505326:
Unlike regular Jail Demon Masks, the true form of Hakukin Oni resides within ornate armor decorated with thin gold.
This great armor was originally a relic of a chief retainer of the Minamoto clan family. Its owner served with unwavering loyalty and admonished his lord without fear. After ending his life, he was respectfully enshrined by later generations and came to be regarded as a symbol of "righteousness" and supreme honor.
1505329: Church knights devoted to doctrine and faith. Their main missions are the investigation, trial, and adjudication of those whom the Supreme Light Church considers heretical evil. They are also responsible for the imprisonment and execution of dissenters. While all of them swear loyalty to the Radiant Light Church, they despise the royal authority of the Rosia Empire, making them an important military force for the church to intimidate imperial nobles.
1505331: Church knights with pious faith. Their main missions are the investigation, trial, and adjudication of those whom the Supreme Light Church considers heretical evil. They are also responsible for the imprisonment and execution of dissenters. While all of them swear loyalty to the Radiant Light Church, they despise the royal authority of the Rosia Empire, making them an important military force for the church to intimidate imperial nobles.
1505333:
Astral vein flows change with the passage of time; once richly filled astral vein nodes lose their brilliance and become astral vein amber, turning into crystals that record the past exposed to the winds of time.
When Starborn touch these ambers, the Karma within their bodies reactivates the astral vein energy remaining in the amber, and the amber regains its radiance.
However, amber suddenly activated in this way emits intense Karma waves in the short term, attracting surrounding creatures and sparking disputes over the amber. Thus, while the amber is being repaired, it must be protected from destruction.
1505335: A faint legend lurking deep within the Fog-Hidden Forest. Drawn by strong obsession, it shows its figure, but returns only whimsical pranks. Truth or illusion? Dream or reality? This is indeed the untouchable fairy butterfly.
1505336: A mysterious nightmare said to lurk deep within the Fog-Hidden Forest, hiding its form by day and appearing at night. Like the thick fog shrouding the night, no one can discern its true identity.
1505337: Among the flocks of Skyhawks that love to fly and yearn for freedom, the individual named "Pamola" is a special existence. According to Winged Folk legend, this individual is the sharp eye of the Hawk God, keeping watch over all creation from high heavens unattainable by ordinary mortals. Therefore, the Winged Folk of Wind-Hidden Rock gave this Skyhawk the name "Pamola", meaning "Thunder Soul".
1505338: A brave and powerful Finnwolf descended from Tana. Growing up in Charlulu Village alongside the hunter Terara since childhood, they are bound by a deep bond. Brave, fearless, and unflinching against any danger, Ull is as loyal and reliable as Tana.
1505339:
The will of the wolf pack descended as power, and Ull achieved remarkable growth.
Its body grew exceptionally large, its fur shone with colorful radiance, and it gained even more splendor. By howling, it can summon phantoms of its brethren to join the combat. When the resonance of the entire wolf pack reaches its maximum, the ice and snow power it manipulates can even alter the weather of the entire area.
Ull now runs across the land where its ancestors once lived. Its heartbeat overlaps with the wolf pack. Thoughts transcending time have finally materialized here.
1505340: Sapitz is small with an active and mischievous personality, and loves ores. It always digs around the ground with its small claws looking for fragments. Although its mining technique is still crude and leaves it covered in mud, it gets immensely excited just finding the tiniest grain of mineral. Sometimes it even digs a small hole around an ore to sleep, trying to blend into the environment like the ore itself.
1505341: Sapyras likes digging for ores. With the paw pads of its front legs, it can sense underground minerals through rock layers and explore new mineral veins. Equipped with an extraordinary intuition to see through brittle parts of rock structures, it often finds mineral veins faster than miners. It has already mastered basic rotational mining techniques, rolling its body into a spherical shape and high-speed spinning to crush ores along with rock walls, obtaining fragments from within.
1505342: Cobolterg has a calm personality, no longer crashing around everywhere like in its youth, and stays at specific mineral veins for long periods. Like an experienced "site supervisor", it directs Sapitz and Sapyras of the pack to divide the work. Signals are conveyed through low purring sounds or high, clear tones produced by rubbing its thorns together. Furthermore, its rotary drilling technique is perfected, capable of carving out small tunnels almost entirely on its own power.
1505343:
Starmi of Fading Light has grown up together with Rubina since childhood. Its name was inspired by light novels Rubina read countless times.
Rubina's Starmi has a much higher efficiency in absorbing starlight than general Starmis, always maintaining sufficient magical power. During Rubina's work, it often emits starlight to illuminate her hands, with an effect comparable to standard lighting fixtures. Lighting a lamp and receiving it—both Rubina and Starmi enjoy such modest interactions.
1505344:
Drafy is a lifeform born from flames, and its dragon eggs often appear in extremely hazardous locations, such as the center of lava pools or volcanic precipices. Having a natural affinity for the Fire element, Drafy perceives the flow of Fire elemental energy the moment it hatches, learning how to manipulate flames guided by instinct.
Drafy loves collecting glowing ores, heat-retaining ores, and treasures, piling them up in its small nest and fiercely guarding them as its own property.
1505345:
Upon entering its growth stage, Draforge's ambitions grow in proportion to its significantly increased size and strength. At this stage, Draforge has already established a stable territory, with deep caves piled high with treasures scavenged from all over—ores, gems, weapon wreckage, and items from intelligent races that, though beyond their understanding, feel "awfully impressive."
Unlike the recklessness of its juvenile stage, Draforge begins to acquire the wisdom of strategy and leadership.
1505346:
Dragoblaze is the ruler of volcanoes and magma. Its sturdy shell withstands extreme temperatures, and the breath of flame expelled from its mouth melts rock walls.
Dragoblaze is noble, but by no means tyrannical. It guards its realm of flames and preserves the balance within it. Unless provoked, it never willingly leaves its territory.
According legend, those recognized by Dragoblaze are permitted to ride upon its back, allowing them to traverse scorching magma and seas of fire as if driving a moving volcano.
1505348:
Batty is the juvenile stage of Shediva. During this period, it is extremely sleepy; even during nighttime when Shediva becomes active, Batty is always dazed and never fully awake.
When sleeping, Batty hangs upside down in caves just like other Shediva. However, not yet mature, they are unaccustomed to this sleeping posture, frequently loosening their claws and falling to the ground, forcing them to climb back up and reattach themselves every single time.
1505349:
Nibat is the grown form of Batty. With more developed wings and lower limbs, sudden falls to the ground while sleeping no longer happen.
At this stage, hearing and vision are greatly enhanced, allowing free movement even in dark nocturnal jungles. These abilities are used not only for hunting but also for hiding from other Kibo. Due to its introverted personality, it tends to avoid crossing paths with other Kibo, preferring to hide in safe places and secretly watch them play.
1505350:
Having fully entered adulthood, Shediva has greatly improved abilities across the board, but its personality has become even more reclusive. Encountering unfamiliar individuals causes it to curl up tightly and bolt away at top speed.
However, in front of familiar kindred, it may display a somewhat bossy and willful attitude—for instance, demanding that another give up the coziest spot on the cave wall...
1505352: Fiark typically haunts farmland, piles of withered grass, or desolate paths. Fearing the light, it only dares to show itself stealthily after twilight. It tightly hugs a small wooden sword, cherishing it as if it were its sole pillar of support. Young and timid, it follows its innate instinct to protect the quiet night. If anyone intrudes upon its territory, Fiark—driven by fear—somehow manages to lift and swing its wooden sword. Although it has almost no attacking power, it still desperately tries to keep danger at bay.
1505354:
Neatmit searches for a self-proclaimed domain, driving its sharp, giant sickle into the ground to declare sovereignty over the area. While its juvenile stage merely "protected while frightened," it now "watches over with firm resolve."
Neatmit permits small Dark-attribute creatures to inhabit its body. Toward such creatures, it is always magnanimous and quiet—or perhaps it still hasn't truly emerged from its lonely juvenile stage.
1505356:
Karabecco is the juvenile form of Cabbird, loves burrowing into the soil, and has a relatively calm disposition. Occasionally, when angered, it might bump into things, but it has zero lethality.
The vegetable on Karabecco's head is edible and quite popular for its moderate spiciness. Because of this, compared to Cabbird, Karabecco has its leaves plucked much more frequently.
1505358:
Cabbird's temperament is much more aggressive than Karabecco's, harboring considerable explosive power. By violently shaking its body, it releases the "spiciness" within all at once to drive away enemies.
When encountering an opponent it simply cannot defeat, it can successfully escape by voluntarily shedding its leaf crest to distract the foe.
1505360:
Lalati usually operates in groups at night, using the light emitted by their bodies to check each other's positions. When startled, they release a weak electric shock to slightly stun enemies.
Additionally, Lalati has a habit of chasing glowing objects, such as light reflected by water surfaces or raindrops, and even metal tools used by travelers. Approaching out of curiosity to touch them with their bodies, they usually end up bouncing away from "shock repulsion," flustered as they clickle and snap continuously.
1505362:
Lalappo is the mature form of Lalati. Its entire body is covered in soft lightning fluff that feels faintly electrical to the touch, resembling a fluffy, floating little thundercloud.
Lalappo can adjust its body size by absorbing moisture and lightning from the air. When absorbing moisture, its body swells roundly; its floating speed decreases, but stability increases. Conversely, when discharging electricity, its body shrinks slightly and its speed increases, flashing across the night sky like swift lightning.
1505365: Jadion inhabits the abysses of frigid icy seas, excelling in ranged combat and arcane techniques. It prefers exploring the unknown and shows interest in artifacts sunken in the deep sea, but rarely reveals itself on shores.
1505367: An Autamitted completely eroded by Sunya. Its appearance retains certain characteristics from before Sunya's erosion, and some of its former habits, personality, and memories remain intact. However, its very mode of life has completely changed, exhibiting characteristics almost identical to native fierce beasts in every respect.
1505369: A Leorburned completely eroded by Sunya. Its appearance retains certain characteristics from before Sunya's erosion, and some of its former habits, personality, and memories remain intact. However, its very mode of life has completely changed, exhibiting characteristics almost identical to native fierce beasts in every respect.
1505371: An Azudran completely eroded by Sunya. Its appearance retains certain characteristics from before Sunya's erosion, and some of its former habits, personality, and memories remain intact. However, its very mode of life has completely changed, exhibiting characteristics almost identical to native fierce beasts in every respect.
1505372:
Suanzhong's flight capability is relatively weak, but the feather powder shaken off its body emits an irritating odor. When colliding, a large amount of feather powder scatters, making the odor even stronger. Suanzhong uses this method to repel enemies.
Its personality is generally laid-back, spending most of its time burrowing in the dirt and sleeping. When encountering difficult-to-solve situations, it gives up easily, which is why Chen Dynasty proverbs sometimes compare people who avoid trouble to Suanzhong.
1505373:
Suania's flight capability is extremely weak, but its entire body is elastic, with fluffy and soft feathers. Just a light touch shakes off a large amount of pungent feather powder, making it adept at driving away enemies.
Suania is quite quick-tempered, getting angry over trivial matters and bouncing around on the ground. However, being forgetful, it immediately forgets why it was angry and goes right back to burrowing in the dirt to sleep.
1505374:
Yellowda likes to think, but often finds itself overwhelmed by cascading questions, sinking into its own world. At such times, it wears a dazed expression and its movements can become awkward.
However, underestimating them based on this would be a grave mistake.
Yellowda is a very detached Kibo who may lose itself in contemplation, but never frets over worries.
1505375:
Yellowda and Yellowalby do not differ drastically like Bluedu and Bluesigna do; they merely grow larger, while naturally becoming wiser and more powerful.
Just because Bluesigna's appearance is elegant, trying to make Yellowalby diet or shape up is entirely futile. Yellowalby's body is packed solid, and they consider anyone trying to put them on a diet a tedious fool.
1505379: Bomark has a fierce temperament, gathering in groups with peers for fun to attack boats on the water. If it accidentally falls or receives a heavy impact, the Fire element within its body destabilizes, triggering an explosion. Even though it suffers almost no injury from the explosion itself, nearby Kibo are easily caught in the blast.
1505403: A Kibo that looks just like leafy greens. It loves burrowing into the soil and is always in a good mood. When angry, it might bump into enemies, but it has zero lethality. The vegetable portion of Cabakko cannot be separated from its main body; forcing them apart would reportedly cause Cabakko never to wake up again.
1505404: A bizarre fierce beast fusing characteristics of various creatures while differing completely in essence. What drives Shadowblaze is an intense craving for "predation." To this fierce beast, even its own kind serves as prey.
1505405: Boaraga is an omnivorous Kibo widely distributed across this world. Its plump body, strange horns on the front of its head, and unique mane on its back give it a ruffian impression.
1505407: A visibly ferocious giant bird covered in sharp spikes from head to toe. Because only bones and frost remain in its wake, it is regarded as a symbol of ill omen. Its presence is as destructive as biting winter winds, yet it is simultaneously part of the cycle of life.
1505408:
A mystical Kibo said to have brought the Spring of Abundance to Fleece.
After this city-state grew strong enough to weather wind and rain on its own, Amalthea quietly disappeared. Even so, the residents believe that the benevolent Amalthea still watches over Fleece from somewhere.
1505409:
"Ludaris" is merely one of the many names given to this fierce beast by intelligent races.
According to legends, this entity once roamed the world bearing a far more glorious name; wherever its armies headed, fortresses were burned to ashes, and wherever its gaze turned, kingdoms perished. Consequently, survivors made its true name taboo, never speaking it aloud. Over long ages, that name became buried in history.
1505410:
A mystical Kibo symbolizing "Gold" and "Abundance," said to embody elements and the very will of nature. Seresha commands the astral pulse energy of "Maturation" and "Transformation," possessing the power to turn formless wishes into richly laden ears of wheat and brilliantly shining gold.
Though said to appear only in the "Golden Land of Abundance" and never leave it a single step, the reality is the reverse. Seresha does not dwell solely in the Golden Land; rather, wherever it visits becomes the Golden Land.
1505411:
A young girl dressed in antique robes with a mysterious talisman pasted on her head.
Her gloomy atmosphere and pale skin make strangers uneasy. However, more often than not, she is the one startled out of her wits by strangers.
1505413:
Fierce as a blazing fire, ferocious as a roaring flame, dazzling as a raging inferno!
Its entire body is covered in black-red mane flowing like magma, its pair of tusks is as sharp as burning blades, and an undying fighting spirit burns eternally in its eyes—this is Flameraga, the supreme king ruling over all Fiaraga.
1505415: The cursed blade "Magatsumaru" gains its power by devouring the spirit and soul of its host, but it can continue to fight even after losing its master. By unleashing all the dark power of its blade and gathering a hundred spirits to form a physical body, it drags its opponent into a barrier it has constructed itself to engage in an endless, mortal struggle.

1508922: Wriggling her nose to sniff around, Xiaoyu carefully selected the candy with the mildest aroma. Tea flavor. It has a slightly unusual profile, but surprisingly delicious...♪
1508923: Wriggling her nose to sniff around, Xiaoyu tried sniffing, but nothing could be smelled through the wrapper...
1508924: No matter how bizarre the flavor, Xiaoyu isn't afraid! Xiaoyu grabbed a blue candy and popped it into her mouth. For some reason, the moment she ate it, the scenery before her eyes warped and swayed, but returned to normal immediately after. How magical!
1508925: If she ate something with a weird taste... no way, no way. Xiaoyu shook her head repeatedly, as if imagining some terrifying sight...
1508926: Waking up in the morning, Xiaoyu felt as though the world had completely changed -- the birdsong outside the window sounded as clear as if it were ringing right next to her ear, the aroma of market pastries drifted right up close, and even the split ends of her shed tail fur were clearly visible.
1508927: Could it be... her training in "Insight" was progressing smoothly? Let's put it to the test right away!
1508928: There was a pastry crumb on the Starborn's collar. They must have just finished breakfast at the market. The Starborn wore a somewhat mischievous expression. They were definitely planning to deliver a surprise to Xiaoyu. And that bulging pocket of the Starborn's... without a doubt, they bought an extra pastry for Xiaoyu and slipped it into their pocket!
1508929: Xiaoyu's analysis wasn't wrong by even a fraction. Even the Starborn was taken aback by this. Xiaoyu decided to name this "see one and know ten" skill --
1508931: A long queue had formed in front of the Meimei House storefront. Apparently, a new menu item had been added to the shop. The drifting aroma mixed the scents of tea leaves and peach blossoms. It was probably a dish using ingredients unique to the Chen Dynasty. Since she could eat the flavors of her Chen Dynasty homeland, Xiaoyu had no choice but to go!
1508932: Xiaoyu pulled the Starborn's hand and came over to check out the situation at Meimei House. The Starborn couldn't hide their surprise that her earlier analysis had hit the mark. Xiaoyu decided to name this "see one and know ten" skill --
1508933: Xiaoyu's tummy rumbled, her tail swayed back and forth, and her eyes sparkled brilliantly. It seemed Xiaoyu wanted the Starborn to take her out to eat something delicious~
1508934: Xiaoyu's self-analysis was spot on. Xiaoyu decided to name this "see one and know ten" skill --
1508935: Sitting cross-legged by the edge of Meltlake, Xiaoyu closed her eyes and focused her consciousness. As she circulated her magical power, a sudden warm sensation spread throughout her entire body. Could it be... she had grasped the profound mysteries of magical power?
1508936: Books say that getting too excited risks losing control over one's mind. Xiaoyu jumped into the lake, and after calming down, she confirmed that the previous sensation wasn't an illusion. Following these past few days of training, her "magical power" had undoubtedly been elevated to a brand-new realm!
1508937: Xiaoyu closed both eyes and devoted herself to training. The effects were monumental, successfully elevating her "magical power" to a new state!
1508938: Xiaoyu transformed back into her fox form and leaped into the Starborn's arms. Comforted by the Starborn, Xiaoyu's mood cleared up completely. Her "magical power" also seemed to have been elevated to a new state.
1508939: Finishing a day of training and walking through the streets of Fleece, Xiaoyu suddenly stopped in her tracks. Closing her eyes, she could clearly sense the "bonds" existing all around her. Those bonds intertwined among the passing people, connecting every corner of the town.
1508940: Had her "Matchmaking" ability leaped forward dramatically? Xiaoyu decided to find someone to test it out on.
1508941: Of course, it was tied just as firmly and securely as before... In fact, it felt like it could be seen slightly more clearly than before. Xiaoyu pondered -- once she found some free time, she'd come up with an amazing name for her "Matchmaking" ability worthy of a future divine fox fairy!
1508942: Xiaoyu pondered for a while... money was trivial compared to truly important things. Even if she didn't have much of a bond with Yun, it wasn't a big deal...
1508943: If her "Matchmaking" power had improved, maybe she could splurge a bit of Yun to buy Peach Blossom Cake and celebrate!
1508944: Even though Xiaoyu hadn't even unleashed her full power, she seemed to have realized that her bond with Peach Blossom Cake was destiny itself, and the two could never be separated...
1508945: Her "Matchmaking" power appeared to be steadily increasing. Let's immediately buy some Peach Blossom Cake to celebrate. By the way, cementing this good fortune wouldn't hurt either.
1508946: Standing by the edge of Meltlake, the thunderous roar of the waterfall echoed across heaven and earth, stirring a fierce wave of excitement in Xiaoyu's chest!
1508947: Right at that moment, Terara, the brave beastman hunter, was also honing her hunting skills nearby. She offered to impart a little trick to Xiaoyu on how to steel one's "courage" and encourage oneself.
1508948: Taking a deep breath, Terara let out a beastman-style howl toward the waterfall: "Awooo――!" The sound echoed long, momentarily drowning out even the roar of the waterfall.
1508949: Xiaoyu trained by mimicking her example. As she did, she felt heat surging within her body and power welling up. The moment that heat reached its peak, she mastered the "Fox Immortal Blasting Fist"!
1508950: Terara showed Xiaoyu beastman martial arts. Those fists were as powerful as a tiger's, looking utterly valiant!
1508951: Xiaoyu practiced by mimicking her example and felt strength surging forth. Riding the surge of overflowing emotion, she incorporated the ideas gained from her training thus far -- and finally forged the "Fox Immortal Blasting Fist"!
1508952: Terara explained this to Xiaoyu: Whether you are a divine fox or a beastman, in a pinch, you must never forget the ultimate secret technique carved into your genes—its name is Intimidation! Fluff up your tail fur and overwhelm your opponent with sheer momentum!
1508953: Jerry, troubled and distressed, came to visit Xiaoyu.
1508954: In the morning forest, he witnessed a truly beautiful sight. Dancing in the morning mist, that person's movements had a powerful resonance, and their flowing hair was cool and neatly arranged. Jerry fell in love at first sight...
1508955: Jerry tried to catch up and exchange words, but the beauty moved with swift, dance-like steps and vanished into the mist—
1508956: How could he meet her once more? How could he forge a bond with her? Jerry sought Xiaoyu's help...
1508959: Seeing the other's appearance, Jerry was momentarily dumbfounded, but immediately poured his passion into displaying his proudest dance.
1508960: Witnessing Jerry's dance, Ponyro paused for a moment before cheerfully beginning to dance along with the rhythm.
1508961: Perhaps "forging a bond" can also mean "Starlinking"...
1508962: Xiaoyu tried to use the power of "fate" to find Jerry's destined match, but for some reason, that match was nowhere to be found...
1508963: A gloomy Jerry walked away, dancing with sorrowful steps. Perhaps not every bond can be forged by relying on a celestial fox.
1508964: Xiaoyu followed the traces in the tall grass and reached the edge of a lake.—There, a flock of Ponyro was leisurely grazing on grass...
1508965: Thinking Jerry's crush hadn't been found, just as Xiaoyu was about to sigh... Jerry happily scampered over to the flock of Ponyro.
1508966: Spotting a particular Ponyro, Jerry's eyes lit up, and he passionately performed his specialty dance.
1508967: Seeing Jerry's dance, the Ponyro's eyes lit up, and it cheerfully began to dance to the rhythm.
1508968: Xiaoyu followed the traces left in the grass all the way to the lake—there, various Kibo were playing by the lakeshore: Ponyro, Bruda, Clodime, and Calabekko frolicking happily.
1508969: It seemed no traces of Jerry's intended "person" could be found. Jerry sorrowfully left the scene...
1508970: Only the sound of a Ponyro powerfully striking its hooves adorned Jerry's departing footsteps...
1508971: "Celestial Fox-sama!" a youthful voice called out to stop Xiaoyu.
1508972: It was that young girl from the banks of Melt Lake who had mistaken Xiaoyu for "Pudding." However, since Xiaoyu was now in human form, the girl naturally didn't recognize her.
1508973: The girl asked Xiaoyu for help. She said her grandmother, during her lifetime, was close to an extremely rare spirit fox Kibo of some sort; that Kibo would often visit their yard to sunbathe, play around, and share delicious scraps...
1508974: Ever since her grandmother passed away, that Kibo never showed its face again. The young girl was worried about whether the little one was doing well in the outside world and asked Xiaoyu to track down that Kibo.
1508975: Xiaoyu closed her eyes and sharpened her senses. A faint thread of fate stretched far into the distance, finally vanishing into the skies of Fleece. Xiaoyu couldn't understand the reason, but perhaps that Kibo had not yet left Fleece...
1508976: Xiaoyu closed her eyes and searched for the presence. A faint thread of fate stretched far into the distance, finally vanishing into the skies of Fleece. Regarding this matter, there seemed to be nothing Xiaoyu could do...
1508977: The girl recounted many happy memories shared between her grandmother and the Kibo. And on the day her grandmother breathed her last... facing her grandmother who would never wake up again, that Kibo had been bewildered, scratching at the ground over and over again with its tiny claws...

An artisan once happened to acquire a kingfisher. He fell deeply in love with the color of its feathers and cared for it meticulously. Its food and daily accessories were always superior to his own.
Those around him laughed and asked if he planned to use the emerald feathers as ornaments to sell at a high price. At first, he was puzzled, but eventually he began to doubt himself. He had no such intention, yet the remark lingered in his heart, leaving him uneasy. And so one day, having forgotten to latch the cage door, the kingfisher flew away on its own and never returned.
After the kingfisher was gone, a hollow void opened up in his heart, but at the same time, a sense of relief washed over him.
A few days later, while cleaning his room, he found two emerald feathers beneath his desk. Their color remained as vibrant as ever. The artisan fashioned them into a pair of earrings, turning them into a silent echo.
1510198: A greatsword. The blade is wide and long, and the spine is dull and thick. Yet when wielded, it feels weightless, emitting the sound of wind blowing through a long trail of clouds. 1510199:
A beautiful dress adorned throughout with ripple-like patterns.
It is said that truly powerful resonance begins as an echo. Yet how can one capture a formless sound? If the sight of grass swaying in the same direction in the wind can be called the shape of the wind, then a voice whispered at one's ear, turning into muffled resonances that ripple outward in layers—perhaps that image is the shape of sound. Thus, the young maiden, awaiting someone whose heart could resonate with hers, sketched the gently expanding ripple patterns and asked an artisan to bring them to life.
And so, this dress was tailored.

A Charlulu-style decorative facility. Can be placed in suitable areas within the farm.
The ox-head totem at the tip of the pillar is a symbol of diligence and unity, and also commemorates the beastman warrior 'Galey' who lived in the village a hundred moons ago.
At that time, Charlulu Village had just been established in Sprout Valley, and everything was in need of recovery. The brave and bold Galey frequently went out hunting and exchanged prey for other goods. Villagers followed Galey's example, gradually forming the custom of barter, allowing everyone to obtain food through their own strengths. Thus, Charlulu Village's food problem was solved, and it prospered day by day. This giant bonfire pillar came to be erected in the square where the villagers trade.

1517181:
[System Overview]
Welcome to the Kibo Factor Fruit system! By consuming Factor Fruit items, you can unlock more powerful Factors for your Kibo or replace existing ones.
To ensure a smooth experience, please read the basic rules below carefully.
[Rules]
1. Each Kibo can hold up to 8 Factors.
2. Each Kibo can hold at most 1 Flash Factor.
3. A Kibo's Innate Factor and Flash Factor cannot be replaced by feeding Factor Fruits.
4. A Kibo cannot hold two identical Factors.
5. Only after all Factors on a Kibo have been unlocked can you feed Factor Fruits to replace selected Factors.
1517182: "Bonds Carried on Peach Fragrance" Event Details
1517183: ◆Event Period◆ During the Journey Trace Test ◆Eligibility◆ Clear the quest "Guidance of the Wolf" ◆Gameplay Overview◆ Target Affinity Value — Tap the screen in a stage to have Xiaoyu toss her fan in the chosen direction. Collect various items to build up Affinity Value. Collecting Peach Blossom Talismans — Among the items are special "Peach Blossom Talismans." Gather them to unlock and read story scenes. Reach the stage's target Affinity Value and collect all Peach Blossom Talismans to clear the stage. ◆Event Content◆ This event features 6 stages. Over the first 3 days of the event, 2 new stages will unlock each day at 04:00.
1517185: ◆Event Info◆ A Peach Blossom Talisman has arrived from Qinghua Township—the day of the Foxfolk Clan's training trial is drawing near. Having neglected her training, Tushan Xiaoyu has lately struggled even to maintain her human form... At this critical moment, it falls upon the Starborn to train Xiaoyu and forge bonds so she can pass the trial! ◆Eligibility◆ Clear the quest "Looming Shadows" ◆Event Rules◆ During the event, Starborn will plan Tushan Xiaoyu's training across four stats—Mystic Power, Courage, Affinity, and Insight—to help her overcome serendipitous encounters and defeat the mastermind disrupting the bonds of Fleece's people. During training, Xiaoyu will learn various abilities that grant different effects in the trial's battles. Choose different training paths for Tushan Xiaoyu to unlock multiple endings and earn generous rewards. ◆Event Rewards◆ *Unlocking different endings in the event grants the version-exclusive Anima "Even Today, the Wind Is Calm" and Astral Gems. *Completing "Training Quests" in the event grants item rewards and "Starlight Shards." "Starlight Shards" can be exchanged for rich rewards at the "Starlight Exchange."

[Entry Requirements]
Unlocks after completing Main Story Commission "1-5 Prosperity of the People"

[Gameplay Overview]
In Crisis Subjugation, you can take on commission quests across various difficulty levels.
Performing activities such as field exploration, spending Primordial Tide, playing Kibo Fight, or completing production at the Farm has a chance to trigger Urgent Commissions with richer rewards.
Each player can trigger up to 2 Urgent Commissions per day, and each commission is time-limited. Be sure to share them with friends and team up to clear the challenge!

[Claiming Rewards]
Claiming rewards from regular commission quests and Urgent Commissions consumes Crystal Keystones and Radiant Crystal Keystones, respectively.
Crystal Keystones automatically regenerate by 5 every Monday, though automatic regeneration stops once you reach the storage cap.
Clearing Crisis Subjugation stage objectives or opening Crisis Subjugation chests grants Crystal Keystone Shards, which can be exchanged for rare rewards in the Crisis Subjugation Shop.

[Astral Chain]
In Multiplayer mode, after one team member inflicts Break on a boss, if other members trigger cooperative attacks within the time limit, an Astral Chain activates and deals massive damage to the boss.
During an Astral Chain, the boss's posture does not recover automatically. Once all members complete the Astral Chain or time runs out, an additional chain effect triggers based on the number of participating members.

1518709:
...
Since the dawn of creation, we have walked this land alongside the Aura of all things. Aura and all living beings have remained connected beside the mountains and rivers, in the breath of grass and trees, and in the currents of the wind, continually exchanging hearts and voices.
At the threshold between the ethereal and the material, shamans serve as guides for all rituals concerning Aura. Through their own power, they transcend the boundaries between the tangible and the intangible, self and other—opening a path for life and nature to commune, allowing "the Ethereal" and "the Material" to shape one another.
Shamans are the conduit between Aura and life. They convey the prayers and wishes of their kin to the will of Aura, sense the secrets and power of life with their souls, deliver prophecies, heal illnesses, and soothe hearts... Thus fulfilling their duty as "the Wise," they safeguard the unbroken continuity of life and nature.
Even now, we continue to walk this earth with Aura.

Duties of a Shaman
1. Perform regular rituals to honor the ancestors and channel the will of the Spirits.
2. Aid kin in communing with Aura and offer prayers.
3. Heal the illnesses of kin and banish their suffering.
4. Guide lost souls back to their rightful state, soothe hearts, and dispel malice.
5. Preserve and pass on the lives of our kin.
1518710: "On the Elemental Principles Cycling Through the World"
1518712:
We live in the world of "the Material." Yet, the arcane is never far away. For instance, just last night or the night before, prayers to Tana were surely offered somewhere across this land. The prayers of our ancestors live on as everyday charms and spells... Yet these can never reach the true realm. The elements are the root of all things and the very force that moves the world. As ever-flowing energy, the elements are in constant flux. In the world of tangible forms, the elements flow, cycle, and interact, breaking the stillness of life and shaping the laws that govern the world.

Through communion with nature, souls, and the Spirits, we have come to sense the elements of Water, Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning, Wind, and Grass. Though silent, trees and grass resist the raging winds with their branches, leaves, and roots; yet they cannot withstand harsh ice and snow or flames that sweep the fields. The earth supports all things, and distant mountains and hills swallow oncoming lightning and wildfires without faltering, yet they struggle against tempests and floods. Fierce gales stir soil into dust, while floods drench earth into mud. Raging fire melts ice, and the meltwater extinguishes the flame... Such phenomena are proof that nature holds the wisdom to maintain balance through the contact, fusion, separation, and destruction of the elements, generously revealing its mysteries.

As for Light and Dark, they are thought to be organic forces distinct from these seven elements—two opposing halves of a single whole, continually poured down from the heavens.

In the natural world, there also exist beings that neither originate from any known element nor hold a weakness to any known element. Thus, we have classified these under the "Null" element. Perhaps one day, we will uncover the source of their power and lift the veil of mystery.

In traditional Beastkin faith, Ulu is a symbol of "courage and strength," while Tana is the embodiment of "soul and spirit." Ulu's majesty drives away all darkness, and Tana's radiance saves every lost soul. Long ago, in an age when the world was swallowed by chaos and the land lay in ruin, our ancestors gathered their kin on nights when Tana was full and held grand feasts.
There, they drew strength, healed their hearts, kindled their courage, and purified their souls. The Tana Fire Festival unites the faith and will of our kin as one. Supporting one another in this way, our ancestors endured the darkest and harshest of eras. And even today, unchanged, we see Aura's guidance within Tana's radiance and draw strength from it.

1518716:
Long ago, a pack of wolves roamed freely across this land. The Great Wolf was mighty and filled with majesty, so much so that even the sun feared its power. Seeking to make the wolves bow their heads and wander in darkness, the marauding beasts scorched the grasslands with searing flames, robbing the forest creatures of their home. Taking its young in its jaws, the Great Wolf leaped over the roaring blaze and raced toward the south.
Leading the pack for seven days and seven nights, it broke through darkness raging with wind and thunder, finally reaching this tranquil valley. Surveying the land, it found our ancestors, who were likewise suffering at the hands of the marauding beasts, and spoke in a voice full of compassion: "I fear neither light nor flame. I shall climb the highest mountain peak and guard this land. So long as the wolves live here alongside you, darkness shall never fall again."
From that day on, the wolf pack lived beside our ancestors, and the Great Wolf protected this land with its majesty and divine power. When Sunya of Death rode in on the frigid winds of the endless river of the underworld, luring small souls to spirit them away to the other world, the Great Wolf had our ancestors gather the bones of their kin, shut themselves indoors, and strictly forbade them from ever stepping outside on dark nights of Tana.
Our ancestors waited in the darkness. Then, a howl echoed from afar, and the light of a full Tana illuminated the valley. Cornered with nowhere to flee, Sunya of Death was torn apart by the Great Wolf's sharp claws and fangs. Then, the Great Wolf leaped high into the air and stood atop Tana. One of its eyes became a star, and as its breath blew away the clouds, it vanished from sight.
1518718: There are roughly twenty Kibo species with confirmed evolutionary lines currently recorded in Sprout Valley. However, during fieldwork, an extraordinarily unusual individual was discovered. Judging by its appearance, behavior, power system, and the byproducts of its activity, it can be classified into a known species, yet it is not recorded anywhere within that species' evolutionary lineage. Below are the conclusions drawn from long-term tracking and investigation. # Possesses Immense Power, High Intelligence, and Self-Awareness This special individual possesses a physique and intellect far surpassing Kibo of the same species. During observation, it exhibited unique abilities absent in others of its kind, even going so far as to alter the surrounding environment and climate. It would not be an exaggeration to call this "godlike" power. Furthermore, it demonstrates clear self-awareness and distinct emotional shifts, suggesting it may even be capable of communicating with sapient races. # Acts as a Leader Figure Among Its Kind, Yet Does Not Always Command the Pack Long-term observation revealed that Kibo of the same species behave submissively toward this special individual and treat it with reverence. While it appears to hold a position akin to a pack leader, it shows no consistent tendency to actively command others of its kind in daily life. # Only One Special Individual Exists per Species During the investigation, activity from a special individual of a different species was also confirmed alongside our primary research subject. Such special individuals are exceedingly rare, and it appears that, as a rule, only one exists per species. # Does Not Arise Through Standard Evolution How these special individuals come into being remains unknown. Because normal Kibo evolution never manifests such hyper-adaptive growth, it is unlikely they arise through gradual evolution from a juvenile stage. Further detailed research is necessary, though compounding factors make conducting such an investigation unfeasible at the present stage.
1518719:
(1)
Uncle Adaiya has been coughing nonstop lately. He said the number of Mofunga in the village suddenly spiked, and with so many Kibo to look after, he overworked himself and fell sick.
My big sister told me, "Starting tomorrow, go help out at the beast pens." She said I have to take care of the Kibo in Uncle Adaiya's place.
Hmm... sounds like kind of a hassle.

(2)
Mofunga are actually pretty cute.
When I went to check on Uncle Adaiya today, he ended up leaving a Mofunga in my care. He asked me to look after it until he gets better.
Its eyes are big and round, and the fluffy fur around its neck feels soft yet cool to the touch... Is this what touching snow feels like? Not that I've ever seen snow.
Uncle Adaiya told me to give it a name.
For a second, I thought about calling it "Snokke," but that sounded kinda lame, so I went with "Snowga" instead.
Starting today, I'm Snowga's caretaker. Hopefully it won't be too much trouble.

(3)
I caught Snowga making a breeze with its tail...
Today, I tried taking a nap somewhere quiet, but it was way too hot to sleep.
As I tossed and turned, a cool breeze suddenly blew over me. When I opened my eyes, there was Snowga, wagging its tail fast to fan me... It felt so nice that I fell sound asleep right there.
Taking care of Snowga might not be so bad after all.

(4)
I'm beat today. Snowga has way too much energy... It ran around and knocked over a Cabard's nest, and instead of fetching the stick I threw, it brought back a Yuranago in its mouth...
I can't anymore. Too tired to write.

(5)
I brought some other Kibo from the village to play with Snowga, thinking I could finally get some rest... Then the moment I looked away, they all ran off. While Uncle Adaiya and I were searching for them, a wild Shunerf showed up... Even though Snowga was injured, it tried to protect everyone. When the Shunerf charged at me, Snowga pounced in and shielded me...
Uncle Adaiya went to (...) for (...) treatment. I hope (...) gets better soon. I'm sorry, and thank you...
(*The final paragraph is smudged with water and illegible.)

(6)
My sister asked if I wanted to "Starlink" with Snowga, like Terara and Ulu. I told her "no."
I'm not interested in fighting, and I have my own way of living.
"Starlink" is important and all, but even without a bond like that, Snowga is still my precious friend.
1518721: To the Goddess of the Forest, Tomorrow is finally Charlulu Village's Scare Festival! We're throwing a grand feast in the village square at night, so please come if you can! Uncle Ruta and Grandma Ruma have prepared heaps of food and drinks. Everyone will eat until they're stuffed, sing and dance around the bonfires, boost each other's courage, and honor the bravery of our ancestors. On this day, villagers put on scary masks, hide along both sides of the paths, and jump out in front of passersby. It's a custom meant to forge everyone's willpower so we can face fear head-on. If you do visit, Goddess, you might run into a masked villager or two. Please don't be startled! None of us would ever mean any disrespect to you! Reply Thank you for such a thoughtful invitation. I have heard of the Scare Festival's traditions before. A custom where you train and encourage one another sounds truly intriguing and heartwarming. Much to my regret, I have an important duty that prevents me from leaving the forest. Though I cannot attend in person, may the winds sweeping through the woods and the green leaves carry my blessings to you all.
1518723: To My Friend Soaring the Skies, I know we promised to go thank the one who delivered the letter together, but the Starborn seems really busy lately, so it might be a little while before we can meet. Oh, right! A whole bunch of Chishiki Palms were growing in the woods on the edge of the village, so I picked tons of Chishiki and dried the seeds. If you take them back and plant them along the cliff's edge, you might get even better-quality Chishiki by next moon. Then everyone at Windveil Crag could hold a Chishiki Festival without worrying about how much grows up on the cliffs! I heard from the villagers... Apparently, folks spotted a black-and-white shadow in the sky recently. Could that have been your "Hawkmaster," Falanta? To think someone like her would come all the way to Charlulu Village! The village chief has been acting kind of sneaky lately, too, scouting around inside and outside the village for land good for farming... though he won't tell anyone what it's for. 1518725: Introduction Lately, I have been receiving more and more questions regarding "how to Starlink with a Kibo." To spread this knowledge across all circles and foster deeper interaction between sapient races and Kibo, I have compiled this guide. It is my hope that this manual will serve as the foundation for a more harmonious and wholesome Starlink. *Note: This document is an internal review draft and not the official release. Starlink Procedure The essence of Starlink lies in forging a spiritual connection with a Kibo through the power of Starveins. To achieve this, one must follow the steps below. 1. Make Contact Contact is the prerequisite for building a connection and the foundation of every Starlink. Whether it is a long-standing acquaintance or a brief chance encounter on a journey, it makes no difference. When a bond is meant to be forged, even a fleeting, wordless passing can spark a Starlink. Therefore, if you spot a Kibo you wish to Starlink with, yet share no prior history and know nothing of each other, why not challenge the Kibo to a "duel"! The author believes this is an effective way to close the distance with a Kibo. There are some things you only come to understand through battle. 2. Prove Your Strength Once Starlinked, a Kibo becomes a companion who fights alongside you. The wiser and stronger the Kibo, the more likely it is to Starlink only with someone it acknowledges. Approachability, wit, or might—any of these can earn recognition. In the author's opinion, displaying overwhelming strength is the most efficient method. To quickly demonstrate your dependability, why not challenge the Kibo to a "duel"! 3. Complete the Starlink When you and a Kibo acknowledge one another and resonate, the power of Starveins enables the Starlink state. At this stage, to complete the "Starlink," you must deepen your connection using a medium composed of Starvein energy. Bonds are mysterious things; even when a connection forms and mutual recognition is achieved between a sapient individual and a Kibo, a Starlink is not guaranteed to succeed every time. The timing, location, or purity of the medium may simply be off. Yet, the author firmly believes that perseverance can overcome any mountain. There is no need to feel discouraged if a Starlink fails. Simply wait a moment, and challenge the Kibo to a "duel" once more! Reviewer's Note: The steps themselves are fine, but why do you keep telling people to "duel" them, ribbit?! Make sure you fix that wording before the official public release! Always keep in mind that Kibo are precious companions, ribbit!
1518726: General RulesAs one of Charlulu Village's most important communal events, the Martial Tournament exists for participants to showcase their strength and learn combat techniques from one another. The tournament is held for 5 days once every 3 moons. During this period, competitors determine victory through one-on-one bouts; winners advance while losers are eliminated. The tournament continues until a single victor remains. Venue The village training grounds serve as the designated venue for the Martial Tournament. Divisions Competitors are divided into three brackets: the "Champion Division," the "Valor Division," and the "Challenger Division." Entry to the Valor and Challenger Divisions is open to all, and competitors may choose a division suited to their own skill level. Competitors for the Champion Division are selected based on the following two criteria: - Any previous division champion who enters again is automatically placed in the Champion Division. - Those with notable achievements who are endorsed or recommended by villagers are placed in the Champion Division. Rules 1. Combat by any means is permitted, though the use of tools or items is prohibited. 2. A competitor is declared victorious when their opponent is rendered unable to fight (as judged by the referee), surrenders, or forfeits. 3. Anyone who kills an opponent, severs a limb, or intentionally inflicts severe injury during a match shall be permanently banned from competing (though the result of that match remains valid). Championship The final victor of the Champion Division is granted the title of "Beast War King" along with the authority to manage the entire village's hunting quotas for the following 2 moons. To date, Charlulu Village has hosted 76 Martial Tournaments. The glorious records of every past "Beast War King" are preserved in the village chronicles. Anyone wishing to prove their might, test their limits, and stand alongside legendary heroes of old—such as "Fierce Titan Tiger," "Night-Prowling Shadow Wolf," and "Iron Bulwark"—sign up now! — Charlulu Village Martial Tournament Committee What about "Rampaging Mad Lion"? That guy was crazy strong in a fight, wasn't he? He was permanently banned and exiled from the village. Don't bring up that troublemaker.

1518737: Those Who Lit an Undying Flame in the Dark NightThe primordial beast of plunder, Farman Chacha, brought about the endless "Calamity of the Dark Night." Climbing to a high mountain peak, Farman Chacha devoured Uru and cloaked the land in darkness. Within that darkness, the beasts of plunder grew ever stronger. Unless Farman Chacha was defeated and forced to cough up Uru, light would never return to the land. Yet in the dark, the Beastfolk lost their way, unable to locate Farman Chacha and suffering grievous wounds from the ambushes of the beasts of plunder. To save them, the Taurik gathered and kindled an inextinguishable flame, illuminating the night like broad daylight and marking the path forward with their fire. However, the beasts of plunder used those flames as beacons and descended upon the Taurik. One by one, the Taurik fell into the darkness, torn apart by the beasts of plunder. The flames atop their heads flickered, and the once-dependable herd of Taurik dwindled to only a few faint sparks. Even so, they refused to retreat. The last Taurik led its companions to the summit, defeated Farman Chacha with its own flame, and vanished as a tiny ember. All that remained of the Taurik herd was a single young Momo. Defeated, Farman Chacha spat Uru back out before fleeing. Yet Uru's power had already been drained dry, leaving behind nothing more than a blackened, hollow shell devoid of strength. The last surviving Momo slipped inside Uru and reignited its fire with its own faint flame. The fallen Taurik also rose as Aura and ascended toward Uru. Thus, light returned to the land once more. Those Who Made Their Bodies a Levee Amid the Waters of the DeadEven in defeat, the wicked beast of plunder Farman Chacha refused to abandon its desire to destroy the earth. Next, Farman Chacha unleashed the "Calamity of the Flood" upon the land. Colossal floodwaters surged with ferocious force, swallowing the earth whole. At first, the water-loving Biliber rejoiced—until they tasted the salt mixed into the current. It was the tears of Beastfolk who had lost their families to the flood. Despising that bitter taste and aching for the Beastfolk's suffering, the Biliber began building levees alongside them. Yet the flood was far fiercer than they had imagined; no matter how tirelessly the Biliber gnawed wood to reinforce the barriers, ever-larger waves crashed over them. Amid the chaos, one Biliber dove beneath the surface and discovered the source of the flood—a massive chasm torn open deep underground by Farman Chacha's jaws. Because the boundary between the surface world of the living and the subterranean world of the dead had been ripped apart, all the waters of "Puche" were pouring through. The waters of the dead would swallow every living creature and eventually reduce the surface to a barren void. Mere wood and stone could never plug that abyss. Mastiva led the Biliber and Waver into the depths, using their own bodies to seal the breach. It was their greatest architectural masterpiece, and a testament to their unity. Once the hole was sealed and the waters of the dead ceased flowing upward, Uru evaporated the excess floodwaters, restoring the boundary between land and river. The levees built by the Biliber still towered above the earth—but the Biliber themselves were nowhere to be seen. The One Who Brought Blossoms to the Path of PermafrostLong ago, the land followed the natural cycle of the Season of Splendor and the Season of Plenty. Plants slept beneath the earth during the Season of Plenty, sprouted and bloomed in the Season of Splendor, and bore fruit to fill the land in the Season of Splendor that followed. Yet Farman Chacha brought forth the "Calamity of the Permafrost," breathing thick, unmelting ice across the world. Terrified of the bitter chill, the plants retreated deep underground and refused to sprout again. Thus, the Season of Splendor came no more. Sozanka asked the Spirits, "How can we shatter this ice and bring back warm days?" The Spirits answered, "Only the power of sprouting can break the ice." Sozanka spoke to the plants, only to be met with silence. Just then, a mischievous Kroneck let out a cry. The Kroneck told Sozanka that the plants were not refusing to sprout—they had simply lost their strength from being trapped beneath the ice for so long. The Kroneck shared its own power with the deeply buried seeds, speaking gently to comfort them. At last, the seeds regained their strength, trembling as they broke through the soil and pushed the ice apart. Then the Kroneck set out along the endless road of permafrost with Leafo and Flatail at its side. They spoke kindly to every plant they saw, sharing their own strength so the plants could find the power and courage to break through the earth once more. Little by little, the ice shattered, though the Kroneck and its companions grew weaker and weaker. Even so, they kept encouraging the plants until the very last seed sprouted. When the Season of Splendor finally returned, the land breathed once more with gentle breezes. The Kroneck and its flock lay down upon the soft meadow and drifted into eternal slumber, content smiles resting on their lips.

1518739: In Search of a Lost Tribe...So far, I've left my footprints across deserts, vast seas, snowcapped peaks, and oases. I've seen cities formed by chains of islands and breathtaking vistas suspended in the sky—the beautiful yet perilous Eclipse of the Calamity Tide. I've even beheld Yggdrasil piercing the heavens in the deep woodland paradise where the elves dwell. Now that was truly magnificent. Countless Azdran danced among Yggdrasil's colossal, pale-blue branches, and even the clouds seemed to fade beside that towering tree. According to the elven Grand Sage, Yggdrasil's branches pierce the sky while its roots stretch across the entire world. Gatherer of all wisdom under heaven and earth, the great tree stands as a symbol of wisdom, knowledge, and omniscience. As he spoke, I sipped a Wood Elf beverage. Suspicious of elven taste buds over a nectar sweet enough to dissolve my teeth—and genuinely worried for their dental health—I offered a polite smile and nodded along as the moment required. Even so, I have no intention of boasting that I've "unlocked every secret of this world." My adventure isn't over yet. So when the tavern keeper earnestly asked, "Aren't you going to take a break?" I answered with a rare, serious look on my face. "An adventurer's life lies along the road beneath their feet. When the road ends and new sights cease to meet their eyes, their life naturally ends as well. I still want to live." But he shook his head and said: "Moving forward isn't the only way to keep living. You've traveled so far and seen countless souls, yet you still don't get it? When you find the place where you're meant to put down roots, your feet will stop on their own." Then he brought out plates of steaming food. I recognized several of the dishes—Windfeel Pie, Honey Harvest, and Blissful Pumpkin Bread. All of them were specialties of Fleece. Fleece was his homeland, and he proudly declared that even after being away for so long, the taste of home he cooked hadn't changed one bit. That seemed like a bit of a stretch to me. Even with the same recipe, ingredients from Reve taste vastly different from those in Fleece due to the climate. Still, touched by the warmth of the steaming meal, I held back any rebuttal, murmured "You're right," and took a bite. His words gave me a chance to reflect on myself. I had always traveled in search of something new, never once looking back at the paths I'd already walked... That was right when an old friend from my past adventures sent me word. A Beastfolk tribe that had barely survived the aftermath of the Empire's rule had set out on a journey in search of their "homeland." They still preserved the oldest Beastfolk faith in "Sozanka and the Spirits," had a Shaman among their ranks, and had even inherited rituals to commune with the Guardians of the Starveins—rituals long thought lost. I'd lived alone for a long time... If I could find them, perhaps I could come to better understand my own past and the history etched into my bloodline. I packed through the night and set out in search of my kin alongside my partner, a young Grago. My chest swelled with that familiar thrill before every journey. My blood raced, brimming with anticipation, no different from any adventure before. After finding my kin, I joined their journey, fought shoulder to shoulder with them, overcame countless hardships together, and at last came to a halt in a certain valley. Looking out over this rich, beautiful land and the few companions remaining at my side, the tavern keeper's words kept echoing in my mind for some reason: "When you find the place where you're meant to put down roots, your feet will stop on their own."

1518752:
Procedures for Worshipping the Dragon King

On the day before the rite, participants must bathe before sunset and change into clean garments.
Priests shall verify the quantity and variety of offerings, which include grain, meat, Starluster Ore, and the like.
On the day of the rite, participants shall gather before dawn. All must wear plain robes and go barefoot, carrying no weapons or superfluous items. Designated bearers shall carry the offerings.
The procession shall be ordered by age and status, with the elderly and children at the front, and youths and able-bodied adults in the rear.
Along the way, speaking, looking back, and leaving the procession are forbidden. When passing roadside carvings or ancient steles, all must halt and bow their heads in reverence.
Upon reaching the temple's outer courtyard, first form ranks outside the gate. After the priests re-verify the offerings, they shall lead everyone inside.
Upon entering, all shall prostrate themselves three times toward the throne. The priests shall recite the prayer, and participants shall present their offerings of grain, meat, Starluster Ore, and the like in turn.
Once the offerings have been arranged, all must wait in silence until the Dragon King announces the conclusion of the rite. Standing up or looking directly at the throne is strictly forbidden.

From beyond the distant mountains we come,
Following cleft rock, ancient steps, and echoing paths.
Arriving here, we lay down our arms, hush our words, and bow our heads.

The wind sweeps across the heights,
And echoes fade into the surrounding walls.
Only the oath of fealty
Neither scatters in the wind nor sinks beneath the waters,
Enduring even longer than eternity.

Some offer flame and withdraw,
Some raise their voices in unison and prostrate themselves.
Pilgrims seek no answers,
Wishing only for the dragon's shadow to descend.

Should you ever reach this land,
Forget not to bow your head.
Not out of fear,
But because here, all things return to their rightful place.
