These Gold-Silver Full Cups are super tasty treats, you know. Soft skin, sweet filling—once you start reaching for one after another, you just can't stop. Still, always begging... ahem, asking Izumi to make them would ruin a master's dignity. So Ponpon decided to learn how to make them myself! That way, I can eat them anytime, anywhere!
At first, Izumi tried to stop Ponpon, saying, 'Nobody except the chefs is allowed in the kitchen,' but when I convinced Izumi it was 'training,' I got a sigh and permission to go in. Hmph! Izumi must have recognized Ponpon's dedication to martial arts!
I've enclosed the Gold-Silver Full Cups Ponpon made in this letter—listen up, Ponpon rolled them with these very paws!
1520538:
I've got something to tell you today!
You know how lots of people come to the peach grove to make wishes, right? Today, a girl came by to make one!
She was plucking peach petals while murmuring, 'Please tell me. Should I... tell him how I feel...?' And right as she said, 'I should tell him,' she plucked the very last petal. Looking a little shy—yet so, so happy—she hopped up and ran off.
You know, peach blossoms always have five petals—everyone knows that from the start, right? That means the choice you make when you start counting is what really matters! In other words, what she truly wished for wasn't getting an answer—it was already sleeping deep in her heart all along.
Little moments like this that happen every day give me so many unforgettable feelings. I wanted to share this feeling with you too, so I couldn't help writing you a letter.
If anything fun happens around you lately, write back and tell me about it, okay? I'll be looking forward to your reply!
1520541:
Before leaving Rothlansa on my mission, I had scarcely met any other races—I barely even knew our distant kin among the elves, and held many misconceptions.
However, after recently taking on a request from an Avarian caravan, I realized that High Elves are no different from us at all. They too can be captivated by beautiful flowers, and troubled by attacks from ferocious Kibo... They're just like us.
Perhaps we and humans, beastkin, and oni aren't as different as we thought... Maybe there's a real possibility of that, don't you think?
1520542:
After waking up as usual today, I went outside with my fawn to enjoy the crisp air scented with earth. All the trees in the forest are thriving, and the Kibo are full of life. Sometimes their fur gets dirty while they're roughhousing together—but I wiped them clean, so there's nothing to worry about.
As thanks, they gave me lots of fresh fruit. I tried brewing some tea with it today... Would you be interested in trying a new blend? I'd be delighted if it suits your taste.
1520543:
This morning, Abby nom-nommed a big roasted meat. Sizzling sauce was super yummy.
After nom-nomming, still smell roasted meat and sauce, all the time.
Smell nothing else! Like roasted meat is right under nose, but nowhere to find.
Is Abby sick? Scary...
1520544:
Today I hunted three Boaragas and a pretty decent-sized Salamand! Guess how I pulled it off? Hehe, I leaped straight into the air, of course, and let loose with my spear—whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! It was so cool I almost clapped for myself!
I'd saved the best cut of meat to grill up and share with you, but when I started roasting it, it smelled so amazing that I couldn't help... well, sneaking just one little bite! (Seriously, just one bite!)
Next time I'll catch an even bigger one to make up for it. That's a promise from Charlulu Village's strongest hunter!
1520545:
Dances are indispensable to Charlulu Village's rituals. Physical balance reflects spiritual harmony, and tranquil energy can draw in aura. That's why a shaman's dance must be powerful yet completely natural and balanced—it demands tremendous stamina.
You are so strong, Starborn, and even your movements in battle are graceful... I've been feeling for a while that you might be well-suited to dance in our rituals! Lately I haven't been able to get this thought out of my head, so I went ahead and wrote you this letter... If you'd like, would you dance with me at the next festival?
1520546:
The winds lately haven't been bad. They're not much help for flying, though they're just right for shooting a bow.
Yesterday I tried tweaking the fletching on my arrows, and now there's less air resistance when I loose them, plus the sound seems quieter than before. So... I got to thinking. Maybe they'd come in handy for night hunting.
Next time you come to Windhide Rock, I might just give you a quick look at the new arrows. Just a look, mind you! I'm not giving them away! Well... I mean, if you really like them, I guess you can try shooting one.
That's all I had to say! Don't go expecting me to write you letters all the time. I just happened to have some free time today!
...If you've also got time to kill and feel like writing, though, I suppose I can accept a reply.
1520547:
I guess more isn't always better after all...
When I headed out today, I packed a whole bunch of Youthberries to eat if I got tired. Only, I brought way too many, so during training I crushed a bunch of them and got juice all over my clothes... I had no choice but to cut my plans short and head home to wash up.
Before writing this letter, I reflected on it in front of my ancestors' wood carvings... Next time I go out with you, I promise—really, truly promise—that nothing like that will ever happen again!
1520549:
Greetings.
Have you seen the Colorful Parade Troupe's latest performance yet? I heard it's become quite the talk among the citizens of Fleece, so it's piqued my interest as well.
Unfortunately, I've been swamped with official duties lately and haven't been able to spare the time to attend, much as I'd like to. That's why I wanted to hear from someone I can trust. Could you tell me—was there anything noteworthy about the stage, the performers, or the music? Who designed the stage lighting? What do the turnout and box-office projections look like? And if one were to buy out the entire troupe, do you think a cash transaction would seal the deal?
I await your reply.
1520552:
I offer you my greetings.
As you well know, Starborn, we Pegasus Knights have had a close affinity with water since ancient times. For Roire's sake as well, I often perform purification rites at springs, so one could say I am particularly well-versed in such matters.
Recently, I learned that humans also have many ways of bathing—from simple showers, to the herbal baths unique to the Chen Dynasty, to saunas said to toughen the body and hone one's willpower...
What method of bathing do you prefer, Starborn? I would like to prepare in advance, just in case the occasion arises.
1520553:
Starborn, how have you been faring?
Thanks to you, I had the chance to lay eyes upon an unusual contraption built by the earthbound folk called an 'airship.' Though they lack wings like us Wingfolk to ride the wind and soar through the skies, their yearning for the heavens led them to create such a wondrous vessel... It is truly remarkable.
Though Pamora doesn't seem very fond of this contraption.
1520554:
Lately, Nono is always sleepy. All the weather's fault.
In dreams, Nono found lots of shiny, sparkly places.
After waking up, wrote everything down so wouldn't forget.
Next time, you come too, Starborn? All of us, the whole expedition team.
1520556:
I've been slapped with a grounding order!
And of all times, right when I can't even use the secret passage! Earlier, when I was running firework experiments in there, I accidentally mismeasured the gunpowder and packed just a tiny bit too much...
Anyway, the passage is out of commission for a while, so right now I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place—starving and freezing, with every single day dragging on like a whole month! You're the only one left who can rescue me! Come right now!
1520558:
I got out way sooner than expected the other day! That's all thanks to you putting in a good word for me in front of my relatives. You saved my skin—thank you!
Now then, this genius mechanist will never make the same mistake twice. This time I'm planning to build a decoy automaton... except I still haven't solved the issue with the all-important power core...
Hey, what if you just hid out of sight and pulled the strings on this contraption yourself?
1520559:
Hey, I just heard something amazing!
Apparently, the largest stone-built mechanical ruins in history were just discovered in the canyon! They're powered by flowing water, and the hidden darts and traps inside are supposedly still active to this day...
Aren't you dying to know how they work? Bet you're itching to go investigate them with a skilled, reliable mechanist, right? Let's split the loot thirty-seventy! Come on, there's zero problem with that, right?!
1520560:
Hey there! Remember that automaton we designed and finished together the other day? After that, I upgraded it a ton—it's evolved so much you wouldn't even recognize it compared to before.
To commemorate your contribution, I even went out of my way to paint your portrait on the back of its head! You're gonna be moved to tears when you see it!
1520561:
This time, I asked a friendly merchant guild to get me some super wonderful firework materials that my family would never let me use at home! Tonight, same time, same place, I'm going to show you the finest fireworks you've ever laid eyes on! A Jinghua Cape debut, from the prime spot I set up just for you—and this genius mechanist will be right beside you explaining the design philosophy!
By the way, are you really sure I can't draw a portrait with fireworks? My artistic skills haven't gotten rusty at all, you know...
1520563:
Heh-heh!
You should feel honored! This is a letter written personally by Ponpon—super rookie of the Chen Dynasty martial arts world, founder of Pon-Style Jeet Kune Do, hope of the Pammies, wanderer of Jinghua Cape, and renowned gourmet of Jiyi Pavilion!
Bet you're super moved to have met the future number-one kung fu master under heaven—namely, Ponpon!
You'd better hang onto this autograph! I'll even throw in a master's claw mark as a bonus. Show some respect and treasure it!
1520564:
I'm writing today for one reason only: seeing you come in and out of Jiyi Pavilion so many times without ever properly savoring the food made this 'gourmet' Ponpon feel super disappointed!
As an undisputed 'gourmet,' let me recommend Jiyi Pavilion's signature dish, 'Heavenly White Jade.' You'd never figure it out if Ponpon didn't tell you... it's actually shrimp stir-fried together with tea leaves! One bite and you'll be blown away!
Listen up. This time, Ponpon was invited as a VIP guest. Next time you stop by, just drop Ponpon's name and you'll get a 'dish-count'!
1520565:
I've got big news today! Recognizing your hard work, this master is making a special exception and appointing you as Ponpon's partner!
Your techniques still need plenty of polishing, but if you learn from Ponpon, you're sure to improve in no time. Before long, we'll even be pulling off heart-pounding combo moves!
When that time comes, I'll nominate Peipei as your opponent for your promotion exam!
If you beat Peipei, I'll throw you a victory banquet at Jiyi Pavilion. And even if you lose, I'll cheer you up with Jiyi Pavilion's finest dishes!
1520567:
How was your day today? Ponpon's was super fulfilling, because I was doing grueling training the whole time. You know how it is—as the future number one under heaven, I can't afford to rest for even a second!
First thing after waking up, I meditated on the roof to absorb the essence of heaven and earth, and learned proper wing-flapping form from the birds.
Then, at a street stall, I found a book called 'Martial Arts for Dummies: Even a Peach Jelly Could Learn It!' The contents were pretty basic, but reading it carefully actually taught me a thing or two, so I'll let you take a look at it too since you're Ponpon's partner!
At night, I even sparred with Tangjiu on an empty street to test if my skills had improved. Lately I've been sneaking snacks every day and my belly's gotten nice and round! Though for some reason, while we were sparring, a whole crowd of onlookers started gathering around us...
1520568:
They say reaching the pinnacle of martial arts requires tempering the mind. Even this master might be hitting a wall with that mental training right now.
The other day, when some bad guys came to Jiyi Pavilion and caused a commotion, Ponpon and Tangjiu tried to rush in, but Izumi stopped us... and then Izumi swiftly took care of them using nothing but bare fists and kicks.
If I'm going to become number one under heaven, I ought to stand in front of everyone and sweep away all danger, right? Why did Ponpon just stand there in the back, unable to do anything...?
1520570:
Ever since I met you, I just haven't been able to stop thinking about you. I mulled it over a bunch, and figured I'd start by writing you a letter! You know, the reason you stood out to me so much back then was because I felt a special bond of fate between us! I'm sure the story of the two of us still has plenty more to come. You look forward to it too, okay?
Oh, and I'm great at sorting out troubles tied to fate and bonds, so if you ever run into any trouble, feel free to come talk to me anytime!
1520571:
More and more people have been coming to the Peach Blossom Grove to make wishes lately. I know it's my duty to watch over mortal ties, but things have been so hectic recently that I haven't even had a moment to rest... When you have some free time, could you come give me a hand?
Granny Fox says I'm 'naturally prone to getting tangled up in karma,' though really I'm just a tiny bit more curious than most and can't help wandering over whenever I hear a good rumor... Yet somehow I always end up right in the thick of it.
Still, it's not all bad! I get to hear tons of little-known rumors and stories... Next time we meet, I'll tell you two of my absolute favorites!
1520572:
Hey, have you tried the new sweets from Jiyi Pavilion yet? They're seriously, seriously divine! No, wait—I should say they're 'so good it'll knock your socks off'!
A long, long time ago, I felt the exact same way. It was right after I first arrived in Jinghua, the very first time I ever tasted mortal sweets. Back then, I was completely blown away. Nowadays, though, eating sweets is just part of my daily routine, so it's rare for anything to move me like that.
Since you're always out adventuring everywhere, Wanderer, you must come across all sorts of rare treats, right? When I think about it like that... becoming partners to explore the world together is truly a wonderful twist of fate!
1520573:
Back when I lived in Qinghua, I used to flip through books that drifted in from the outside world and picture what mortal life was like from the stories inside. Every time I read a sad tale, I'd wish over and over that I could step right into the story, clear up everyone's lingering grudges and misunderstandings, and change the tragic ending... That feeling is probably what led me to get involved with the mortal world in the first place.
Even now, sad stories still make me cry, but the time I've spent with you has given me courage, confidence, and the strength to turn sorrow around—so now I can say it for sure. This journey of ours is definitely going to have a happy ending!
1520574:
At the next Celestial Blossom Festival, let's write peach-blossom charms together under the tree, okay? As for what that 'special bond' I felt back then really was... I already know my answer. If I were to write on a charm with my own hand, your name would definitely be on it. Whether that means what you think it means—I'll tell you in person when we meet.
Oh, and last time I told you about a story I didn't like, so this time I'm bringing my absolute favorite books! Don't worry, they're all heartwarming tales where everyone gets a happy ending! Maybe you and I could even try acting out a few scenes from them, or something... Anyway! I'll tell you all the details when we see each other!
1520575: Today I saw a very curious dish in the dining hall, and it has been on my mind ever since... It looked just like crab meat, smelled exactly like crab, and even had the exact color of crab roe... Yet the proprietor insisted wholeheartedly that it was a vegetarian dish. Could they have been trying to pull a fast one on me?
1520576:
I have heard it said that when one sense is closed off, the others grow sharper.
I feel that I usually rely too heavily on my eyes when drawing my bow. As it happens, there is no moon out tonight. If you are willing, Starborn, would you care to join me in trying some archery training in the dark?
1520577:
My sincerest apologies! When I was writing down my contact information at the post office the other day, I accidentally put down your address, Starborn.
If a parcel from Roselansa arrives, could you please hold onto it for me? You can hand it over the next time we meet.
If there happens to be any food inside, please do not hesitate to enjoy it while it is still fresh!
1520578: Lately, I have been reading a certain story. It was a novel depicting the adventures of an elven mage from the perspective of a human hero... In the tale, the mage met many people, formed close friendships, and then watched as they departed one by one. In the end, all that remained was the mage walking the world alone, no longer able to make friends of the heart... It made me wonder. Perhaps living a long life... is not always purely a blessing after all.
1520579:
The days I spent adventuring alongside you have shone so brightly that I did not want to think about what would come after our journey ends.
Even so, I feel I must share these feelings with you now.
Thank you. Someday, these days will surely become my most cherished memories of all.
1520580:
When I was out today, I found a bag of fruit beside a tree stump. The beastkin children rarely come around here, and they don't often pick vegetables or fruit either... so it must have belonged to you, right? I'm sorry—my fawn tore the bag a little when it picked it up in its mouth. I mended it, though it isn't quite as good as new.
Let me give you a new bag the next time we meet.
1520581:
The fruit and letter you sent arrived safely. It makes me so happy that you think of me like this.
However, patrolling the forest and driving away threats is simply my duty as a Gardener... so there's no need for thanks or gifts.
Besides, even without me, a Starborn like you would have handled it without any trouble, wouldn't you?
All the same, please be careful whenever you head out alone. I wouldn't want you to get hurt.
1520582:
Changes in the trees are hard to notice by eye, and even more so when you live right inside the forest. Doing the same things every day makes it hard to even sense the passage of time.
I used to be accustomed to that routine—waking at sunrise, taking walks with the Kibos, clearing out uninvited guests encroaching on the woods, and returning to tend the garden...
Lately, though, things are different. The beastkin children seem livelier than before. Like drifting petals, their laughter carries along the flow of the stream... If the forest of the past was like a sweet, deep slumber, then the forest of today is a crisp and beautiful dream.
It is all thanks to you. If you'd like... shall we take a stroll through the forest together sometime?
1520583:
How does it feel to walk through the forest after the rain? The scent of grass and trees, the rain-damp air, the smell of earth, the light and shadow filtering through the leaves... Everything here is a mark of just how one-of-a-kind this forest is. Do you think this scenery will stay etched deeply in your memory?
Of course, what matters far more is that you can find a brief moment of peace in the short time we spend together. Everything else is trivial.
Come to think of it... could this be called a 'date' between the two of us? Or perhaps a special day off? Ever since I left my homeland and came here alone to guard Evergarden, I had forgotten what a 'special day' even felt like.
Thanks to you coming into my life, I've finally been able to remember that feeling.
1520584:
Once, I listened only to the voice of the Elven Queen, the voice of Yggdrasil, and the voice of the forest. I never dreamed I would ever hear another sound—the knock of a visitor at the garden's gate. Perhaps the barrier dividing the garden from the outside world had, without my noticing, become a wall around my heart as well...
Thank you for listening to me. To show my gratitude, I prepared some new fruit tea and Roselansa-style sweets. I'm not sure if I managed to recreate the authentic taste from my memories, but I'll be happy if they suit your palate.
If you don't have time to stop by, I'll bring them to you myself.
1520586:
Hello.
Wrote a letter.
Be friends.
1520588:
This, Abby's letter.
Food, all gone. Tummy super empty, wanna munch-munch yummy things.
1520589:
Don't wanna munch-munch now.
No sleepy-time either.
Wanna play together more, okay?
1520590:
Bouncing the ball together before was so fun!
Today I was playing by myself and hit the ball toward the trees. Then all the Kibos ran away.
Gotta be a good kid to play with everyone. Abby knows that.
Did Abby do a bad thing? Will you still play with Abby, Starborn?
1520591:
Flying through the sky feels so good!
Wind is cool, sky is big, can fly anywhere.
Clouds in the sky look like the cotton candy you gave me, Starborn, but when I munch-munch them, no taste.
Wanna munch-munch cotton candy. Come with me, Starborn?
When flying through the clouds, what do you think about, Starborn?
If you wanna fly, come to Abby!
1520592: I talk up a storm in person, but when it comes to writing a letter, I've got no clue what to put down... Anyway! If you ever run into trouble, just give me a shout anytime!
1520594:
I just realized, I might've gotten the name wrong in my last letter... Eh, whatever, no big deal! This time I wrote it all by myself, so don't you dare say my handwriting's messy!
Oh yeah, I've been sparring with the militia folks the past few days. Feels like my spearwork's gotten even sharper because of it! I promise, next time we go on patrol together, you won't even have to lift a finger! I'll wrap everything up by myself in no time!
Even though I've got your back, you still gotta keep up with your own training too, got it?!
1520595:
For some reason my tooth's been aching lately. Forget talking, it's even messing with my meals! It's driving me crazy! Even if I can't talk, I can still write letters to you like this, but there's nothing I can do about not being able to wolf down meat! Argh, what am I supposed to do?! A wolf's fangs are a symbol of strength, and I've been taking such good care of them, too!
Man, I'm craving that huge roasted slab of meat you grilled for me before... It was so good!
1520596:
Charlulu Village is a pretty awesome place, right? I grew up there since I was little, so everybody knows me. Playing together, going hunting, eating good food—that was every single day...
Yet for some reason, somewhere along the line, I couldn't stop wondering what the outside world was like. I hesitated forever over what to do, but your courage gave me the push I needed... Listen up: fearless Terara here is gonna keep charging around everywhere right alongside you from here on out!
1520597: Where are you right now? I'm coming to see you in person. Writing letters really is a pain after all. I've got a mountain of stuff I wanna talk about face-to-face! If we just stick together all the time, we won't have to wait around for letters to arrive, right?!
1520599:
Warmest greetings to you, Starborn!
Putting words down on paper truly is different from speaking face-to-face. It gives one plenty of time to gather their thoughts and convey their feelings more clearly.
Besides, a letter lets you say things that might be difficult to say in person.
Truth be told, the village children sometimes get up to mischief, and I always feel hesitant to scold them directly... Perhaps writing a gentle reminder down and handing it to their families would be more effective instead.
1520600:
Zutol Square in Charlulu Village sees a great deal of foot traffic from the villagers, so small disputes tend to break out there quite easily.
I'm a little embarrassed to admit it, but I'm not very good at handling that sort of trouble... Even today, two villagers were arguing over who should get the same item. They turned to me for the final say, and I had no idea what to do... In the end, the village chief had to step in and mediate.
It just goes to show I still have a long way to go. I want to become someone people can rely on in any situation.
What would you do in a situation like that, Starborn?
1520601:
The other day, Tinana gathered some unfamiliar fruit from outside the valley. Curious, I asked for a small share...
It had quite a mysterious flavor. There was a hint of spice beneath its refreshing taste, and while the skin was tough, the core was soft with a slightly crisp texture. As it happens, I've been thinking about compounding a medicine to soothe travel fatigue lately, and this might make an ideal ingredient.
If you ever need any medicine yourself, Starborn, please don't hesitate to let me know. Once it's finished, I'll send some your way.
1520602:
Now that the rainy season has passed, we've been having clear, cloudless skies day after day. When I take a walk through the forest at night, the entire starry sky is vividly visible.
I've heard that in folklore from many lands, the stars are said to be connected to the soul. Beastkin lore says the same—the braver and more passionate a soul is, the brighter the star it belongs to will shine.
What connection, I wonder, does the name 'Starborn' hold with the stars?
Even if one cannot rival the stars in the heavens, among the countless souls upon this earth, yours must surely shine the brightest of all.
1520603:
Today wasn't very busy, so I was tidying up around the house... when I happened to come across the tools I used back when I first became a shaman.
Most of them were gifts from the villagers—a polished bone necklace, a lovely pointed hat, a waist ornament covered in little bells... and the sacred drum passed down through the village for generations.
At first, I couldn't perform my shamanic duties very well, and whenever I needed to connect with Aura, I had no choice but to rely on the sound of the ritual drum. Gradually, however, I realized that when communing with all spirits, what matters isn't following the ceremony step by step, but conveying one's feelings honestly and directly—so little by little, I stopped relying on the drum.
Seeing the sacred drum today made me miss its sound.
Starborn, I promised to offer my blessing upon your journey, didn't I? The next time we meet, please allow me to play a farewell tune for your departure on this sacred drum.
1520604:
You... have been running all over the valley looking busy lately. What exactly are you searching for?
Instead of wasting time rushing around all by yourself, shouldn't you think about whether there's someone around who can help you?
I mean, well... I just happen to be patrolling that area lately, and if I spot someone in trouble, I'm obligated to lend a hand, no matter who it is...
Anyway, you get what I'm trying to say, don't you?
1520605:
Brace yourself for this. While I was out on patrol today, I ran into a rampaging Laikaumo! It was thrashing around everywhere, completely unstoppable—a real terror. In the end, I took my lightning arrow and...
Ugh, forget it! A letter doesn't do it justice at all! You want to hear the whole story properly, right? Next time we meet, I'll tell you all about my heroic exploit in full!
1520606:
Today, while I was helping out at the smithy, a sudden idea hit me. What if I applied the structure of the Grago shell we saw the other day to gear crafting...? So I gave it a try, and it worked surprisingly well!
I've only ever thought about walking the path of a warrior, but maybe I actually have the makings of a great blacksmith?
1520607:
You seem awfully busy, huh? You haven't come by Windhidden Crag in ages—did you get mixed up in some kind of trouble?
It's not like I'm lonely or anything. I was just a tiny bit curious, that's all. There's no special meaning behind this letter either. Whenever you feel like dropping by the village, just come on over. I won't turn you away.
1520608:
Lately, something dawned on me. Whenever I'm about to take off into the sky, my heart doesn't race the way it used to.
Maybe I've gotten so used to flying as a winged-kin that I've lost my old passion... even though I worked so hard just to fly freely...
Ugh, I give up! Thinking about it gets me nowhere! Hey, what do you think? Write me back.
1520609:
<s>Welcome to Charlulu Village, Starborn.
I felt a bit awkward coming to bother you in person, so... I tried writing a letter instead.
I really hope your days in Charlulu Village are pleasant and fun.
Hmm...</s> 
Is this a little too stiff? Does it sound too distant?
How should I address them? 'Hey there'? 'Honorable Starborn'? Or maybe 'Starbooorn!'?
It's no good... I've already rewritten this twelve times... <s>What do I do?</s> 
How should I greet Starborn so they'll feel close to me?
1520610:
I'm so sorry!! I sent that last letter by mistake...
Um, and there's something else I need to apologize for too... You see, from now on, you might... end up receiving a letter every single day...
I didn't know what kind of welcome letter to write so you'd feel comfortable with me, so... I had just written a bunch of different drafts to test them out...
Except the village kids found them. Because I'm always so timid, they thought I didn't have the courage to send them, and tried to help me 'take a step forward.'
Only, this step is... well... I think it might be a little too big...
1520611:
Yesterday, while I was picking fruit outside the village, I happened to spot you.
I wasn't following you, I swear! I just happened—really, purely happened—to see you...
Have you trained somewhere before, Starborn? There's no wasted motion when you swing your sword, and you dodge attacks so smoothly—you look like a seasoned veteran. You know so much about Kibos too... and you're great at using the terrain and surroundings in battle! It's amazing... The way you fight is so graceful, I couldn't help staring...
...
Oh, b-but really, I wasn't following you or anything!
1520612:
A tiny Gadori hatched in the village today. Fresh out of its shell, it looked so fragile... It's hard to imagine those little twig-like limbs growing thick and sturdy enough to support a Gadori's heavy body and haul heavy loads with ease...
Lately, though, I'm starting to understand little by little. Just like a Kibo fresh from its egg, everyone has a time when they're weak. You accepted my weakness. So I found myself thinking... I hope that someday I can grow too, and become a sturdy shield that can shelter you from the wind and rain.
Um, was that a little too sudden?
Still... I know I can do it. Even if I can't right now, one day I definitely will!
1520613:
Luruka told me you're leaving Charlulu Village soon...
Yeah, I know... You're a visitor here, so I always knew you'd set off on a new journey someday... Maybe along the way, you'll even run into my mom. A long time ago, she pointed up at the night sky and told me, "As long as life flows alongside time, it is forever on an adventure. Moving forward with the current is the way life is meant to be..."
So I won't ask you to stay. Maybe... someday, I'll follow in your and Mom's footsteps and set out on a journey of my own, too.
But before that... whenever you come back to Charlulu Village, you can always come stay with me! You'll always have a place here!
1520614:
It's been a while since we last met.
Merchant ships from the Rosia Empire have docked at the harbor, and House Hakuon's patrol unit is currently inspecting their cargo. It's been like this day after day—getting a break feels like trying to grasp at clouds.
Someone suggested I find an assistant... My workload has certainly been piling up lately, and I can't think of anyone besides you who could serve as my assistant.
What do you say, Starborn? Would you care to become Moren Hakuon's assistant? Naturally, I'll prepare tasks worthy of your talents.
1520615:
In House Hakuon, there is an unspoken custom of gifting a musical piece to newly joined members, to celebrate the opening of their new chapter.
However, if I am the one giving the gift, don't you think performing with twin blades suits me far better than plucking a stringed instrument? How about a sword dance to bestow House Hakuon's blessing in place of a song?
That way, everyone will clearly see that it isn't merely House Hakuon, but I myself who hold high expectations for you.
Look forward to it—I'll put together a proper choreography.
1520616:
While organizing official documents last night, a sudden thought struck me. My sense of time is a little dull, so I was slow to realize it... but it's already been quite a long time since we first met. Yet to me, you're still full of mysteries.
I am a being of perfection. As the heir to House Hakuon, I must always remain flawless... And yet, you always make me feel like I'm still far from perfect. Every time I gaze closely at you, an indescribable feeling wells up inside me. Could this be jealousy? Or perhaps...
Oh, enough! I'll just say it honestly! The truth is, I can't leave you alone, and before I even realize it, my eyes are always following you!
1520617:
Have you ever tried a drink called "After Midnight"? Apparently it's all the rage in Fleece lately—the merchants won't stop raving about it, saying you'll regret it if you don't try it at least once.
As a Starborn traveling all across the world, you must have tasted plenty of rare drinks I've never even heard of. I'm truly envious...
If Father hadn't been attacked by those fiends... I could have traveled just like you and woven my own epic. That's something deeply important to High Elves, yet now I spend every day rushing between our clan and various factions, sometimes without even enough time to enjoy a single drink.
May I have a moment? I've been thinking, and having you join House Hakuon really isn't realistic after all. Instead, how about forming an "alliance" with me? That way, I can entrust many matters to you. There aren't many people I can trust, and you're the most suitable person for it.
Once official business is wrapped up, let's share a drink—just the two of us.
1520618:
My birthday is coming up soon...
According to House Hakuon's traditions, every birthday comes with numerous ceremonies and strict etiquette that must be followed. Even who is permitted to attend undergoes rigorous scrutiny.
However, since I'm currently managing family affairs in Father's stead, I have a certain degree of freedom. We can ignore all those old customs. For this birthday, I'm inviting only you.
I'll forget that you're the Starborn, and you'll forget that I'm the heir to House Hakuon. To me, you'll simply be "{playerName}," and to you, I'll just be "Moren."
Now that I think about it, the season I was born in is ideal for skiing. Let's go to the ski resort in the Grand Duchy of Iton together that day. Don't forget to dress warmly. After all, if you catch a cold, there's no one else who can take care of you but me.
1520619:
As I'm sure you know, Starborn, pegasi have a keen sense for seeing the good and evil in a person's heart. And this is the very first time Loire has ever acted so warmly toward anyone other than me. Therefore, you are undoubtedly someone worthy of trust.
I know I will never regret choosing to walk alongside you.
1520620:
Have you been busy lately? Actually, the swordsmen of the Elven Throne and the members of the Knights are planning to hold a mock battle soon, and I was hoping to ask if you might serve as our referee. With your strength and insight, Starborn, I'm confident you'll be able to judge the flow of battle fairly.
Also...
I feel like if I can hear your cheers, my fighting spirit will burn even brighter.
1520621:
Lately, I've been looking into ways to improve our combat rations. Flavor, calories, nutrition, portability... To ensure nothing goes wrong when it matters most, every single one of these criteria deserves serious evaluation and research.
I've enclosed a few prototypes with this letter, so please give them a taste and let me know what you think.
1520622:
You once asked me about the origin of the title "Twin Feather," didn't you? It was a name bestowed upon me directly by the Commander when I was decorated. What it truly means... to be honest, I am still trying to understand it myself.
Sometimes I wonder what I would be doing right now if I hadn't joined the Knights back then. Still, if that had been the case, I suppose I never would have shared such irreplaceable moments with you.
1520623:
By our elven sense of time, it hasn't actually been all that long since we first met, yet it feels as though I've already spent ages embarking on countless wonderful journeys with you.
It is precisely because of your presence that we have even found hope of eradicating the threat of the fiends once and for all.
I swear upon my honor as a Pegasus Knight: I will make my very body a lance, and for you—and for our dream—I will pierce and shatter every obstacle standing in our path.
1520624:
Starborn, how have you been faring?
Recent events have led me to reflect anew on the future of Wind-Hidden Crag. Upholding tradition does not mean rejecting progress. We ought to engage with the outside world and listen to different perspectives. As chief of the tribe, I too must further hone my ability to communicate.
With that in mind, you suddenly came to mind. Your ideas and insights always give me fresh clues toward solving problems.
So, I was thinking of exchanging letters with you regularly from now on—what do you say?
I'm not particularly good at growing close to others, and this is my first time writing a letter. If my phrasing is improper in any way, I'd appreciate it if you pointed it out in your reply.
1520626:
Starborn, how have you been faring?
When exchanging letters like this, what sort of things is one supposed to write?
When I asked a member of the clan, they looked terribly startled and asked me back, "Are you writing a letter to someone?" Since that didn't answer my question, I didn't press further.
Lately, all is well at Wind-Hidden Crag. I am doing well, and the rest of the clan is too. The weather is fine.
Also, I ate red chilies today.
1520627:
How have you been faring?
My only hobby is eating red chilies. Just yesterday I had a delicious dish, so I wrote down the recipe to share with you.
Oh, and when it comes to the red chilies in the recipe, you must never substitute them with letchilf! You can't even call those red chilies—they aren't spicy at all!
Please refer to the enclosed recipe for "Five-Color Stir-Fried Red Chili."
1520628:
My apologies. I've been so busy lately that I haven't been able to send a letter for a while. Even though I was the one who suggested writing to each other, letting my reply fall behind is inexcusable.
I was out fighting fiends for several days, which left me with a mountain of tasks to deal with. Because of that, I can only spare my midday break to dash off this short letter.
As for the red chilies... I don't eat them every single day. I didn't have any yesterday.
My stomach started hurting, so the shaman confiscated my red chili sauce.
Until next time.
1520629:
Whenever I'm waiting for a reply from you, a strange sensation comes over me. It's like knowing Five-Color Stir-Fried Red Chili is on tomorrow's menu, yet not being able to eat it just yet.
Whenever you have time, come visit Wind-Hidden Crag. The weather's been great lately—perfect for flying. I want to talk with you, and eat red chilies together too.
Even as I finished writing this letter, that strange feeling came back again.
About your reply... if you aren't too busy, could you send it a little sooner?
1520631:
Did Nono's first letter arrive okay?
Even without a treasure map, can the post office find Starborn properly?
If it didn't arrive, write back.
1520633:
Last letter, Nono forgot to write the name of who to send it to...
This time Nono wrote it properly, so it should get there faster.
Want a reply soon. Nono will put it away with the first letter in the treasure chest behind the house...
1520635:
It's raining, so can't go exploring.
But if Nono sleeps, Nono can explore in dreams...
Nono wrote down the path to the treasure from the dream. Soon as it clears up, heading right out.
1520636:
Will share the treasure found on the last exploration.
Already put Nono's share in the treasure chest. Location of treasure chest is NOT behind the house. Really.
When Nono finds more shinies, will send them.
Wonder if they'll fit in an envelope, though.
1520637:
While packing bags, someone was talking about treasure and exploring.
A story about "Great Explorers"... That means Nono and everyone, right?
Yeah. 'Cause Starborn is strong, Nono is strong, Titi is strong, and Pu-chan and Bururu are pretty strong too.
Exploring is shiny. Still want to keep going.
1520639:
Hello!
The other day, I saw your Guild's notice recruiting a pale-blonde female knight accompanied by a Grifa to join an expedition, so I decided to apply.
I specialize in many close-combat skills such as spearwork and shield defense, and I'm confident in using Light-element magic too. Please leave it to me!
I've enclosed the Uni required for the application in this letter.
1520641:
Starborn, thank you for warning me!
I hid nearby and watched for a while, and sure enough, I spotted a group of them. They were sizing up passersby and rewriting the notices to match their targets' traits.
Afterward, I contacted the sheriff, who said they were a classic band of swindlers and promised to handle them.
So they really were scammers... Back when I lived in the Rosia Empire, nothing like this ever happened.
1520643:
Ever since I started exchanging letters with you, I realized I suddenly have so many more things to look forward to.
Wondering whether my letter arrived safely, eagerly waiting for your reply, looking forward to writing the next one.
This is the first time I've ever exchanged letters with a friend under my own name. Before, whenever I picked up a pen, it was always about family, honor, or glory—never anything I actually wanted to say. But when the letter is addressed to you, I don't have to worry about any of those boring formalities.
I wish I could keep saying whatever I truly want to say like this forever.
1520644:
The other day, when I passed through the market, I spotted this flower.
Even though it isn't in season, it was blooming so vividly and beautifully at a stall.
According to the shopkeeper, a glass greenhouse lets it bloom even out of season. But because of that, once it leaves that environment, it has a hard time adapting to changes in the weather.
Sure enough, it wilted right after I bought it. So I pressed it inside a book to dry it—that's the flower enclosed in this letter.
Say... is a greenhouse really a good thing for a flower?
1520646:
The outside world is completely different from everything I was used to before. If I don't stay sharp at all times, I can't handle everything that comes my way.
There are so many problems I don't know the answers to, and even more things I never even realized could be problems in the first place...
Is it okay if I come to you for advice about stuff like this? Whenever I'm around you, I always feel so relaxed, and even if we can't solve it right away, at least I don't have to rack my brains all by myself. Ehehe.
1520648:
Curious what my weapon shop in the Federation looks like?
A customer once told me, "The interior of your shop looks just like an art gallery!" And honestly, I was pretty thrilled with that compliment. Because at its core, this place really is meant to display the art I design—it just happens to be weapons.
Oh, right! If you ever visit Reve, you definitely have to stop by and see it. Looking at you gives me the feeling that tons of new inspiration are going to come pouring out♪
1520650:
I got two tickets to the Weapon Expo today. That reminded me—the organizers actually invited me to unveil my newest piece at this exhibition! They offered to display it right in the center of the exhibition hall, so I said yes.
I'd love to hold my own solo exhibition someday. And when I do, I'll have you be my partner, Starborn... Yep, it's settled! Let's go to this expo together so we can study up for the future!
1520652: Did you read "100 Ways to Hit a Dead End in an Otherworldly Labyrinth" that I recommended the other day?! If you haven't yet, read it right now! Otherwise you'll regret it for life! The story is super good, and my absolute, absolute, absolute favorite chapter is "Veil of the Labyrinth"—the gatekeeper's line is just so crazy cool! "The shadow of the night of death is the soul of an infant weeping and crawling at your feet. Sleep—for being cast into the abyss is the mercy the labyrinth grants to dreamers."... Wait, no, I mustn't spoil what comes next, so just hurry up and read it! I really want to talk more about this book with you!
1520654:
The design sketches for my new piece are finally locked in! I originally meant to wait until everything was finished before telling you, but I just couldn't wait—every bit of inspiration for this piece came from you! You could even call it a work of art crafted exclusively for you. Surprised?
Things are going to get pretty busy for me for a while. I have to craft the weapon while also squeezing in a trip back home...
1520655:
The latest masterpiece lovingly forged by the Rosinia Federation's renowned weapon artist—"Morningstar of Prosya"—is already on its way! This special gift should be reaching you very soon! I'm confident in every piece I create, of course, but I'm still dying to know what you think of it. Make sure you tell me your completely honest opinion!
Also... once my gift arrives, don't you think you ought to prepare a fitting gift in return? I'm not the type to be satisfied easily, you know. Hmm... how about a trip for just the two of us?
1520656:
Greetings. On behalf of the Fleece Lord's Manor, I extend a warm welcome upon your arrival.
As the maid assigned to attend to your reception and daily needs, I shall serve you to the very best of my ability. Should you require any assistance, please do not hesitate to ask at any time. Within reasonable bounds, I shall see everything resolved.
1520657:
Greetings. As the Golden Wheat Carnival approaches, I write to extend my warmest regards.
Enclosed, please find a recommended sightseeing itinerary for the duration of the carnival. Should you wish to adjust your schedule or find anything unsatisfactory in the plan, please feel free to reply at any time. As always, I shall support you with the utmost sincerity.
I wish you a most wonderful Golden Wheat Carnival from the bottom of my heart.
1520658:
Dear Guest, I heard from the Head Maid that you expressed concern about whether I might be overworking myself, urging me to prioritize my own health.
First, thank you kindly for your consideration. I am currently in the best of health. However, it appears that your definition of health and mine differ somewhat. Staying up until dawn and pushing breakfast back to what most people consider lunchtime can hardly be said to meet any standard of healthy living.
While it is not my place as a maid to speak out of turn, do you not require a guardian at your side to encourage healthier habits? Should no suitable candidate exist, I would be more than happy to take on the role.
1520659:
By the time you read this letter, I trust you will have finished the special breakfast I prepared on the plate holding down this envelope.
In light of your rather unusual daily rhythm, I had no choice but to offer guidance toward a healthier lifestyle in this manner. Should you have any complaints, please contact me during standard breakfast hours.
1520660:
The Head Maid advised me to go out with friends more often during my days off, yet I could not immediately think of where to go.
Is there anywhere you would like to visit?
P.S. You may call me simply by my name. No unnecessary honorifics are required.
1520662:
It seems a lot of kids have been getting sick lately, so I wanted to remind everyone again. Remember our health motto!
Wash your hands well, brush your teeth well, eat until you're full, and sleep soundly!
That's the secret to staying healthy.
1520665:
Um, I actually meant to send this to the children at the sanatorium... It looks like the post office delivered it to the wrong address. Still, to me, you're just as much of a child. Make sure you keep our little "promise," okay? Good kids who listen get a flower as a reward, and naughty kids who don't get a spanking.
Also, I noticed your old wounds, and they look really bad... If you have time, come by the sanatorium sometime. I'll tend to them properly for you.
1520668:
Your appointment for the "Comprehensive Physical Examination" has been confirmed. This examination includes 28 major categories and 36 subcategories.
Estimated duration: 3 days. Please bring a change of clothes and arrive at our facility early in the morning on the day of your examination on an empty stomach.
This examination is covered by a family package purchased on your behalf by our nurse, Anis. Here is a message from Nurse Anis:
"You looked so pale the other day, and I'm really worried about your health. Make sure you show up on time, okay? I'll take extra good care of you."
1520670:
I saw your test results. From the looks of it, you haven't been eating properly or getting enough sleep at all! You promised you'd follow the health guidelines... Why won't you take better care of yourself?
Adventuring out there is so dangerous—if you're not in top shape, you're only going to get hurt more easily. And if you get injured out there all alone, I won't be able to rush to your side right away... I know you're a Starborn, carrying a huge responsibility that may decide the fate of the world.
Even so, to me, whether you're eating well and sleeping regularly matters far more than the fate of the world.
1520672:
According to the director, since you're a Starborn, the standard metrics for your exam are different from ours. Based on several of your physical performance results, the director concluded that you're actually very healthy.
I'm so glad you're healthy—I can finally breathe easy... Sorry for misunderstanding earlier.
Truthfully, I know you're an amazing Starborn who's more than capable of protecting yourself. Still, I can't help worrying so much. Maybe it's because I'm always seeing you fight ferocious beasts, and I see you getting hurt so often. And sometimes, I even have nightmares where you're injured and I can't do anything to help.
Lean on me every once in a while, okay? I'll always be right here waiting for you.
1520674:
Today, Master taught me how to write a letter. Writing my very first letter feels so exciting!
At first I wanted to write one to Ponpon, but since we see each other every day, I didn't know what to write.
I don't get to see you every day, Starborn, so I decided to write to you instead.
I'll be waiting for your reply!
Hmm... Now I just have to take it to the post office, right?
I hope it reaches you safely...
1520677:
Did I write the recipient and sender names backwards?
What's inside the letter is what Peipei wants to say. Usually the speaker's name goes first, so I got it mixed up. But now that I think about it, the letter is for you to read, Starborn, so your name should go at the very top, right? Got it!
I'm so happy to learn something new.
1520679:
I had this the other day and it was super yummy! Please try some. I asked Master to learn how to make it, but Master said if we knew the recipe, we'd make tons of candy, and if we made tons of candy, we'd eat tons of it, and eating too much candy gives you cavities... so Master told me to go buy it outside instead.
The thing is, I already spent all my allowance for this month...
1520680:
A customer got their math wrong and accused me of shortchanging them by 20 Uni on purpose.
I calculated it again, but they still wouldn't listen to me. Then Master came out from the kitchen and explained it, and the customer suddenly understood.
Is Peipei really that hard to understand...?
Master said that once Peipei grows up, someone who truly listens to Peipei will come along.
1520681:
Since you've always listened so seriously to what Peipei says, I'll let you in on Peipei's secret dream, Starborn.
Martial arts uniforms don't come in Pammy sizes, and most martial arts halls won't accept Pammy disciples.
Pammies might fall short in some ways, but we're amazing in others! Peipei can climb all the way to the top of a bamboo stalk, whereas Master can't—because Master would snap the bamboo in half!
Once I get as strong as Master, I'm going to invent a Pammy martial art, gather lots of Pammy disciples, and open a Pammy Martial Arts Hall!
1520683:
Please forgive the sudden intrusion, but there are certain rumors circulating out there, and I simply must clear up any misunderstandings with you.
Peachwood swords, ink lines, glutinous rice, and the like actually have no effect on me whatsoever. In fact, I quite enjoy all sorts of dishes made with glutinous rice—if the opportunity arises, I would love to savor them together with you.
Some people also claim that wooden stakes and hammers work on me... I truly have no idea where such tales come from. I even use them when repairing my own bed, so they don't frighten me at all...
Ah, um, what I mean to say is that I am not nearly as frail as you may have heard, Esteemed Starborn. I don't have all that many weaknesses, so please feel at ease taking me out with you...
Though now that I'm writing this out, going out during the day might still be a little hard on me after all... If possible, I would be delighted if our outings could be at night.
Oh no, I'm so sorry! Reading this letter back, it seems I've written something terribly selfish again... I should just go dig a hole and bury myself...
1520684:
Have you ever heard of the mystic arts known as Fangshu? Compared to orthodox Xuanmen sects, practitioners of Fangshu are closer to the ancient shamans. In addition to wielding talismans, we are well versed in Yin-Yang, the Five Elements, and celestial divination.
It would be presumptuous of me to boast of such trifling skills before you, Esteemed Starborn, but should you ever have need of them, I would be more than glad to lend you my aid.
1520686:
You once asked me what inconveniences this body brings. One of them is likely what is known as "hyperthymesia."
I only heard that term later from a traveling merchant in Fleece, yet it seems to describe my condition remarkably well.
I still remember the sting of scraping my knee when I fell as a child just learning to walk, and I can reproduce every single talisman I ever studied during my training down to the finest stroke. Even more than that—my final moments among the living, the claws and fangs of the ferocious beast lunging straight toward me—I can recall them as vividly as if they were right before my eyes.
You have lost your past, whereas I am a shadow forever trapped in mine, my heart constantly pierced by memories as sharp as blades.
As for how to ease that pain... if such a remedy existed, I suppose I would never have needed to seek "liberation" in the first place.
1520687:
Throughout these days of exploring alongside you, Esteemed Starborn, I cannot help but feel that my debt to you only grows heavier.
Despite being a practitioner of Fangshu, not only have I failed to be of much use, I have troubled you time and again on my account. You have saved me from the hooves of charging Boaragas thirty-seven times alone; rescued me from the pranks of Cheshire Bats fifteen times; protected my food from Gourmonks six times; and pulled me away from Flamules on the brink of exploding three times...
Even if I were to dedicate the entire remainder of my life to it, I could never fully repay such immense kindness.
1520688:
Thanks to the power of the jade disc that Father and everyone protected, I was able to linger on in this world. Although I once told you that my memories of the past sustained me, the truth is that there were times when I lost my way as well. Living on like this... I spent so long wondering what purpose it served. If Father ever knew that, I am certain he would grieve all the more deeply, beating his chest in sorrow and regret.
Now, however, I want nothing more than to stand proudly before Father at your side and tell him, "I am doing well."
My old wounds still ache, yet the time I have spent with you—even if it exists only in memory—is more than enough to heal them all. And as for my reason to keep existing in this world, I can search for it together with you from here on out.
It feels almost as though I have come back to life—this must be what that feels like, wouldn't you agree?
1520689: Oh! You look familiar, nya! I've seen you at both the Adventurers' Association and the Kibo Fight Guild, haven't I? What an eager rookie! Since you just got here, there must be plenty of things you're still figuring out. Don't hesitate to ask me anything! Maple is the receptionist at the Adventurers' Association and the guide for the Kibo Fight Guild, so steering newcomers onto the right path is my number one job, nya!
1520690: I've been seeing you around the Adventurers' Association and the Kibo Fight Guild a lot lately, nya! Having passion is great, but make sure to take care of yourself and get plenty of rest. If you wear yourself out, you won't be able to do the things you love! Whenever you need a hand with anything, don't be shy—just tell Maple. Solving everyone's troubles is what I do, nya!
1520691: Thanks for helping Maple out yesterday and stopping those persistent rotten fighters, nya! Honestly, those guys are notorious all over Fleece. Lots of participants' Kibos were getting bullied by them too. Now that you taught them a lesson, I bet they won't be causing trouble for a good while! You're really someone we can count on. You've got tons of fans at the Adventurers' Association and the Kibo Fight Guild now, you know! Make sure to keep dropping by, nya!
1520692: It's good to relax every once in a while! Besides, the Golden Wheat Carnival is right around the corner, nya! Fleece's Golden Wheat Carnival is super lively, so Maple—your pro guide—will show you around the carnival market! I promise it'll be an experience unlike anything you've had before. So... are you free on the day of the Golden Wheat Carnival, nya? I'll wrap up my work as fast as I can that day so I can keep my schedule open for you!
1520693: Lately, it feels like I do just about everything with you, nya. Even today, when I got an invitation to the Adventurers' Association receptionists' mixer, I almost asked if you wanted to go with Maple! Then the coworker who delivered the letter asked, "Wait, *the* famous Starborn?!" and it suddenly hit me. Oh, right! You're the big hero who saved Fleece! Somewhere along the way, in Maple's heart, you stopped being some unreachable hero. Instead, you became someone so much closer—someone cute with your own likes, dislikes, and little quirks. So, what about Maple? Who is Maple to you? Just an ordinary friend? Or maybe... Maple hates guessing games, nya! Come tell me your answer in person!
1520695:
Even before we met formally, I had heard tales of your exploits across many places, Starborn.
The talent and skill you have demonstrated in action are truly admirable.
Due to work obligations, I sincerely apologize for having to take my leave first.
When we meet again in the future, I hope we may build a fruitful partnership together.
1520696:
{playerName}, how have you been faring of late?
Recently, I have been reading through numerous training methods recorded in old texts, and quite a few passages caught my attention. If I can draw some inspiration from them, I may take another step closer to challenging the legendary Great Yokai.
Should you have the time in the future, I would be grateful for your continued guidance.
1520697:
I never imagined so many people would take an interest in my blade. While I was out buying necessities at the guild, a collector actually offered to buy "Oborokage." Naturally, I refused.
"Oborokage" is not merely my companion in battle—it is also the symbol of the Minamoto Clan, and it will only be drawn from its scabbard for one whom it acknowledges.
Though it is the highest honor, the very first time I drew "Oborokage," I was astounded by its power...
1520698:
I returned home to take care of some household matters that had piled up.
While I was speaking with my mother, flower petals drifted past the window, and I noticed the cherry tree in the courtyard had come into bloom.
It made me think back to learning the art of tea beneath that very cherry tree so many cycles ago.
When the blossoms return next time, won't you come visit here too, {playerName}?
I'll brew some herbal tea for you again when you do.
1520699:
I am truly grateful to you for accompanying me in my training and helping me grow stronger. It still weighs on my mind a little that I got carried away and used too much strength during our sparring match the other day. Please do not take it to heart.
Through all the training I have done thus far, I have come to feel strongly that what I truly seek is not mere victory or defeat, but to become someone who can stand tall and face every battle and trial yet to come.
When the time truly comes for me to draw my blade and make my stand, I still want you by my side... to witness together the fruits of the path we have walked.

A Kibo this rare will disappear after {2}, ribbit!

A Shining Variant {1} was just spotted in {0}, ribbit! If you have time, go check it out!
A Kibo this rare will be gone after {2}, ribbit!

A Starlit {1} was just spotted in {0}, ribbit! If you have time, go check it out!
A Kibo this rare will be gone after {2}, ribbit!
1520704:

A Shining Starlit {1} was just spotted in {0}, ribbit! If you have time, go check it out!
A Kibo this rare will be gone after {2}, ribbit!

1520715:
Hey, Hero. I found the absolute best spot by the shore of Melt Lake to sneak in an afternoon nap.
The grass is as soft as the pudding at Meimei House, and when you lie down on it, you can spot a cloud shaped just like a fox—a spitting image of me!
Oh, just so we're clear, I've been watching what I eat lately, so I'm definitely a bit slimmer than that cloud...
Still, grass and clouds alone aren't quite enough. If you were right here beside me, Hero, it'd be just like that line from the stories: "A single moment like this is worth a thousand gold."
Pretty please, won't you come to Melt Lake right now? Though what if, by the time you get here, that goofy cloud has wandered off somewhere...?
Well, even if it does, that's okay. Just having you beside me is enough to make any view wonderful!
1520716:
When you come, Hero, could you bring me an awoo? Awoo? ...
(The rest of the letter is covered only in a trail of tiny fox pawprints... What could that mean?)

A thousand cycles ago, to safeguard the people of Fleece, the First Lord joined hands with the Aeolians to battle ferocious beasts and bring peace to the city.
Today, in honor of the First Lord's spirit, the Adventurers' Guild is once again hosting the "Beast Hunter Tournament" to crown our finest warriors!
The tournament will run for 15 days in total, with the Adventurers' Guild periodically updating the hunting roster. Complete hunts to rack up points, vie for the championship title, and win the grand prize of 1,000,000 Uni!
The Adventurers' Guild has already prepared celebratory roasted meats, bonfires (and bandages). Grab your weapons and your courage, and let's march out together!

Tana is Luruka's closest partner. Remarkably clever and a bit fiery-tempered, Tana is loyal to its partner above all else.
One hundred moons ago, Tana traveled from the frigid north to Sprout Valley. Ever since, Finwolves have made this region their home—and it was here that Tana met Luruka, forging an unbreakable bond together.
1520879: A valiant and powerful Finwolf. Raised in Charlulu Village alongside the hunter Terara since childhood, they share a deep bond. Brave, fearless, and unflinching in the face of any danger, Ul is a reliable and loyal companion.
1520880: A Kibo full of mystery. No information available yet.

1520888: This Kibo has not been discovered yet. You can search for it in Fleece - Meltlake.

1521080: This Kibo has not been discovered yet. You can search for it in Fleece - Harvest Valley.

Perhaps because of this, anyone who bullies Woody tends to encounter bad luck in the forest.
1521086: Grown Lindy's wood elemental manipulation powers have increased significantly. The young sprout that used to be on top of its head has grown and now resembles a hat. It hangs such individuals from tree branches with thorny vines and refuses to let them down until they admit their wrongdoing.
1521092: Amidst Lily's hardships, Heidi fluttered down unexpectedly, like a soft snowflake. 1521093: The main force of the fierce beast army, maintaining numerical superiority while also improving combat effectiveness—a very formidable enemy. 1521094: The type with the highest combat prowess among general fierce beasts. Powerful, berserk, and boasting overwhelming arm strength. When appearing on the battlefield, it does not care at all about involving leading Darkknights. Furthermore, it may even absorb useless Darkknights as its own energy, making it truly a ruthless and stern governor.
1521095: A regular believer of the Evolution Cult participating in battle. Wearing a leopard-woman mask on their face, they don the cult's standard easy-to-move women's combat uniform. When activating power, Karma ring magic circles appear on both of their wrists.
1521096: A special pair-in-one Kibo born in the dim places of Jinghua Cape. High learning capacity and abundant curiosity prompt them to observe passersby with keen interest. As a result, the other party becomes frightened and flees in panic, but this allowed them to learn various expressions. Moreover, for a long time, they mistook the words "It's a ghost!" shouted by fleeing people as their own name.
1521097: Astral Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai
1521103: Having fully entered its adult stage, Shadiva has greatly improved all its abilities, but its personality has become even shyer. Upon encountering an unfamiliar person, it wraps its body up completely and bolts away at top speed. However, in front of trusted kin, it may display somewhat bossy and willful attitudes, such as demanding the most comfortable spot on the cave wall.
1521108: Meefon is active during the day near Claudime herds. Seeing it engrossed in eating grass, many small Kibos lower their guard and approach Meefon to play together. However, some inexperienced Meefons reportedly have dulled fangs from eating too much grass during the day...
1521110: Megarum has long fur covering its eyes and claws. Due to the dangerous aura emitted from its body, many Kibos are afraid to approach it. At night, Megarum reveals its true form: its long, silky fur stands on end, exposing fierce eyes and sharp claws. Its claw strikes are terrifying, and creatures designated as its prey have almost no way of surviving. Strangely enough, even though Megarum is this ferocious, it never attacks the Claudime herds near its habitat.
1521112: Mimic is a cunning yet timid Kibo that lives by attaching itself to treasure chests. It wanders around various places where treasure chests appear, collecting items dropped by explorers like a diligent scavenger. Even "trash" that appears valueless to human races is a precious collection to Mimic. Occasionally, it takes them out to gaze at or fiddle with them, letting out a satisfied, eerie laugh.
1521116: The Azure Flower Young Fox is small with soft fur. A pink flame-like tuft of hair at the tip of its tail is its most distinctive feature. The juvenile Azure Flower Young Fox is in its most active and mischievous phase. A playful foodie, whether it is peach blossom petals fluttering down slowly or piping-hot steamed buns in a bamboo steamer, it immediately fixes an eager gaze upon them. If the Azure Flower Spirit Fox or Dream Flower Nine-Tails are not keeping a watchful eye, it will instantly stir up trouble one after another.
1521118: The Azure Flower Spirit Fox has grown more supple and elegant through maturation. Its fur is dense, its tails are three in number, and the scarlet fur adorning its body is increasingly vibrant. These are proofs of its even more formidable power. In front of the Azure Flower Young Foxes who admire it, the Azure Flower Spirit Fox displays a mature, composed, and elegant demeanor. But once away from the little foxes, it immediately reveals a mischievous side—though the innocence of a cub is gone, it does not yet seem fully mature.
1521120: Only a very few Azure Flower Spirit Foxes can evolve into the Dream Flower Nine-Tails. Not only long cultivation is required, but a mysterious "bond" is indispensable. Every single bond, emotion, and occurrence in the world serves as an opportunity supporting the cultivation of the Nine-Tails clan. Even after becoming a Dream Flower Nine-Tails and mastering transformation techniques, the days of weaving bonds for cultivation never end.
1521123: Once Ludaris's most loyal and brave subordinate, now its most cruel and brutal claw and fang. Pursuing Ludaris and committing atrocities, though still by Ludaris's side, they no longer act for mission or loyalty, but purely for destruction and slaughter.
1521124: Red Scorpion Gang Squad Leader. Called "Boss" in the gang. Extorts wealthy merchants, but actually uses the stolen money to help those living at the bottom, especially children. Weapon is an explosive pile bunker. While single-shot and high instantaneous single-target damage, it cannot output sustained firepower. Reusing it requires loading gunpowder and waiting a while for the heat to cool down.
1521126: Sapitz is small, active, and mischievous, with a liking for ores. It is always digging around in the dirt with its small paws to search for fragments. Its mining technique is still crude and leaves it covered in mud, but finding even the tiniest grain of mineral excites it greatly. Sometimes it even digs a small hole around an ore to fall asleep in, trying to blend into the environment like the ore itself.
1521128: Sapyrus likes digging for ores. With the paw pads of its front feet, it can sense underground minerals through rock layers and independently explore new mineral veins. It possesses an uncanny intuition for spotting brittle parts of rock structures, often finding mineral veins faster than human miners. It has already mastered basic rotary mining techniques: curling its body into a sphere and rotating at high speed to shatter the ore along with the rock wall, obtaining fragments from within.
1521131: Flammy grew up alongside Mity and is very sensitive to her emotions. Whenever Mity is suffering, it flaps its wings frantically and sparks to chase away the dark clouds in her heart. Flammy has an extraordinary desire to protect Mity. If anyone approaches when she is feeling down or weak, it immediately fluffs its feathers, spreads its wings, and emits sparks to intimidate them.
1521132: Usually, Sugar Birds always move in flocks, but Sugar Chuu has a poor sense of direction and cannot keep up with its kin, often lagging behind. However, it does not seem anxious about this at all, leisurely sipping flower nectar, and once full, collapsing into the grass to sleep soundly. Quite bold, its curiosity toward other races surpasses its caution. And very fortunately, it has never encountered real danger or natural predators.
1521133: The Greater White Black is a relatively strong individual among Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai, with physique and attack power far surpassing ordinary Xiao Hei and Xiao Bai. However, because its facial expression is not very frightening, it rarely startles anyone even when appearing suddenly. The Greater White Black dislikes being mistaken for someone else. Especially when Lanko does so, it loses its temper and refuses to return to its coffin for a long time.
1521134: Among deer herds, Leidos is an extremely rare and special existence. Plants sprout and flowers bloom wherever it walks. Therefore, deer often follow in Leidos's footsteps, and its figure is like a guardian deity of the forest. Leidos is the first visitor to Metsa's Evergarden. Intrigued by this wood elf who came to the forest, and wanting to help her with her worries about how to care for the scattered plants in the fields, it carried tree branches over in its mouth... Metsa never intentionally tamed Leidos. Yet Leidos always walks beside her of its own accord—more than just a companion, it is like a guardian gifted to her by the land and nature.
1521135: Kaea was born on a farm in the outskirts of Fleece, and while still little, was taken in by the former director of Carnon Sanitarium and entrusted to Anis. As time passed, Kaea gradually grew into a reliable Starlink companion. Using her own strength, she assists Anis in treatment and calms the minds of patients and their families. The medical bag Kaea carries is custom-made by Anis, and Kaea is also the very first to rush to Anis's side whenever Anis needs her. Anis sometimes feels that rather than unilaterally protecting Kaea, she is similarly protected by Kaea in return.
1521136: This Kibo has not been discovered yet. You can obtain it by increasing Anis's affinity.
1521137: Kikugi has a docile, laid-back personality and is always relaxed. But in emergencies or when its Starlink partner Catar is in danger, it shows aggression unlike usual and its movements become unrecognizably swift.
1521138: Velvet has an active personality, always bringing encouragement and good luck to surrounding companions. The ribbon on its head and the bell on its neck are matching items given by Maple. Velvet considers this special treatment from Maple and treasures them very dearly.
1521141: Dragblaze is the ruler of volcanoes and magma. Its sturdy shell withstands all high temperatures, and the fiery breath exhaled from its mouth melts rock walls. Dragblaze is noble, but by no means cruel. It guards its fiery domain and maintains the balance within it. Unless provoked, it will not proactively leave its territory. According legend, those recognized by Dragblaze are permitted to ride upon its back, able to advance through scorching magma and seas of fire as if driving a moving volcano.
1521143: Chofuko is fierce, strong-willed, possesses a strong curiosity about the outside world, and likes ramming into things everywhere. When stimulated, it emits hot flames from within its body, burning the fur on its head and parts of its body to intimidate enemies.
1521145: Fialarga is not only skilled in charging, but also possesses a blazing mane, capable of inflicting severe burns on enemies. Furthermore, after Fialarga charges, a temporarily blazing trail of fire is left behind. Meanwhile, in non-combat states, they often gather near rocks, mingling the residual heat of their bodies with geothermal heat. This leisurely sight is unimaginable from its rampage during combat.
1521148: This Kibo has not been discovered yet. You can search for it in Fleece - Eastern Lost Trail Forest.
1521150:
Neatmitt searches for domains it has acknowledged, plunging its sharp, giant scythe into the ground to declare sovereignty over the territory. In its youth it only knew how to 'protect with fear', but now it has grown to 'watch over with steadfastness'.
Neatmitt allows small dark-attribute creatures to inhabit its body. It is always generous and quiet toward such creatures—or perhaps it truly hasn't yet emerged from its lonely juvenile period.
1521153:
Carabard's temperament is much wilder than Karabekko's, harboring considerable explosive power. By violently shaking its body, it releases the 'pungency' within all at once to drive away enemies.
If it encounters an opponent it simply cannot defeat, it can safely escape by dropping its own leaf crest to distract the opponent's attention.
1521155:
Lalati usually form groups to be active at night, confirming each other's positions with the light emitted from their bodies. When startled, they emit a weak electric shock to slightly stun enemies.
Lalati also have a habit of chasing shiny objects—such as light reflected on water surfaces or raindrops, or even the metal tools used by travelers. Out of curiosity, they approach to touch them with their bodies, but usually bounce away themselves from 'shock repulsion', fluttering and making continuous clicking sounds in fluster.
1521158: The cursed blade 'Kakitsumaru' not only devours its host's spirit and soul to gain power, but can also continue fighting even after losing its host. By releasing all the yokai power residing within the blade and gathering a hundred demons to form a physical body, it drags opponents into a self-constructed barrier to enjoy endless bloodshed.
1521159: Jaidion inhabits the abyss of frigid icy seas, excelling in remote attacks and magical arts. It prefers exploring the unknown and shows interest in artificial objects sunken deep in the ocean. Wild Jaidion rarely show themselves on land.
1521161:
The feather powder shaken off Suanrong's body emits a pungent odor, and when colliding, a large amount of feather powder scatters to make the smell even more intense. Suanrong uses this method to repel enemies.
Its personality is generally laid-back, and most of its time is spent burrowing in the soil to sleep. When encountering a difficult situation, it gives up readily, which is why the Chen Dynasty proverb compares fatalists to Suanrong.
1521163:
Suannia's body is elastic, and its plumage is fluffy and soft. Just a light touch causes a massive amount of pungent feather powder to shed, making it adept at driving away enemies.
Suannia is quite quick-tempered, easily angered over minor things and jumping around on the ground. However, because it is forgetful, it quickly forgets why it was angry and shifts its interest to other things.
1521165:
Yellowda likes to think, but often gets caught up in a cascade of questions and slips into its own world. At such times, it may wear a blank expression and its movements become stiff.
However, those who underestimate them based on this will learn a painful lesson.
Although Yellowda is given to contemplation, it never frets—making it an exceptionally philosophical Kibo.
