1562528:
A picturesque grassland area featuring beautiful, serene scenery. It is a popular spot for the residents of Charlulu Village to hunt, fish, forage, or take strolls with companions.
Even at night, the light emitted from the giant crystal in the center of the lake and the plants on the shore envelops the entire grassland, causing all life to grow vibrantly as if bathing in the energy released by the crystal.
1562530:
A forest area through which gentle winds blow. Like neighboring areas, it is bathed in energy released by the large crystal in the center of the lake. This area is covered in vast greenery where Kibo live freely and comfortably.
It is also surrounded by rivers, forming natural fishing grounds with unique characteristics, making it exceptionally well-suited for fishing.
1562532:
An area covered by a deep forest. With a rich variety of plants—some growing very tall, others small and cute—it forms a complex food chain and natural landscape.
Deep within lies a carefully tended secret realm, quietly sprouting in a corner of the deep forest.
1562533: Hawk Mountain Range - Astral Vein Node
1562534:
A mountainous area with rugged surface terrain. On cliffs and inside caves, many special Kibo live that are rarely seen in other areas of the valley.
The complex and treacherous terrain, peculiarly shaped rocks, and sturdy cliff walls appealed greatly to the Winged folk who migrated from the valley long ago. They decided to make this place their new settlement and have resided here to this day.
1562536:
Steep, towering cliffs deeply shroud the lowlands, and an unfathomable, oppressive atmosphere constantly drifts over this land. This is a forgotten place where neither Beastmen nor Winged folk care to tread, and keen-sensed Kibo perceive the dangerous presence lurking there and give it a wide berth.
Through gaps in the slowly swirling air currents, lush vegetation and a slender flowing stream are faintly visible, yet danger remains the unchanging theme of this land.
1562538: A simplified node built using scrap materials left over from constructing Astral Vein nodes. It satisfies the travel needs of certain adventurers.
1562544: White Cave of the Gloomy Bay - Simple Node
1562545:
A tribe of Beastmen migrated to Sprout Valley in search of a new homeland, settling down here to form a settlement. After a hundred generations, this settlement developed into present-day Charlulu Village.
The village is enveloped in a calm and peaceful atmosphere, and the villagers possess simple and innocent personalities. They uphold ancient customs and traditions, living a modest and fulfilling life in harmony with the mountains and rivers.
1562546:
A neutral city with beautiful natural scenery, thriving commerce and trade, and a coexistence of diverse cultures.
Due to its geographical importance and neutral stance, chambers of commerce from various factions gather here, making it an extremely developed trade and transportation hub on the continent. This has driven Fleece's diversification, allowing visitors to encounter members of all intelligent races within the city. Consequently, one can experience a wide variety of unique cultures here.
1562547: A vague legend lurking deep within the Fog-Hidden Forest. It is drawn to strong desires and appears, only to respond with whimsical pranks. Is it truth or illusion? Dream or reality? This is the untouchable fairy butterfly.

1562589:
A supply station opened by Otata, a master of fishing. Not only does it sell various types of bait and fishing catches, but it also provides homemade special fishing rods said to increase the fishing success rate in the region.
'There's no fish in this world I can't catch~, nor any river I can't cross~!'
Otata always hums such enigmatic phrases while calmly reeling in jaw-dropping giant catches—ranging from giant fish to Pammy's itinerant merchant Memme, you never know what you might reel in.
1562591: A field Starlight mining site. When constructed, it grants a buff effect to the farm's Starlight mining site.
1562592: Hawk Mountain Range Starlight Mining Site
1562597:
A small shop opened by Memme the Pammy merchant, frequently stocking local specialties.
Curious merchant Memme loves trading goods as well as gathering gossip from all over the world.
Sometimes, you might spot a large piece of luggage and a Umi plushie left by the roadside. Look closely, and you'll find a cardboard box in front of Umi bearing the message: 'Self-service, please.' Customers who witness this cannot help but smile—the shopkeeper has wandered off to go rubbernecking once again.
1562599:
Titi the Pammy adventurer always pulls unexpected, wondrous bargains out of a wrapping cloth. If you happen to encounter Titi on the road, it's worth taking a peek to see if Titi has found anything nice recently.
Titi and Poo-chan are a born treasure hunter duo. From ownerless Kibo eggs to glowing ores, there is nothing Titi cannot get their hands on. And whatever they acquire is sold to those who recognize its value—such as the Starborn.
1562600:
Originally established by the Pammy Miracle Workshop as a post office for Pammy folk to correspond with one another, Pammy Post Office gradually began accepting business from other races as Pammy traveled to various corners of the world and interacted with diverse cultures.
Over time, Pammy Post Office steadily grew and earned everyone's trust, continuing to provide convenient postal services backed by a prompt, accurate, and warm-hearted spirit of service.
1562603: Puka Pier extends out toward the surface of the water. Because the surrounding lake water is warm and nutrient-rich, numerous fish gather here. The villagers established a simple yet practical fishing spot here, making it a sacred ground for fishing.
1562605:
Tinana's fruit shop is stocked with all kinds of fruits found in the Howling Plains.
Neat-freak Tinana meticulously wipes the fruits displayed on her stall over and over until they gleam.
She then searches for buyers for her polished fruits under the guise of 'perks for a lucky customer'—most residents of Charlulu Village have served as her lucky customer at some point.
1562607:
The village chief usually appears approachable and a bit absent-minded, but is actually a mysterious figure surrounded by various strange rumors.
For instance, some say... if you bring a special seashell to the village chief, you can trade it for rare treasures unavailable anywhere else.
——Could it be true?
1562609:
Records requests from the residents of Charlulu Village, allowing you to accept various request quests in the Charlulu region.
The villagers each harbor troubles and wishes—finding a lost seashell, watching over a Kibo companion so they can nap in peace... Such trivial wishes are registered at the request board, awaiting someone to lend a helping hand. Fulfilling requests naturally earns you heartfelt rewards as well. If you have time, it's worth stopping by.
1562610: Kibo Fight is not merely a competition of techniques, but also a venue to reaffirm the bond between humanity and Kibo. In fights, participants listen to each other's voices and refine their tactics through mutual understanding, while also illuminating the paths each should tread.
1562613: Lakes and wetlands formed by alpine snowmelt. The water flow is gentle, surrounded by an elegant environment and enveloped in a peaceful, comforting atmosphere. It is an ideal habitat for Kibo, and many of Fleece's native Kibo are born here.
1562616:
Deep within the forest dwell numerous mysterious Kibo amidst dense, towering trees. Ordinary folk who carelessly wander in will immediately lose their way.
It is said that paths inside the forest lead to the High Elf domain, but without the ability to discern mazes and perceive mysteries, finding the realm of the elves is difficult.
1562617: Scars of War - Astral Vein Node
1562618: Once, two mighty nations clashed here, forever altering the topography. Floating rocks, shattered earth, and ceaseless colossal storms... all seem to speak of how ferocious the war of that era was.
1562628:
Records the wishes of Fleece's residents, allowing you to accept various request quests within and outside the city-state.
From cargo contracts lost by outland merchants and requests from sheriffs asking for help dealing with suspicious figures appearing in the wild, to troubles encountered by certain Kibo...
In this city-state that values freedom and contracts, anyone can post hardships and requests of all sizes on the quest board, awaiting adventurers to extend a helping hand.
Naturally, upon request completion, rewards are paid out as contracted. If you happen to pass by the quest board, it's worth stopping by to take a look.
1562629: Lykoumo is covered in thick fur across its entire body. Although it appears slow and clumsy, its movements are agile and forceful. It usually inhabits high-altitude regions where humans rarely tread.
1562630:
Rumor has it that Ceresia only appears within the 'Golden Land of Abundance' and never steps a foot outside it... but in reality, the opposite is true. Ceresia does not simply inhabit the Golden Land; rather, wherever Ceresia visits transforms into the Golden Land. Because of this, it maintains an extremely cautious attitude regarding its destinations, ensuring that overflowing abundance does not exhaust the land or Astral Vein energy.
'Nectar of Grace' Amaltheia and Ceresia symbolize the two aspects of abundance—'nurturing moisture' and 'resplendent radiance'—and this combination is the origin of Promilia's era names, 'Verdant Era' and 'Brocade Era'.
1562632:
Top 3 on the list of creatures Pammy admire most. Soft downy fur, beautiful caudal fins, and the translucent aqueous light enveloping its entire body evoke a sense of moisture for beholders. It is just like the life-giving rain after a prolonged drought.
Fleece's crops achieving a bountiful harvest every era is primarily thanks to Amaltheia's presence. Amaltheia can utilize Astral Vein energy to return excess nutrients to the land and prevent the occurrence of crop diseases—wherever its tears fall, even barren land can grow crops.
1562633: In the cultures of certain tribes that worship fire or revere strength, Flamerraga is regarded as the 'incarnation of the trial of fire', serving as a symbol of strength, courage, and destruction. Valiant warriors of such tribes actively seek out Flamerraga to engage in combat (or be defeated by it) to prove their courage, even if it often means their own demise.

A shop opened by Lilica, a Pammy seed vendor stationed at the farm, selling a variety of seeds.
Resourceful and clever, Lilica not only has an abundant selection of seeds but is also well-versed in cultivation knowledge.
Busy with various tasks around the farmland every day, Lilica never forgets the dream hidden in her heart—to work together with Starborn to make this farm in the hidden valley the best in the continent and host a grand agricultural expo.

Similar complaints are constantly being sent to the Adventurer's Guild. It seems Outamitt loves picking up weeds that emit a pungent odor and wrapping them around its body. Whichever farmland it sets foot on, the owners invariably make the same request—drive it away as soon as possible.
<color=#bd5576>(Includes a [Matchmaking] judgment. Handle it well to potentially increase your bond value with "Outamitt".)</color>
1658569: To pass the exam, Xiaoyu must work hard on her training. At the same time, she has to worry about the weight issue her grandma keeps nagging her about...
1658570: Xiaoyu was racking her brain. How could she lose weight without reducing the amount of Peach Blossom Pastries she ate... Just then, a cry for help came from somewhere.
1658571: Seeing the Moflyne in trouble, Xiaoyu decided to help it out.
1658572: The rescued Moflyne floated up in front of Xiaoyu and affectionately rubbed its body against her hand to show its gratitude...
1658573: Xiaoyu gathered her dharma power, raised her hand, and prepared to cast a spell... But before she could unleash the spell, she was struck by a severe bout of dizziness...
1658574: It seems she lacked enough dharma power and reverted to her fox form. On top of that, her tail got stuck in the crack of a roadside stone!
1658575: With things coming to this, rather than helping the Moflyne, Xiaoyu herself could only wait for a Starborn to come rescue her...
1658576: Using her hands and feet, Xiaoyu scrambled up to the top of the tree...
1658577: Before her hand could reach the Moflyne, Xiaoyu's weight snapped the branch, and she plummeted straight to the ground.
1658578: Though Xiaoyu took a tumble, the broken branch allowed the Moflyne to escape safely. The Moflyne floated up in front of Xiaoyu and affectionately rubbed its body against her hand to show its gratitude...
1658579: Having played to her heart's content all afternoon, Xiaoyu felt refreshed in both body and mind. If anything, her spellcasting skills seemed to have improved a little...
1658580: However, Xiaoyu suddenly realized... she could no longer manifest her human form! Watching the Moflyne's shadow drift far away, Xiaoyu couldn't even call out...
1658581: By dusk, she was dizzy with hunger... Her dharma power finally ran out, allowing her to manifest her form again.
1658582: Quick-witted, Xiaoyu transformed into a little fox and leaped straight into a tree hollow.
1658583: Just as she was celebrating her supposedly perfect hiding spot, her tail was grabbed firmly by the Moflyne!
1658584: Turns out, because Xiaoyu had gained weight, her fox body was still sticking halfway out of the hole!
1658585: Not only that, Xiaoyu's dharma power had increased significantly!
1658586: Constant dropping wears away a stone! Heaven does not abandon those who try! After overcoming hardships, her efforts finally paid off! Hard work bears fruit! Xiaoyu immediately decided to bring the Starborn along to celebrate grandly.
1658587: How could this be... I gained weight AGAINNNN!!!!!
1658588: Oh, it's just a Monya kept by someone else. No wonder it was acting so cute by the roadside just to beg for treats!
1658589: On a moonless night, amid howling winds, beneath the flickering shadows of trees, Xiaoyu finally caught the elusive culprit—and it was actually a Waokey!
1658590: The moment it was about to be caught, instead of running away, the Waokey started doing a cute dance right in front of Isabella.
1658591: A drunken mercenary clung onto Bruda and refused to let go no matter what...
1658592: Oh, a skinny Calabekko has sneaked into the line! This is bad... Grenade is taking an aggressive stance against the Calabekko!
1658593: Similar complaints are constantly being sent to the Adventurer's Guild. It seems Outamitt loves picking up weeds that emit a pungent odor and wrapping them around its body. Whichever farmland it sets foot on, the owners invariably make the same request—drive it away as soon as possible.
1658594: Hearing that Xiaoyu was a celestial fox skilled in matchmaking, the writer Amy specially came to seek guidance. Amy is currently drafting a story about a man and a woman falling in love at first sight due to a chance encounter. To express the bond of "fate" between them, what kind of staging should she use...?
1658595: The stalwart mercenary was deeply moved when he laid eyes on that plush toy. It was the toy he cherished above all else during his childhood. After all, he chose the profession of a mercenary precisely to protect this cute, fragile plush toy! He expressed his heartfelt gratitude to Xiaoyu for retrieving the plush toy for him. It just goes to show that what looks like useless junk to some can be an irreplaceable treasure to someone else.

Unearthed from the brownish soil, the light of Ulu wrapped it in a golden radiance.
A devout shaman offered it to the campfire, and the sound of songs and drums echoed to the ends of the heavens.
Searing flames danced up into the night sky, and the voice of the great divine spirit whispered along with the smoke—
From distant Sogatar to Puche, vast waters bind heaven and earth.
The doors of heaven opened and spilled forth, deeply buried for countless ages.
The roar of the sky gave it sharp cracks. This is a favor from Tana.
The fire of Aura at the edge of the clouds bestowed upon it a shining outer shell. That is the gift of Duya.
Grasp it in the palm of your hand.
Hang it above the gate.
When the wind blows through, you will naturally hear the sounds of distant ages.

1658795: Good work, Maple. From now on, you'll probably be visiting the Adventurer's Guild and Kibo Fight Association often, so I look forward to working with you!
1658796:
Thanks to the power of the jade bi guarded by Father and everyone, I was able to survive in this world. Earlier, I mentioned that memories of the past sustained me, but the truth is, there were times when I lost my way as well. I kept wondering what on earth I survived for... I just couldn't figure it out. If Father had known that, he surely would have deeply regretted it and beat his breast in sorrow.
However, the current me wishes to stand proudly before Father alongside you and tell him, "I'm doing well."
The wounds of the past still ache, but the time spent with you has transformed into memories more than enough to heal all wounds. And I believe that the meaning of continuing to exist in this world is something we can figure out together from now on.
Is this what it feels like to be given a new lease on life?

Maple is the receptionist for the Adventurer's Guild and a guide for the Kibo Fight Association, so guiding newcomers down the right path is my most important job meow!

Ralappo can adjust its body size by absorbing moisture and lightning from the air. When it absorbs moisture, its body expands roundly, lowering its floating speed while increasing stability. Conversely, when discharging electricity, its body shrinks slightly and its speed increases. Its figure streaks across the night sky like a nimble flash of lightning.

1661906:
Ever since she was helped by Xiaoyu, that Moflyne has occasionally started coming over to play near Xiaoyu.
One day, shaking its ears, the Moflyne invited Xiaoyu to a game of hide-and-seek.
<color=#bd5576>（[Prowess] check available. Can increase the bond value with 'Moflyne'.）</color>
1661907:
After playing with the Moflyne for a few days, Xiaoyu noticed something astonishing... Why, her own weight had decreased!
That wasn't all. Xiaoyu's Prowess had also improved significantly!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Prowess] check. Increases the bond value with 'Moflyne'.）</color>
1661908:
By the roadside, someone was wandering around anxiously, muttering something. "This isn't it... Not here either... Won't somebody help me!"
——It's the forgetful Chris. Because he forgets his keys every time he goes out, he hides a spare key under a stone in front of his house, but this time it seems he forgot which stone he hid it under.
At a time like this, the future Immortal Fox-sama could hardly just turn a blind eye.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Courage] checks. Please prepare properly before challenging.）</color>
1661909:
At the airship dock, Bella was pacing about with a sorrowful expression. She sighed with every step. When she heard that Xiaoyu could resolve troubles related to 'Bonds', Bella's eyes lit up.
<color=#bd5576>（Perhaps you can deepen your bond with Bella.）</color>
1661910:
Two women stood close together, whispering softly.
Building a bridge of understanding between Kibo and humans is also part of Xiaoyu's duties. Let's gather some courage and speak to them!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks.）</color>
1661911:
Shiroro's path was blocked.
Her opponents were two mercenaries as sturdy as city gates.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight], [Courage], and [Bonding] checks. If handled properly, your bond value with 'Shiroro' may increase.）</color>
1661912:
Crispy cake——Crispy cake——
Lured by the calls, Xiaoyu went to investigate, but it seemed the owner of the cake stall wasn't hawking their wares after all...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks. If handled well, your bonds with others may increase.）</color>
1661913:
Xiaoyu, the Immortal Fox who resolves troubles tied to 'Bonds'. Right now, she has become quite famous in Fleece, known as 'Immortal Fox-sama' to the point where letters asking for help even reach her.
<color=#bd5576>（[Insight], [Courage], and [Bonding] attributes will increase.）</color>
1661914:
With her face contorted in terror and as pale as a sheet, Isabella rushed into the Adventurer's Guild.
It seems that over the past few days, something eerie has been placed in front of her house. A 'suspicious object of a bizarre shape', a 'suspicious object with a strange smell', and even a 'suspicious object that is still wriggling'...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Courage] checks. If handled properly, your bond with Isabella may increase.）</color>
1661915:
Holding a bouquet of flowers, Joyce stood in front of the farm shed. He slowly knocked on the door and confessed his love with all his heart, but a scream came from the other side of the door——"Go away!"
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks.）</color>
1661916:
Liz studied abroad in Symphoria for a year, and upon returning home, found that her family house had been demolished. Her parents seem to have moved, but she wasn't told where their new home is...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Bonding] and [Insight] checks. If handled well, your bond with 'Liz' may deepen.）</color>
1661917:
A drunken mercenary clung tightly to a single Bluuda and refused to let go...
"Hey, mercenary... You've been staring at me since earlier... Are you picking a fight?!"
<color=#bd5576>（Expected to increase [Courage], [Bonding], and [Insight] attributes.）</color>
1661918:
As Xiaoyu walked down the path, her path was suddenly blocked by a furious girl. The person she hated apparently moved away without saying a word. Xiaoyu surely knows how to track down that person and help clear the girl's mind!
<color=#bd5576>（[Insight] and [Bonding] attributes will increase.）</color>
1661919:
"Hey, you there, 'Immortal Fox', wait a moment."
An arrogant voice called out to Xiaoyu. It seems there was a minor quarrel between Henrietta and her childhood sweetheart whom she has feelings for. The other person is depressed, unable to eat, and can't fall asleep either.
<color=#bd5576>（[Insight], [Bonding], and [Courage] attributes will increase.）</color>
1661920:
Amidst the pouring rain, a girl holding a Frogure walked listlessly through the streets. She kept muttering something...
<color=#bd5576>（[Bonding], [Prowess], and [Stamina] attributes will increase.）</color>
1661921:
A red-haired lady visited Xiaoyu with a worried expression. She and her husband had lived closely together in harmony for a long time. However, yesterday while cleaning, she found a single portrait hidden away deep inside her husband's bookcase.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight], [Bonding], and [Courage] checks. Please prepare properly before challenging.）</color>
1661922:
A boy in deep distress rushed over to Xiaoyu. The other day, he rescued an injured Starmiy by the roadside, but...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Bonding] and [Insight] checks. Please prepare properly before challenging.）</color>
1661923:
Suddenly, a strong wind blew past. When Xiaoyu casually glanced at her feet, 10 unis had fallen there unawares.
Over this unexpected windfall, Xiaoyu fell into contemplation for a moment.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] test. If handled well, your [Bonding] attribute may increase.）</color>
1661924:
Xiaoyu recently learned some romance techniques. The trick is to give a wool felt doll modeled after yourself to the person you care about, making them constantly remember you.
There's no time like the present! Xiaoyu enthusiastically kept moving her needle, but ran out of wool halfway through. Thus, Xiaoyu pondered what she should do next...
<color=#bd5576>（Increases the bond value with 'Starborn' and raises [Courage], [Bonding], and [Insight] attributes.）</color>
1661925:
Grenade was distributing delicious wheat grains to Grainy and the others.
Oh no, a thin Karabekko accidentally slipped into the line! This is bad... Grenade is showing a hostile stance toward the Karabekko!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] test. Please prepare properly before challenging.）</color>
1661926:
When Han Youyou came to visit, Xiaoyu was holding her head in her hands over a letter from Grandma...
<color=#bd5576>（Increases your bond with 'Han Youyou'. You might receive an unexpected harvest.）</color>
1661927:
Similar complaints have been continuously pouring into the Adventurer's Guild. It appears that Oatamit loves collecting weeds that emit an intense stench and wrapping them around its body. Whichever farmland it sets foot on, the owners invariably make the same request——drive it away as soon as possible.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] check. If handled well, your bond value with 'Oatamit' may increase.）</color>
1661928:
From deep within the forest came a heartbreaking cry. Glancing toward the source of the voice, Xiaoyu saw a woman dressed in Symphorian attire covering her face and weeping bitterly. Words leaked from her lips like "What should I do... It's so painful... To think I can never go back..."
It seems the woman is troubled by matters of the heart. Xiaoyu is confident in solving such problems. Let's hurry over and speak with her!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] check. If you play your cards right, your bond with others may increase.）</color>
1661929:
At the ranch, Julian was watering the crops.
Spotting Xiaoyu, she ran over with excitement beaming on her face! Julian had heard from a friend about Xiaoyu's ability, 'Matchmaking'. Desperate to forge a bond with the person of her heart, she earnestly begged Xiaoyu to help her!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] check. Increases your bond with Julian.）</color>
1661930:
Xiaoyu was training by the shores of Melt Lake. While executing the 'Willow-Sweeping Wind' form, her fan slipped from her hand, tracing a beautiful arc before tumbling straight into the lake with a plop... making a distinct splash.
Right then, a wet head popped up from the surface of the lake——it's a Frogure! In its mouth it held a gem fan, in its left webbed foot a peach blossom fan, and in its right webbed foot a pure gold fan. The Frogure gazed intently at Xiaoyu, as if waiting for some important words...
<color=#bd5576>（[Mood], [Insight], [Prowess], and [Bonding] attributes will increase.）</color>
1661931:
Gazing intently at the surface of Melt Lake, Xiaoyu came up with a bold idea——could that Frogure that appeared with three fans actually be the legendary lake god often found in stories?
If it really is a lake god, throwing something in is bound to get you even more things in return... I have to try it!
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase [Prowess] and [Bonding] stats, and raise the bond value with 'Starborn'.）</color>
1661932:
To think there actually is a lake god in Melt Lake!? Such a wondrous event must be reported to Komugi!
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase [Stamina], as well as raise [Prowess] and [Insight] stats, and increase the bond value with 'Frogure'.）</color>
1661933:
Known as an Immortal Fox skilled in helping people through matchmaking. Amy, an author, visited her to brainstorm ideas for a story. Wanting to write a plot where the protagonist and heroine meet by chance and fall in love at first sight, Amy was racking her brain over what kind of episodes to write to express the 'bond' between the two...
<color=#bd5576>（Increases your bond with 'Amy'.）</color>
1661934:
The work written based on the idea Xiaoyu provided last time was a massive success. The story of the protagonist and heroine deeply moved readers. Thus, Amy cheerfully visited Xiaoyu once again. This time, the two characters were temporarily separated due to a misunderstanding, and she wondered how the plot should proceed from here...
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Amy'.）</color>
1661935:
Amy's novel was a huge hit, and her mailbox is overflowing with letters from readers eagerly demanding a continuation! Therefore, she made a special visit to express her gratitude to Xiaoyu...!
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Amy'.）</color>
1661936:
A request was posted by Carnon Sanitarium. To soothe the minds of those suffering from illness, they requested an event to be planned.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Matchmaking] checks. [Insight] and [Bonding] attribute values will increase.）</color>
1661938:
Interacting with people of different personalities and learning to adapt your speech accordingly—this is also one of the ways to train your 'Matchmaking' ability.
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Maple'.）</color>
1661939:
After paying 888 unis to hire someone to visit his ancestors' graves, the gravesite turned out to be completely wrong!
The client, living far away in the land of the Chen Dynasty, was furious. He personally visited Fleece and submitted a request to the Adventurer's Guild to track down his true ancestors' graves.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Bonding] and [Insight] checks.）</color>
1661940:
A request came into the Adventurer's Guild: to transport 10,000 unis to the Lampblack Mine. The client was feeling uneasy about going alone.
There seemed to be more to this request than meets the eye. Maple asked Xiaoyu to investigate this matter in detail, but...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks.）</color>
1661941:
Today, there was a long queue at the entrance of the Adventurer's Guild. It seemed many people were lining up to submit requests.
Just as Xiaoyu was checking what kind of requests she could take, an angry Emily grabbed her arm.
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Maple'.）</color>
1661942:
The Lost and Found box at the Adventurer's Guild is on the verge of exploding. Maple asked Xiaoyu for help. If the owners can be found, that too will form a wonderful 'bond'—
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Maple'.）</color>
1661943:
Xiaoyu recently learned many useful skills from Terara. According to a book she read, you should share a 'desire to share' with your beloved. Xiaoyu couldn't help but want to do these fun and meaningful things together with the Starborn!
<color=#bd5576>（Increases your bond with the Starborn.）</color>
1661944:
Terara, an exceptional hunter, brought back a bunch of strange mushrooms from the field! Want to try one?
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Courage], [Bonding], and [Insight] checks.）</color>
1661945:
Terara says that a brave hunter should wield easy-to-handle weapons! But Xiaoyu already has her own exclusive fan... No, no, Terara insists that just isn't imposing enough!
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Terara'.）</color>
1661946:
While accompanying Terara on training, Xiaoyu and she happened to talk about grooming tail fur. The two hit it off completely and chatted cheerfully about this and that.
<color=#bd5576>（Increases the bond value with 'Terara'.）</color>
1661947:
In the bustling street, a blushing boy blocked Terara's path, muttering things like, "You can't even speak the common tongue... and your status is low..." Terara was left utterly confused upon hearing this. Could he be here to pick a quarrel?
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Terara'.）</color>
1661948:
Symphoria recently spotted several strange pairs of men and women in the cafeteria. She vaguely sensed the complex and inscrutable emotional entanglements between them, but didn't know how to advise them. Just then, to solve this difficult problem, Komugi introduced Xiaoyu to her!
<color=#bd5576>(Includes checks for [Bond] and [Insight])</color>
1661949:
Requests to the Adventurer's Guild are surging! Komugi introduced Xiaoyu to Maple to help fulfill requests. This is sure to forge new bonds...
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Komugi'.）</color>
1661950:
Early in the morning, a somewhat burnt smell drifted through the kitchen of the Lord's Manor.
Cathbelle held a golden-brown baked maple syrup pancake, while Nanacha held a salted meat sandwich whose savory aroma tickled the nose, glaring at each other with sparks flying.
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Komugi'.）</color>
1661951:
Lately in the streets of Fleece, a rumor has been the talk of the town. The contents of newly published stories by two romance novelists living in Fleece and Symphoria bear a striking resemblance to each other. What is the meaning of this... could one of them be plagiarizing?
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks.）</color>
1661952:
Hanging at the entrance of Louisa's house are homemade salted fish. When she returned home one day, she found a fruit-flavored salted fish recipe left behind by a kind-hearted person. When Louisa tried out that recipe, it turned out far more delicious than her own!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] tests.）</color>
1661953:
Superior insight is not only reflected in keeping a sharp eye on everyone's every move, but also clearly demonstrated in reverse-tracking capability.
Today, through a game of hide-and-seek, Symphoria is going to test just how much Xiaoyu has honed her reverse-tracking skills!
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the bond value with 'Symphoria'.）</color>
1661954:
Symphoria brought a reward for Xiaoyu after a day of rigorous training! Colorful candies, which one should you choose?
Wait. Could this actually be... a test of Xiaoyu's insight?
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Courage] tests.）</color>
1661955:
After finishing her daily practice, Xiaoyu was walking through the streets of Fleece when she suddenly stopped. Closing her eyes, she could clearly sense the surrounding 'bonds'. Those bonds intertwined among the passing people, connecting every corner of the city.
Has her 'Matchmaking' ability improved by leaps and bounds? Xiaoyu decided to find someone to test it out on.
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase the [Bonding] stat.）</color>
1661956:
Troubled Jerry came to visit Xiaoyu.
In the morning forest, he caught sight of a certain beautiful figure. The dancing of that person amidst the morning fog had a powerful resonance, and their flowing hair was cool and neat. Jerry fell in love at first sight...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks.）</color>

"Lord Senko!" a small voice called out to stop Xiaoyu. It was that girl by the banks of Melt Lake who had mistaken Xiaoyu for a "pudding." However, since Xiaoyu was now in her human form, there was no way the girl could recognize her.

1661990: "Xiaoyu once witnessed a pair whose fate was tangled because "a single rare Kibo caused both sets of parents to have a massive falling out and cut ties." Those two overcame the family feud and finally united. Hearing Xiaoyu's story, Amy felt inspired and expressed her thanks over and over."
1661991: "Xiaoyu had heard tales of a bound pair who "trusted one another and helped each other overcome a crisis while trapped deep within a desperate labyrinth"... That story sounds kind of familiar, though?"
1661992: "Xiaoyu remembered the two bound individuals she had helped before. It was a tale where "after being separated, the woman applied herself to her studies while the man devoted himself to trade, and two years later, both reached the pinnacle of their respective worlds and met again." Hearing Xiaoyu's story, Amy felt inspired and expressed her thanks over and over."
1661993: "Xiaoyu recalled a pair connected by fate. "Loving each other dearly without any lingering grudges, spending every day simply eating sweet peach blossom cakes together—that is the greatest happiness of all~"... Hm? That sounds somewhat familiar."
1661994: "Xiaoyu rallied Starborn and other companions to put on a lively and bustling theatrical play. All the patients in the venue watched with great enjoyment."
1661995: "In accordance with everyone's requests, Xiaoyu divided the patients into groups and arranged different events for each. The very next day, a total of 72 flags and banners praising Xiaoyu were delivered to the Adventurer's Guild."
1661996: "Acrobatics, magic tricks, songs, and dances were performed one after another, and all the patients in the audience watched with delight."
1661997: "Searching for a grave... isn't that pretty much the same thing as matchmaking, nya♪"
1661998: "A request came into the Adventurer's Guild. Someone wanted 10,000 Uni transported to the Lampblack Mine. The client was apparently uneasy about heading there alone."
1661999: "Following persuasion and logical analysis by Maple, Xiaoyu, and Shiroro, the client finally confessed. They had prayed to a certain spiritualist to ward off misfortune, and that person told them, "It is an oracle from the gods. Unless you offer a custom limited-edition bag worth 10,000 Uni as a tribute, your wish will not be granted." Since the client couldn't get their hands on the limited bag by themselves, they figured giving that money to the spiritualist would achieve the same effect..."
1662000: "Grubby, smelly, and nothing to catch the eye... yet to its owner, it might hold special significance. Summoning the full power of her "Bonds," Xiaoyu finally managed to track down the owner of the lost item!"
1662002: "Kneading black mud and smearing it all over your tail?! That sounds super shady..."
1662003: "Symphoria had recently spotted several strange couples at the cafeteria. She vaguely sensed the complex and baffling emotional entanglements between them, but didn't know how to advise them. Just then, Komugi introduced Xiaoyu to her to help solve this tricky problem!"
1662004: "When Xiaoyu probed the bonds, she noticed traces indicating that the connections between everyone had been disrupted by someone. It seemed a mastermind was pulling strings behind the scenes..."
1662005: "That has got to be a scam! As the mercenary realized the situation and moved to catch the fraudulent spiritualist—while the swindler was busy stuffing his face with roasted meat, he had already vanished..."
1662007: "Symphoria brought a reward for Xiaoyu after a day of rigorous training! Colorful candies—which one should she pick?"
1662009: "Finding a Ponilo, Jerry's eyes lit up as she passionately performed the dance she excelled at."
1662010: "It seemed there were no traces of Jerry's intended "person" to be found. Jerry departed the scene with a sorrowful look..."
1662011: "The girl asked Xiaoyu for help. In life, her grandmother had been close with an extremely rare spirit fox Kibo of some sort, and that Kibo would often visit their yard to sunbathe, play around, and share delicious treats..."

<size=26>◆Shopping Tips◆</size>
<size=24>During her travels, Chiyo can purchase various practical items at the travel shop.
Make good use of your "Funds" while keeping future "Debts" in mind to
further strengthen Chiyo, earn more sortie points, and get a higher prize money!</size>

<size=26>◆Meimei House◆</size>
<size=24>Chiyo can purchase 1 "Sweets" item and 1 "Dishes" item daily at "Meimei House".
They are delicious, but be careful not to overeat~

"Sweets" and "Dishes" restore Chiyo's concentration and
may also grant additional buffs.</size>

<size=26>◆Colorful Parade Troupe◆</size>
<size=24>The "Colorful Parade Troupe" sells Pariri's mystical blessings and items,
and you can also watch various wonderful stories performed by Pammy and others.

Chiyo can make purchases here any number of times.

Items from the "Colorful Parade Troupe" boost Chiyo's stats and
may also grant a short-term "Fortuitous Encounter".</size>

<size=26>◆Fleece Market◆</size>
<size=24>The "Fleece Market" sells various training facilities and items,
and Chiyo can purchase items here any number of times.

These items are expensive, but if the Starborn acts as a guarantor, Chiyo can pay a small down payment first,
with the remaining balance paid after the next trial.

Market goods boost the effectiveness of Chiyo's daily training and

1662319:
We live in the world of "Things of Substance". However, mystery is by no means distant. For instance, last night or the night before, prayers to Tana were surely offered somewhere in this vast land. Ancestral prayers continue to be passed down as everyday sorcery... but these never reach the true realm. Elements are the root of all things and what drives the world. As flowing energy, elements are constantly changing. In the world of tangible things, elements flow, circulate, and interact with one another, breaking the silence of life and forming the principles that govern the world.

Through communion with nature, souls, and spirits, we have perceived the elements of Water, Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning, Wind, and Grass. Vegetation speaks not, resisting the raging wind with branches, leaves, and roots. Yet it cannot withstand the harsh ice and snow or the fires that scorch the fields. The earth sustains all things, and distant mountains and hills swallow oncoming lightning and wildfires without blinking, yet they can hardly resist gales and floods. Gales whip the soil into dust, and floods soak the earth into mud. Blazing fire melts ice, and the melted water extinguishes the flame... Such phenomena are proof that nature possesses the wisdom to maintain equilibrium amidst the contact, fusion, separation, and destruction of elements, generously displaying its mysteries.

As for Light and Darkness, they are considered an organic force distinct from these seven elements. They are bestowed incessantly from the heavens, opposing yet two sides of the same coin.

In the natural world, there are also entities that derive from none of the known elements and possess weaknesses against none of them. Thus, we have classified them under the "Null" element. Perhaps one day, the day will come when the source of that power is unraveled and the veil of mystery is lifted.
1662320:
(1)
Uncle Adaya has been coughing a lot lately. The village mofungas suddenly increased, and there are many more Kibo to take care of, so he got sick from working too much.
Big sister told me, "Go help out at the beast house starting tomorrow." She said I have to take care of the Kibo in Uncle Adaya's place.
Sigh... This is going to be a bit of a hassle.

(2)
Mofungas are actually pretty cute.
When I went to visit Uncle Adaya today, he ended up leaving a mofunga in my care. He asked me to look after it until he gets better.
Its eyes are round and blinking, and when I touch the fluffy fur around its neck, it feels soft yet chilly... Is this what touching snow feels like? Though I've never seen snow.
Uncle Adaya told me to give it a name.
I thought about naming it "Snok" for a second, but it sounded lame, so I settled on "Snowga" in the end.
Starting today, I'm Snowga's caretaker. I just hope it's not too much trouble.

(3)
I saw Snowga make wind with its tail...
Today, I tried to take a nap in an empty spot, but it was way too hot to sleep.
After tossing and turning forever, a cool breeze started blowing. When I opened my eyes, Snowga was waving its tail quickly to fan me... It felt so nice, I fell fast asleep right then and there.
Taking care of Snowga might not be so bad after all.

(4)
I'm so tired today. Snowga has way too much energy... It ran around and wrecked a cabard's nest, and it brought back a yuranago instead of the branch I threw...
I can't take it anymore, I'm too tired to write.

(5)
I brought over another Kibo from the village to play with Snowga, hoping it would give me a break... But the moment I let my guard down, they all ran off. While Uncle Adaya and I were searching everywhere, a wild schnelf showed up... Even though Snowga was hurt, it tried to protect everyone. When a schnelf charged right at me, it leaped in to protect me too...
Uncle Adaya went (...) to (...) for treatment. I hope he gets (...) better soon. I'm sorry, and thank you...
(*The last paragraph is smudged with water and illegible*)

(6)
Big sister asked me if I wanted to "Starlink" with Snowga like Terara and Lulu.
I told her "no."
I'm not interested in fighting, and I have my own way of living.
"Starlink" is important, but Snowga is an important friend of mine even without that kind of bond.

1662325:
[Special Article] Visiting Fleece During the Golden Spike Carnival
Olman Punkuck
As you know, the Golden Spike Carnival is a trade festival held in Fleece every two moons. During this period, merchant guilds from Fleece, the Chen Dynasty, the Rosia Empire, Avarian, and elsewhere bring high-quality goods to Fleece to display and sell throughout the Golden Spike Carnival.
The history of the Golden Spike Carnival dates back to ancient times.
According to legend, when Fleece's ancestors arrived in this land, it was still an unnamed wilderness sandwiched between three nations. Together with their Starlinked Kibo, they cultivated this land with steady character and diligent labor, gradually accumulating wealth by trading harvests with neighboring countries, transforming this small land into a trade hub spanning far beyond just the three nations.
Today's Fleece residents do not worry about basic living necessities like food and clothing; rather, as masters of this open city, they welcome merchant guilds and tourists from all across the continent. Moreover, to praise the wisdom and diligence of their ancestors, the people of Fleece established a day in the harvest season as the Golden Spike Carnival. The Golden Spike Carnival is not merely a memorial to ancestors, but also a symbol of longing and expectation for a prosperous and happy life. The sight of golden wheat spikes swaying in the wind seems to retell Fleece's story, irresistibly drawing people into the charm of this land. Over time, the Golden Spike Carnival has become an important part of Fleece's culture, with countless tourists visiting Fleece to experience the carnival.
If you visit Fleece during the Golden Spike Carnival, the "Special Auction" is an absolute must-see.
Grandly hosted by the Lord on the final day of the carnival, the Special Auction is the carnival's climax and its most thrilling event. Merchant guilds and independent merchant organizations from various countries pour all their efforts into preparing top-tier items for this auction. Items carefully selected by merchants are preregistered and await bidding.
Upon entering the preview period, all registered items become the center of attention. People eagerly examine the exhibits and thoroughly research information such as quality and historical background. Buyers and those interested in the items are free to browse and decide whether to participate in the auction. This process gives people an opportunity to compare and consider goods while serving as a crucial phase for participants to determine their bidding strategies.
During the main Special Auction, registered items are put up for sale one after another, appearing before the people as auction lots. A tense and passionate bidding session begins as buyers compete to secure their desired items. The auctioneer's swift hand gestures, passionate price-raising shouts, and ever-changing prices form a scene full of power and excitement. Every single bid has the potential to change the overall flow of the auction, and participants hope to seize victory in this battle of wits and courage.
Throughout the entire auction process, the venue was enveloped in passion and tension, with people watching every step closely. The Lord supervises proceedings with an impartial attitude to ensure fairness. Once the auction concludes, successful bidders depart in satisfaction, while those who failed to win gain new insights from the process.
Serving as the grand finale of the carnival, the Special Auction is not only the carnival's climax, but also a venue for all participants to showcase their strength and talent.
[From the Editorial Department]
If you wish to set off for Fleece right now, please send your application form to the "Lonely Land" editorial department via the Pammy Post Office. Our representative will review the content and contact you regarding joining the expedition. Don't miss the Golden Spike Carnival!
1662326:
[Tales of the Three Kibo]
Deep within a distant forest lived three cute Kibo. Foundey, Skrain, and Gurmank—these three Kibo were the guardians of this land, each possessing special wisdom and power.
Foundey had a gentle personality and was a friend to all the forest Kibo. Skrain was great at saving, always gathering food while building the coziest nest. Gurmank possessed super strength, protecting weaker companions and giving everyone peace of mind.
One day, a powerful Kibo suddenly came to the forest and loudly declared, "I will build a kingdom in this forest. All Kibo shall live in this kingdom. This kingdom is a country of 99 stairs. The Kibo on the 99th step shall clean, the Kibo on the 63rd step shall tend the fire, and the Kibo on the 24th step shall paint portraits. I shall sit on a down duvet on the 1st step and gaze upon an ever-prospering country."
Hearing this, the forest Kibo became uneasy and asked Foundey, Skrain, and Gurmank for help. The three gathered Kibo started a strategy meeting.
Skrain flicked its tail and said, "Let's make our nests sturdy and create a safe place for everyone to live."
Gurmank patted its chest and said, "With this strength, I will protect all Kibo!"
Foundey blinked and proposed a plan: "First, let's observe this uninvited guest and see if they truly bring prosperity to this land."
After a period of observation and probing, the three Kibo realized something: while that outsider Kibo possessed power and ambition, they also harbored a desire to be "respected" and "accepted." So everyone decided to give them an opportunity to become part of this land. Foundey announced, "You may live here, but you must abide by our rules so that all Kibo can live freely and happily."
Upon hearing this, the outsider Kibo thought for a long time before finally accepting the proposal. The outsider Kibo promised to follow the rules and live peacefully alongside the other Kibo.
Thus, a kingdom was born in the forest, but this was not the kingdom of any specific Kibo. There were no social hierarchies in this kingdom, and every Kibo willingly contributed their strength to this land. Thanks to everyone protecting this beautiful forest together, the land became increasingly prosperous and wonderful.
1662327:
[Melo's Tale]
In a distant land lived a Mellowme named Melo. With pure white fur and large eyes, she was always full of curiosity about everything around her.
However, Melo had a small trouble. Whenever the wind blew strongly in the forest, she would always get scared and hide inside a tree hollow, unable to come out.
One day, a strong gale suddenly swept through the forest, bending branches and scattering leaves. Melo tightly closed her eyes in fear, curled up inside the hollow, and thought, "Strong wind... at this rate, I might get blown away along with my nest."
Then she heard a rhythmic knocking sound. "Melo, Melo, let's go take a walk in the forest," called Melo's friend, the Melorid Nya, inviting her out to play.
Melo actually wanted to go, but she was terrified of the sound of the wind outside. Cringing deeper into her nest, she answered through the door, "But the wind outside is so strong. Let's do it another time..."
Nya shook her head and walked away with a waddling gait.
After a while, another knock was heard. Soon after, a pleasant voice reached her from outside the door. It was Melo's friend, the Morkyn Pupp. "Melo, let's go out! Today is a great day for an outing!"
Melo repeated the same answer she had given Nya earlier. But Pupp said, "I'm a Morkyn too, and I don't worry about getting blown away by the wind. What on earth are you so worried about?" However, those words couldn't dispel Melo's anxiety. Pupp had no choice but to go out alone.
Melo stayed cooped up in the tree hollow all by herself. It was a bit boring, but she didn't have to worry about being blown away by the wind. Thus the afternoon passed, and as evening approached, the sound of the wind finally stopped. Melo hopped happily out of the tree hollow and headed toward her two friends waiting in the forest.
Yet just as her friends came into view in the distance, the wind started blowing again. Melo panicked and was about to head back into the tree hollow when Pupp shouted loudly from behind: "Melo, look over there!"
Looking in the direction Pupp pointed, she saw a flock of Windel—the forest wind had been their mischief all along!
Relieved, Melo stopped in her tracks. Nya and Pupp rushed over to Melo's side, and the three little companions played happily together for a long time, feeling very blessed.
Melo, in particular, had more fun than ever before. For the first time, she realized that the things she had been afraid of all this time were actually no big deal at all.

1662332: Author's Note: "Cheshire Bat's Bedtime Fairy Tales" is a story collection that appeared approximately four hundred Suo ago, allegedly burned as a banned book during a certain era. Consequently, only a few fragments have been passed down to posterity. The stories depicted within it are exaggerated interpretations of Kibo's real-world behavior. Unlike intelligent races, Kibo should not have subjective speculation and imagination overly appended to their study. However, the author believes such works still possess value and can be collected as a literary genre. Therefore, I traveled across the continent to compile them into a single volume and republish them. Indeed, telling these as bedtime stories to children is not recommended, but interested Kibo researchers and story enthusiasts will surely find entirely different hypotheses and possibilities hidden within. I Became a Greaterg--"Stuffing grain, stuffing grain, my belly is stuffed and making a racket. Schnelf comes and swallows me up, no escape, no place to hide." That was the fattest and plumpest Greaterg in the entire world. Its belly was swollen like a balloon, and it stayed cooped up in one spot without moving an inch, unable even to roll over. It was terribly bad-tempered; if there was even a tiny speck of dust on the grain, it would blow all the freshly offered grain away with an angry white puff from its snout. The poor Grenards had to gather clean grain all over again, and running back and forth so frequently wore down their claws. Even so, the Greaterg was not satisfied; with its eyes half-closed, it ordered the trembling Grainies to crawl beneath its rear end, and then crushed them down with all its might. Fearing its power and authority, the Grainies and Grenards served this fattest and plumpest Greaterg without rest. Because of this, everyone grew skinny and thin like water-starved wheat straw. I couldn't understand how everyone could accept such a lifestyle. I looked at the grain in my hand. This was food I had gathered with great difficulty, so why couldn't I eat it and why did I have to offer it to that fat nuisance? I couldn't help myself and asked the Grainies and Grenards nearby: "Why do we have to give our food to it?" The Grainies and Grenards exchanged glances. "That's just how we've always lived." "We're so weak that we can't survive without relying on the Greaterg. He protects us." "In return, we should offer our food to him." They chirped "Ririri" one after another. "But he has never protected us even once! He's just stealing our grain..." Before I could finish speaking, a terrifying howl echoed from afar—it was Schnelf! One, two... Schnelf's voices echoed from all directions, and we were surrounded! I led everyone running back to the Greaterg's territory, hoping to shake off these dangerous predators. But Schnelf pursued relentlessly, showing no intention of letting us go. Even more Grainies and Grenards joined our fleeing group, but the Greaterg remained in place. Was it planning to act as the rearguard? Amidst the Greaterg's tragic screams, Schnelf stopped pursuing. The Greaterg's plump figure was blocked over and over by the tall grass, shrinking rapidly in our field of view. It was obvious to everyone that it wouldn't survive. "See? The Greaterg protected us." A Grenard said to me. The Grainies and Grenards looked very sorrowful. One Grainy said, "I shed a single tear for the Greaterg." Another Grainy said, "As for me, I shed three tears." They gathered around me together. "Now that the Greaterg is gone, what should we do? You are a Grenard who led us away from Schnelf's attack... Please, become our Great King!" Yet I shook my head. "I don't want to become a Greaterg. I don't want to look as fat and lazy as that. Besides, I believe the grain we gather should be shared equally among everyone." They did not reject my proposal and built a new home with me in another wheat field. They listened to me very well. If I said a swing made of wheat leaves should be built in the east, a swing was built in the east; if I said a grain storage room should be in the west, a large storage room was added in the west. Sometimes they would secretly hand over grain. At first, a single Grainy secretly gave me half of its grain, and I thought this was just a token of goodwill and about half of it shouldn't be a problem. But afterward, even the Grenards started offering food, and unable to refuse, I had no choice but to eat that grain. After all, I am a Grenard, so I cannot resist the taste of grain. Gradually, I became lazy and grew fat. My tail grew long and dragging, and finally, I became the fattest and plumpest Greaterg. I grew bad-tempered, and my head felt stuffed to the brim with grain. I puffed out a white breath and roared with my eyes: "Bring me grain! Bring me grain! If you don't bring me grain, I'll put all of you beneath my rear end and crush you!" Like my servants, they devoutly and reverently offered every single grain they harvested to me. Then once again, the sound of Schnelf was heard. One, two... They closed in, tightening the encirclement toward my territory. I wanted to run away quickly, but my body was terribly heavy, my head was too heavy to lift, and my limbs felt as though they had sprouted roots into the ground. The Grainies and Grenards fled at lightning speed from my side, leaving only me unable to move. Only a single Grainy glanced back at me once as it escaped. It said to me— "Dear Greaterg, I shed a single tear for you." (*The ending features a single-line note: Perhaps what truly rules over them is the golden ears of wheat.)
1662333: Preface As intelligent beings, we have unraveled the mysteries of the world in the span of just a few thousand moons—which, of course, is impossible. The continent of Promilia is filled with mysteries far beyond our imagination. Countless secrets slumber there, from the skies to the seas. Recording these secrets and passing them on to the world is the responsibility that the Unsolved Mysteries Editorial Department must shoulder. We hope that one day, these secrets will no longer be "Unsolved Mysteries." People have yet to realize the significance of such records. From time to time, those with vested interests hinder the headquarters' investigations. The printing and publication of the Unsolved Mysteries series have experienced many difficulties, but through the efforts of this editorial department, we have finally been able to compile the series into books. This series is hidden near various "Unsolved Mysteries," falling into the hands of those who seek secrets. The editorial department believes that whoever reaches this book shares the same aspirations and holds a passion for exploration in their heart. Dear readers, please remember that on the path of seeking the truth, the Unsolved Mysteries Editorial Department always walks alongside you. Volume 1: Pammy's Trapdoor …… There was always a small trapdoor in Pammy's Miracle Workshop. Its size was just right for Pammy to pass through; if her body were even slightly larger, she would get stuck and be unable to move. Whether it was Fleece's Pammy's Miracle Workshop, the Chen Dynasty's Pammy's Miracle Workshop, or Rieve's Pammy's Miracle Workshop—any Pammy's Miracle Workshop anywhere in the world possessed this trapdoor, yet no one had ever seen it open. The trapdoor of Pammy's Miracle Workshop was always closed. I once asked the Pammy at the reception desk of Pammy's Miracle Workshop what this trapdoor was for. Then Pammy answered with her classic smile: "Underneath the trapdoor, Pammy's secrets are hidden. Um, do you want to know what kind of secrets they are? Well... of course I won't tell you~" Pammy's smile was so adorable that I immediately forgot the question in my heart. Everyone, I love Pammy! Even if Pammy does nothing, just skipping by hopping around, I find Pammy irresistibly cute. Just by Pammy smiling, I feel as if I have been reborn. And that tiny secret hidden beneath the trapdoor makes Pammy even more mysterious and adorable. However, why do I love Pammy so much? Come to think of it, no one seems to know where Pammy comes from or where she goes. We simply accept Pammy's existence, just as Promilia accepted all of us. I understand that every race has its own secrets. Perhaps Pammy's secret takes the shape of a trapdoor. Thinking about Pammy's trapdoor, I fell into a deep sleep. In my dream, that trapdoor opened, and countless Pammies poured out from the door and swallowed me up. Ever since that night, I could only think about Pammy. If I couldn't see Pammy for a whole day, my whole body would grow weak and I wouldn't be able to sleep. After that, I sneaked into Pammy's Miracle Workshop every day, secretly observing Pammy and that trapdoor. I feel like there are other things I should be doing. I feel like I should investigate the secrets of this world. I feel like I should write a book together with my companions. However, memories of such things gradually became fewer and fewer. Lately, when I look at myself in the mirror, I feel a little uncomfortable. Why am I an ordinary human and not a Pammy? Please don't misunderstand, it's not that I hate myself or harbor prejudice against other races. It's just that I have to be a Pammy. I want to become Pammy's companion. I want to become Pammy's family. I want to enter Pammy's Miracle Workshop. I want to become Pammy. I want to become nothing but Pammy. Tonight, I am heading to Pammy's Miracle Workshop. There, I will…… This is the last letter left by Lasha, an investigator of the Unsolved Mysteries Editorial Department, before her disappearance. Afterwards, all contact with her was completely cut off. In response, taking the safety of our editorial staff into consideration, we have suspended all investigations related to Pammy's trapdoor. Whatever the outcome, we sincerely hope that Investigator Lasha has found the happiness she desired.
1662334: Log No. 10927 This quarter's on-duty shift will be handled in rotation by the three of us: me, Ed, Voyat, and Livy. Deeply recognizing that the water quality of Meltlake is directly tied to the quality of life of the townsfolk, I intend to do my utmost to protect the peace and tranquility of this region. Today's tasks mainly consist of handover and training, and no abnormalities were identified in Meltlake and its surroundings during patrol. —Ed Log No. 10930 Came to the Forester's Cottage for the first time. According to Ed, the day's duties are finished after doing one water quality check in the morning, two forest patrols in the morning and afternoon, and finishing writing the log before bedtime. I must say this job really suits me. The scent of the forest, the aroma of the lake water, the rustling sound of stepping on fallen leaves during patrol, and the Kibos that occasionally peek out out of curiosity. When I greet them, some even cozy up on their own, wanting me to pat their heads... Ah, I am already completely immersed in bliss! Without a doubt, today was a peaceful and wonderful day. The vitality radiated by the forest is the best proof. And I fall asleep enveloped in the quiet, gentle, and clear murmurs of Meltlake. —Voyat Log No. 10933 Nothing happened today. Besides, it is simply way too cold here! My fingers are so stiff from the cold that I can't move them, and I can't chop firewood! Water quality test: Water quality normal, sediment normal, meets health standards. Patrol results: Safe, no traces of abnormal activity. Log entry: All work proceeding as planned. I couldn't help feeling a little sad; they probably forgot about me. But I'll be staying at the Forester's Cottage for the next few days, so there will surely be a chance to repair my relationship with the Kibos! 1662336: Fleece Street NewsNo. 034Feature Article: Today's Events at the Lord's ManorEarly morning in Fleece was enveloped in pleasant tranquility. From the moment last night when my superior told me, "I want you to go record Nanacha's activities at the Lord's Manor," my heart soared high into the sky like a Mokyun, and my steps became light and brisk. And today, when I knocked on the doors of the Lord's Manor, a sense of reality finally welled up. Nanacha and Shine, the butler of the Lord's Manor, had already prepared warm tea. "You are today's first guest. The visitor from Elden Land is scheduled to arrive in an hour. Until then, please feel free to enjoy the tea snacks in the reception room." As expected of Head Maid Nanacha, her thoughtfulness and meticulous work ethic are bound to win high praise from every visitor. It is said that Nanacha served at the Lord's Manor even before the current Lord took office. When it comes to knowledge about the Lord's Manor, if she were to say "I am second," no one else would dare claim first place. This fact was powerfully proven during this accompanying record as well. At 9:50 AM, ten minutes before the arrival of the next guest, Nanacha led the maids to tidy the carpet once more and arrange fresh tea snacks. The freshly brewed special fragrant tea was just at the right drinking temperature, the tables were polished like new, and the organized commercial documents were placed neatly before the Lord's seat. Nanacha even paid attention to the changing light outside the window and adjusted the position of the curtains. "Count Bourgeois is very particular about the next quarter's ore procurement and related commercial partnerships—or rather, he feels quite anxious. I was hoping the aroma of the fragrant tea and the soft light might soothe him even a little," Nanacha explained. When the negotiations between the Lord and Count Bourgeois began, Head Maid Nanacha waited in the lounge, keeping an eye out to see if anything was needed in the reception room while assisting Shine in organizing letters sent by citizens last week. Among them were complaints regarding public security and municipal issues, as well as gifts from residents. Nanacha explained it as follows: "The Lord's direct sheriffs and guards do their utmost to protect the citizens' lives. However, when there are proposals regarding urban management or when difficult problems are encountered, it is also possible to consult the Lord by letter. His Lordship reads every single letter. Devoting ourselves to the citizens is our duty." In the afternoon, Nanacha helped process event applications submitted by various organizers and began cleaning the entire Lord's Manor. Tablecloths and cushions were transported to the laundry room, floor dust was cleaned and then finished with dry wiping, and all the vase water was replaced. No matter how trivial the task, Nanacha never lost her gentle smile. "Making the estate cleaner and ensuring everyone spends their time comfortably is my happiness." Night fell, and the day's work was drawing to a close. All of today's operations at the Lord's Manor were finished, and my record was nearing its final stages. Before seeing me off from the Lord's Manor, Nanacha handed me a gift she had prepared in advance. Gentleness, professionalism, tolerance, sincerity... These were the deep charms that I felt during my interactions with Nanacha, qualities that ordinary people simply do not possess. As expected of the Pammy who won first place in popularity as the "Fleece Ambassador Candidate"!
1662337:
This was an event from the distant past—not merely an era when wisdom had just begun to sprout. People constantly sought new knowledge without weariness, but in truth, that was a very perilous endeavor. The pursuit of secrets meant reaching out into the darkness and probing in all directions. After the accessible wisdom was exhausted, some chose to remain within the safety zones already understood, observing the fringes of the dark mysteries—after all, they could lead a plenty prosperous life with the technology developed thus far.
However, there were also scholars and wandering travelers. They firmly believed that the pursuit of knowledge was the purpose of living, and they continued crossing mountains and rivers, searching for a pure land where knowledge could be deeply cultivated. Finally, they stopped in a land that was lush with vegetation yet somewhat desolate, intending to build a new homeland. But they did not know that a race bearing ancient bloodlines slumbered in this land. The sounds of new life in motion caught the attention of the still-young Rafau. Noticing the busily working travelers, they lurked in the wetlands, tree shades, and reed beds, watching the birth of a new city…… Then, fluttering their young wings, they returned to the leader of the ancient bloodline, repeatedly conveying the travelers' earnestness.
"Observe whether, after tasting frustration, they can face the further trials prepared by creatures and nature with courage and perseverance."
Shortly after the divine beast prophesied, the city was subjected to a lightning raid. Amidst lightning racing across the sky and roaring thunder piercing the clouds, the tall tower built by the travelers creaked, and the stained glass windows shattered. All that was gorgeous and beautiful vanished, and their homeland was reduced to scorched earth.
"An excessive thirst for knowledge is the same as excessive desire. This may be punishment for us," said one traveler.
"But to discard knowledge is to discard the soul," another traveler replied.
"Are you not afraid of desire?"
"I desire knowledge more than that."
Rafau and the leader of the ancient bloodline overheard their Q&A. The travelers sank into a momentary sorrow, but soon threw themselves once more into learning, reconstruction, design, and construction…… and sturdier homes rose up. The travelers did not complacently assume that peaceful days would follow. Knowledge was their weapon. At last, in this land called Avalian, lightning once again dealt an unforgiving judgment upon the travelers.
"I want to go help them," Rafau said, preparing to spread his still-soft wings.
"Are you not afraid of lightning?" The leader's voice roared louder than the thunder.
"I desire the lightning!" Rafau soared high into the sky. The electric charge clinging to his body disrupted the trajectory of the thundercloud, and the lightning chased after his shadow. For the first time, he tasted this power—a power that ought to have been one with himself. His body lengthened, horns and tail began to grow, and his claws sharpened…… As he frolicked with the lightning, the sky cleared up once more, and the travelers gazed with respectful eyes upon this majestic Radiva.
"Thank you for protecting this land."
"I merely share the same thirst as you."
Radiva walked over to the traveler who persisted in seeking knowledge. The Rafau lingering close to the leader's side also raised their heads. "You've chosen your companions, haven't you?"
"I have chosen shining souls," the leader replied.

On the busiest street of the town, a newly opened toy store had captured people's attention. Inside the store, a wide variety of plush toys, from giant bears to tiny rabbits, were neatly lined up, all sporting adorable appearances. Hearing the rumor, Moflyne once again felt curiosity tickled.
"Nini~" making a joyful sound, it decided to go peek at the toy store.

"Mom, look! This plush toy is so cute!"
"Dad! It feels great when you hug it, I want this one!"
Flying secretly into the toy store and seeing many children happily hugging plush toys, Moflyne had a sudden thought—
"I'll become a plush toy too, and let everyone hug me. It's bound to feel amazing!"
Thus, using the mysterious power it possessed, Moflyne transformed into the likeness of a small child resembling a plush toy, blending in among the plush toys.
Before long, several more children entered the toy store one after another. Everyone cheered, joyfully holding up cute plush toys, each eager to embrace one.
Moflyne, transformed into a plush toy, felt a warmth and comfort like never before when a child hugged it tightly. That sensation was so wonderful that it couldn't help but purr!
"Huh? Why is this plush toy purring?" asked the child in surprise.
Other children and adults in the store also gathered around, gazing in wonder at the purring plush toy. Realizing its cover was blown, Moflyne bashfully returned to its original form. Its eight ears swayed gently, and its eyes shimmered with a mischievous glint.
"Nini~" Moflyne greeted everyone with its unique voice and executed a joyful backflip in mid-air.
"Whoa! A flying plush toy!"
"No way, isn't that a Kibo?"
"I've seen it in books! That's Moflyne! It's definitely Moflyne!"
The children cheered. They never imagined they would actually get to meet the legendary Moflyne! Ever since then, Moflyne was no longer a secret existence, becoming the most popular star in town.
And thanks to Moflyne's story, this toy store also became a favorite spot for children. Everyone knew that not only could you find cute plush toys there, but you might also meet the real Moflyne. And Moflyne would occasionally return to the toy store, transforming into a plush toy to enjoy the warmth of being hugged.
Of course, by now it had learned how to control its purring and no longer easily revealed its true identity.
1662339:
At the borders of a far-off sacred lake lies a sanctuary blessed with eternal morning light and water mist. That is the domain of Shylopo, a place that emits a holy radiance while concealing an imposing power.
Shylopo. A Kibo with two horns growing from its head and four large ears fluttering in the morning breeze. When dawn arrives and the first golden light flickers across the water's surface, it always emerges quietly from the hazy mist.
"In this sanctuary, Shylopo is the sole king," an old man from a nearby village would always tell the restless youths.


The old man had once heard such a story—



One morning, a painter visited the lake shore. Intending to capture the wondrous spectacle displayed by the dawn lake surface, he set up an easel and eagerly began painting the scene where water ripples and morning glow intersected.
He did not notice that on a stone a short distance away, a soft shadow had quietly seated itself, watching him with great interest.
Blinking, Shylopo softly raised its head and tried mimicking the painter's gestures. Puffing out its chest and stretching its neck, narrowing its eyes to gaze into the distance, it even imitated the posture of holding a brush with its front paws.
That 'majestic' posture brought it one step closer to 'high-order light,' Shylopo felt.
At that moment, a mischievous small beast darted out from the reed bed on the shore, letting out a shrill cry!
Startled, the painter turned back and saw it—the 'incarnation of holy light' that ought to be in the heights of heaven was crouching right beside him, imitating him with a proud expression.
As he panicked, the brush slipped from his hand, and lake water splashed out, wetting Shylopo's coat.
"Poko," a low, trembling voice carried across the water surface. Shylopo's pupils flashed sharply.
As the star patterns across its entire body emitted a dazzling gold-and-white light, every single hair stood on end, turning into thin, sharp spears of light. The lake surface rippled with that energy, the morning mist tore apart, and a dazzling golden spectacle was revealed.
The painter trembled at the sudden holy radiance. Unable to stand, he could only cover his eyes with both hands. Meanwhile, that small beast had panicked and fled into the bushes.
"Poko!" Shylopo's voice echoed between the wind and water. It resembled both a whisper and the tolling of a bell, carrying an irresistible dignity, as if warning people not to approach that sanctuary.
With a leap, Shylopo turned into a bluish-white afterglow and dashed straight up into the heavens. Stardust-like afterglow rained down upon the lake surface.
The mist slowly blanketed the lake surface once more, the light gradually faded, and the preceding events felt as though they were a dawn illusion.
The painter stared blankly at the lake water. He could see only the disturbed canvas and the ripples still faintly trembling on the water's surface.
He had lost his memories. Any memories concerning Shylopo's appearance could not be recalled at all.


"Children, remember this well,"
The old man said beside the campfire. "If you ever hear a soft, soul-stirring voice saying 'poko' amidst the morning mist and lake light, know that it is neither a breeze nor a waterbird. It is the king of the sanctuary declaring that this is its territory."
