1662346:
"Chronicles of Cavaliers: Pompon"
In Jinghua Cape, there is a Pammy named Pompon, who is fond of martial arts.

When asked about his hometown, today he says Qingzhuling, tomorrow Hongguapo, and the day after Wulongtan. When people press him further, he gets angry and says, "How can a master walking the path of the world easily reveal the location of his family home!" In the end, no one ever knew where Pompon came from.

Pompon stands three chi tall, walks with his hands behind his back, and always acts like a grandmaster. He is especially fond of reading martial arts secret manuals, but the characters he can read are limited, so he mostly reads stories from the streets. Once, he was seen holding a book and deep in thought for a long time, and everyone thought he had achieved some sort of enlightenment, but when they looked closer, he was holding the book upside down.

Rivaling Jiyilou for the first time, Pompon was overjoyed, declaring that he had finally met his lifelong rival. He wrote a challenge letter with charcoal, pressed his paw print at the bottom, and respectfully dropped it in front of the door. After reading it, Quan used it as a shim to fix a wobbly table leg. Pompon flew into a rage, and from then on, visited Jiyilou every single day without rest, morning and night, looking for a chance to fight. However, Quan treated Pompon like a junior, and Peipei viewed him as a playmate, so no matter how he provoked them, no one ever took up his challenge.

Once, Pompon lay in wait at a corner of the wall, waiting for Peipei to pass by. He suddenly jumped out, raised both paws high, and roared, "Boo!" When Peipei simply said, "Good morning," Pompon completely drooped in defeat. At another time, he hid in a cupboard, appearing in the middle of the night to startle everyone. When everyone searched everywhere and couldn't find him, they opened the cupboard, only to find he had already fallen fast asleep.

Although Pompon loved martial arts, what he learned was a messy hodgepodge. He heard three moves from street storytellers and stole five moves from stage performances. Whenever he met a bodyguard or martial artist on the road, he would observe them from afar for half a day, and subsequently devised seven or eight unique boxing styles of his own. Therefore, the techniques he used often had names that echoed far and wide, but their effects were negligible.
Cloud-Exploring Flying Dragon Palm: in reality, just stretching out a hand to grab an apple.
Fierce Tiger Descending the Mountain: in reality, just slipping and tumbling down a slope.
As for the Cabard Independent Skill, nine times out of ten, it was just staggering left and right.

However, his luck was peerless.
One day, suffering from extreme hunger, he tried to snatch some fruit, which accidentally startled a flock of birds. The taking-flight birds startled a boar, and the rushing boar crashed into a withered tree, snapping it in two. When the tree fell, there was a beehive right there, and Pompon thoroughly enjoyed a feast of honey. Every time he recounted this story, Pompon would inevitably look immensely smug.

Starborn say—I have seen many people in the world who cultivate martial arts. Some seek fame, some chase profit, and others fight for a momentary stubbornness. Pompon's boxing is crude and his footwork unsteady, yet in his travels through the world thus far, whenever he hungered he found food, whenever he tired he found an inn, and whenever he caused trouble he invariably received someone's help. Even when plunged into desperate straits, he always managed to stumble upon a path to survival. No matter the danger, he turned misfortune into fortune. No matter the difficulty, he managed to muddle through successfully. This is true kung fu.
1662347:
In the eastern outskirts of Jinghuazhou, there was a peach grove. Every time the flowering season arrived, the peach blossoms spanning several miles would draw endless streams of blossom-viewing visitors. Hanging within the grove were numerous peach blossom talismans seeking peace, fame, or good marriages, and everyone said that with a sincere heart, one could move the fairy fox of the grove.
There was a woodcutter named Zhao Sheng. Over twenty years of age, his family was poor, and they possessed practically nothing in the way of household goods. His father had passed away early on, and he lived dependently with his mother. The neighbors advised him to settle down early, but Zhao Sheng shook his head and refused. When asked why, he would only say, "I still have an aging mother to look after, so there is no need to burden someone else with hardships." Hearing this, everyone admired his character.
However, Zhao Sheng's mother worried over her son's marriage and always went to the peach grove to make wishes. Every five days, she would invariably head to the peach grove with incense, candles, and handmade pastry (su-bing), hanging a peach blossom talisman on a tree. Written upon it was merely a single phrase: "A good match for my son."
Upon discovering this, Zhao Sheng was at his wits' end and could only secretly take them down. One hung up, one taken down; another hung up, another taken down—it was a constant repetition.
Once, returning from chopping firewood and passing by the peach grove, he happened to spot a young girl beneath a tree. Dressed in pink clothes, she sat leaning against a peach tree, flipping through and reading several peach blossom talismans in her hand. Beside her sat a familiar box of partially eaten pastries. As he drew closer, he saw that the talisman the girl had spread out in her hands was precisely the one written by his own mother, prompting him to mutter involuntarily, "Not this again."
Startled, Zhao Sheng stepped forward to inquire. Raising her gaze to look at him, the girl instead retorted, "Are you Zhao Sheng?"
Zhao Sheng was even more astonished. Just as he was about to ask for details, the girl had already rolled up the talisman and smiled brightly, saying, "So this is what you look like." No sooner had she finished speaking than she stood up, flipped the sleeves of her garments, and vanished deep into the peach grove in the blink of an eye. Zhao Sheng chased after her for a few steps, but her figure had already disappeared without a trace.
Upon returning to the village, he recounted this event to his neighbors. Some dismissed it as rambling in his sleep, others laughed it off as a mistaken sight, but an old man whispered, "Perhaps there really is a fairy fox within the peach grove."
Although Zhao Sheng originally did not believe in strange anomalies, he spotted the girl several times thereafter in the peach grove. Sometimes lying prone on a branch flipping through peach blossom talismans, other times holding a dessert and eating while watching the passing crowds. However, whenever he tried to approach, her form would vanish once more without a trace.
Years passed in this manner, and thanks to Zhao Sheng's diligent labor, the Zhao family gradually prospered. Zhao Sheng's mother still made trips to the peach grove to pray for good fortune, but she stopped speaking of Zhao Sheng's marriage every single day.
In the late spring of a certain year, a visitor came from a neighboring village. A certain family, having heard of Zhao Sheng's diligence and filial piety, came forth to propose a marriage alliance.
Months later, the marriage was finally decided. On the wedding day, Zhao Sheng's mother was overjoyed and specially prepared a large batch of pastries to visit the peach grove in thanksgiving, accompanied by Zhao Sheng. Yet the peach blossoms bloomed as beautifully as ever, but there was no sign of the fairy fox—only an unfamiliar peach blossom talisman added to the end of a branch. The characters on the paper were slightly scrawled: "Zhao Sheng's match is already ordained. This repays the debt." Below was an extra line added in smaller characters: "The pastries were delicious," and signed with a crude drawing of a little fox.
Seeing this, Zhao Sheng could not help but burst into laughter. Looking back, flower shadows fluttered deep within the peach grove, and a faint sound of ringing bells seemed to drift by on the wind, accompanied by the laughter of a young girl. Straining his ears to listen once more, she was nowhere to be found.
From then on, Zhao Sheng was blessed with children and grandchildren, and every spring when the peach blossoms bloomed, he would bring his family to the peach grove. And whenever someone asked him about the fairy fox, Zhao Sheng would always smile and reply, "Perhaps there really is a fairy fox within the peach grove."

1662349:
"The Legend of the Forest Goddess Passed Down in Charlulu Village"
An elderly hunter of the village said that in the deepest depths of the dense forest dwelt a goddess, and she lived in a place where the flowers grew higher than the trees.
If she gently waves her hand, a nourishing rain pours down upon the flora. She can converse with Chitch, and can even help a wounded Chameleus stand tall once more.
All the Kibo yearn to meet her and wish to win her favor.

The first was a Doru. He figured that if he could run the fastest, the goddess would surely like him best.
Thus he practiced running every day, and sometimes even came to Charlulu Village to steal fish just to train his running speed.
As a result, on the day he ran toward the goddess's dwelling, he ran far too fast and leaped right over a ravine, making it utterly impossible to meet the goddess.

The first—ah, the second was a Flogure. He figured that if he could sing the most skillfully, the goddess would surely like him best.
Thus he practiced singing every day. Singing beneath trees, by the lakeside, and toward Tana in the night sky.
As a result, he ruined his throat, and his original beautiful voice of "popo, gero" transformed into a raspy "croak-croak."

The second—the third was a Granzaros. He figured that if he possessed the greatest strength, the goddess would surely like him best.
Thus he practiced his strength every day. Carrying stones, crashing against tree trunks, lifting fallen withered logs, and pushing slumbering boulders.
As a result, when charging toward a mountain cliff, he shattered the rock and buried himself beneath the crushed stones.

Realizing that all these methods were useless, the Kibo decided to give the goddess gifts.
Before long, the Kibo grew increasingly numerous: Kibo holding flowers in their mouths, Kibo presenting fruits, Kibo picking up sparkly stones, and even Kibo catching glowing bugs.
They continued traveling deep into the dense forest every day, until finally, an elegant Foundi said, "You fools. When has the goddess ever accepted any gifts?"
True enough, flowers, fruits, stones—she had accepted none of them.
The Foundi continued:
"Yet she planted the flowers in gardens, buried fruit seeds in the soil, and lined up the stones along the stream bank."
"Did she not even find a cozy new nest for those glowing bugs?"
Thus the Kibo finally understood. The forest goddess does not show favoritism to any single individual, but rather loves everything within the forest.
She is like the rainwater pouring down upon the woods, or the sunlight illuminating the valleys.
As long as they live true to themselves, the forest goddess will watch over them always.
And when passing through the trees, the Kibo always felt as though the flowers from the place higher than the trees were gazing quietly upon them with a gentle, loving gaze.
1662350:
"Confidential to the 'Polar Star of the Night Sky'"
"Tonight, when Starmi stretches its limbs, please come to the supreme land of Fleece."
"Allow me to show you the magic of the moon."
Closing the invitation steeped in the sweetness of candy, under the shroud of the pitch-black night, Fleece was still brightly lit. Yet the residents ought to have already fallen asleep, thereby making the stillness all the more profound. A clear, crisp click of high heels echoed as a young girl came to meet you. A warm orange glow illuminated the contours of her face, making her amber eyes sparkle, yet tonight was heavily overcast with no moon.
"Right on time," the young girl's tone carried not a hint of dejection. "If the sole audience member were absent, even someone like me would be troubled." With a smug expression on her face at the Starborn's punctual arrival, she wore the look she always donned when about to showcase her skills.
"Hmph! I know what you're worrying about. The Abyssal Evil King plucked away the moon with his sinful hands, right? But such a trivial matter is effortless for this 'Crimson Flame Thunder'?" Spreading both arms wide before the Starborn, the young girl's red jacket fluttered in the wind.
"Besides, I have you. The 'Polar Star of the Night Sky'—no matter what deep darkness others might sink into, you can always radiate the glow of hope with your unyielding posture."
"Look at me. With your strength, let us breathe life back into this night."
Standing right before you, the shroud of night pressed in close.
"Behold, the Moon Mystery!"
As clouds and mist were gently swept aside to the left and right by the wind, as if a handmaiden helping her princess peek had softly parted the curtains, a pure, cold white light softened the young girl's silhouette, nearly melting into the utterly alluring full moon behind her.
Since when had the chirping of insects begun to echo?
"That's not all." The young girl raised her left hand, placing it near her eyes. A wisp of thin cloud drifted past, making the wondrous light within her eyes sparkle all the more brilliantly.
"This is the magic of the moon." The tips of her hair and hat reflected the moonlight, making the dust floating in the air all the more prominent. The wind stopped, the clouds ceased moving, and unseen insects seemed to chirp until the end of time, breathless.
Time... does the city still exist there?
"In this very moment... it feels almost as if there are only you and me in the world..."
Rubina's eyes shone in the moonlight, and at that moment, the clock tower bell tolled three times.
"Today's show concludes here. Thank you for viewing."
The young girl gave a theatrical, pretentious bow.
"Next time I shall bring you an even more wonderful program. Look forward to it♪"

1662352:
I believe that an important part of a maid's work is 'dealing with things beforehand.' 
Waiting to act until the master asks is far too late. A truly competent maid should notice dust before it piles up, deal with strange odors before they spread, and eradicate pests before they try to build a nest. That way, the master won't be distracted by trivial matters. 
To achieve this, observation, action, and execution are all indispensable. 
For example, when cleaning a room, you first identify areas where dirt easily accumulates and tidy them up in order. If there are objects blocking your view, you must lift or move them so you can clean every corner. It's not difficult; a little strength and patience are more than enough. 
'A little,' you ask?
Just enough to move the wardrobe and lift the sofa on the side. You can do it with one hand, so it's hardly worth explaining.
Moreover, being tidy is not just about 'having no dust.' 
Whether storage is easy to understand, whether items are easy to take out, whether the drooping curves of the curtains are neat, and whether the wrinkles at the edge of the bedding are smoothed out—these are all points to check. A maid's ability is also reflected in the comfort of a room. If you can't even fluff the pillows properly, it's out of the question.
As for pests, quick decisions and swift action are always our guiding principles.
Giving them time to struggle only makes things more troublesome. It is best to finish them off quickly, quietly, and thoroughly before the master's attention wanders. Choosing the right tools usually gets it done in one blow. Even if unsightly traces occasionally remain, you only need to take a little time to clean them up, which is no problem at all.

Cleaning, organizing, removing dirt, maintaining the environment, and taking care of the master's personal needs—these are all jobs that a maid naturally ought to fulfill. 
...Yes?
An ordinary maid wouldn't lift annoying furniture along with the floor tiles, you say?
Is that so? 
But if we don't do that, how are we supposed to eradicate dirt and pests?

1662399: What if it's not within a 'reasonable range'?
1662400: If the demand isn't within a 'reasonable range', would the requester end up getting cleaned up instead...?
1662401: How about we just celebrate the festival together instead?
1662402: In the end, you can't choose, can you?
1662403: I mean no harm, but stuffing french fries packed with berry jam inside fried fish—is that really an appropriate breakfast recipe?
1662404: Who you go with is more important
1662406: Replies exist for Peipei's sake. That's why I wrote Peipei's name right at the very front.
1662407: After receiving a letter from Peipei, the 'Starborn' turned into a cheerful 'reply writer'.
1662409: As expected of Izumi. Just what you'd expect from Peipei's master!
1662410: Whether Peipei grows up or not, I'll always listen properly to what you have to say.
1662412:
Since you put it that way, I should express my gratitude as well.
To your father, and to the jade bi he fulfilled his duty to bring back.
Otherwise, I would never have met you, nor been able to explore the true path of life together.
1662414:
Eh? Could it be that Maple noticed me?
Does Maple remember everyone she sees at the guild?
1662415: I look forward to working with you from now on
1662417: If you've been watching me all this time, doesn't that prove Maple is working hard as well?
1662419: I still have a long way to go
1662420: It was just on the way
1662421: My hands just moved on their own
1662422: Seeing Maple looking troubled, my hands just moved on their own.
1662423: Please call out whenever you need anything
1662425: Please don't push yourself too hard
1662428:
You're my best friend.
Thinking back to our first letter, I never imagined I'd become this close with Maple...
1662430: Maple is... of course a fellow kitten, nya~
1662431: Let's talk more leisurely next time
1662432:
True power is something polished bit by bit, isn't it?
If you keep up your training, you're bound to gain something from it.
1662433: If you need help, I'll assist you
1662434: It was entrusted because it's Chiyo
1662436: I thought the sight of cherry blossoms blooming all over the garden must be breathtakingly beautiful. I hope we can see such wonderful scenery every single day from now on.
1662437: Of course! If Chiyo is going to brew tea, I'll prepare some treats that go well with it. By the way, what kind do you like?
1662438: I think the reason Chiyo became strong is ultimately because she imposes unremitting efforts upon herself.
1662439: Don't worry, that kind of injury is really nothing much. If we spar again, I'll take you on seriously.
1662443:
Today, after waking up as usual, I went outside with my fawn and enjoyed the crisp air carrying the scent of earth. The trees in the forest are all vibrant, and the Kibo are full of energy. Sometimes, while playing together, their coats get a bit dirty—but I wiped them clean, so there's no need to worry.
As a thank-you, they gave me a lot of fresh fruit. I tried brewing tea with some of it today... I wonder if you're interested in a new blend? I'd be happy if it suits your taste.
1662444:
Today, you see, I hunted 3 boarlargas and 1 salamand of a decent size! How do you think I did it? Hehe, of course I leaped into the sky and thrust my spear with all my might—swoosh, swoosh, swoosh! It was so cool I almost wanted to applaud myself!
I wanted to save the best meat and roast it to eat with you, but once roasted, it smelled so incredible that I couldn't resist... well, tasting just a tiny bite! (Really, just a bite!)
I'll catch an even bigger one next time to make up for it. That's a promise from Charlulu's strongest hunter!
1662445:
Last time I managed to get out faster than expected!
That's all thanks to you speaking well of me in front of my relatives. It really helped, thanks!
Anyway, this genius mechanic will never make the same mistake twice. This time, I plan to build a surrogate mechanical puppet... though I haven't solved the problem of the most crucial power core yet...
How about you secretly hide and control this mechanism with strings?
1662446:
Hey-heya! Remember that mechanical puppet we designed and completed together last time?
After that, I made quite a few modifications, and it has evolved so much it's incomparable to the old one.
To commemorate your contribution, I even specially painted your portrait on the back of its head. You'll definitely be moved when you see it!
1662447:
This time, I asked a kind trade guild to help me get some truly wonderful fireworks materials that aren't allowed to be used at home! Tonight, at the usual time and the usual place, I'll show you the finest fireworks you've ever seen!
It's Sunya's public debut, and at the best viewing spot prepared just for you, this genius mechanic will explain the design philosophy right by your side!
By the way, are you really sure I can't draw your portrait with fireworks? My drawing skills haven't rusted at all...
1662448:
Fufun!
Consider yourself honored. This is a letter personally written by Ponpon—the super rookie of the Chen Dynasty martial arts world, founder of the Pom-Style Jeet Kune Do, Pammy's hope, Sunya's vagabond, and the renowned 'Kurume' of Jiyilou!
Aren't you super moved to have made the acquaintance of the future number one kung fu master—meaning Ponpon?
You should keep this autograph! I'll throw in the master's claw marks as a bonus. Handle it with respect and cherish it!
1662449:
What kind of day did you have today? Ponpon was very productive. I was doing strict training the whole time. You know how it is, as the future number one under heaven, I can't rest for even a single second!
As soon as the sun rose and I woke up, I sat in meditation on the rooftop, absorbed the vital essence of heaven and earth, and learned the proper wing-flapping posture from the birds.
Then, at a street corner stall, I found a book called 'Martial Arts Introductory Secret Text for Dummies'. The contents were pretty basic, but reading it carefully gave me some insights, so I'll share it with Ponpon's partner—you!
At night, in the deserted streets, I also sparred with Tangqiu to test if my skills had improved. Lately, I've been sneaking snacks every day, so my tummy had gotten completely round! But for some reason, as we started sparring, a crowd of onlookers gathered all around...
1662450:
Lately, the number of people coming to Peach Blossom Forest to make wishes has been increasing more and more. Even though it's our duty to guard mortal ties, we've gotten so busy that we don't even have time to rest...
If you have free time, would you mind coming over to help out?
Granny Fox said my constitution is 'easily tainted by karma',
but it's just that I'm a liiddle more curious than everyone else, and whenever I hear gossip I can't help getting closer... Well, because of that, things ended up like this in the end.
Still, there are good things about it! I get to hear lots of gossip and stories that aren't very well known to the world...
Next time we meet, I'll share two hand-picked interesting stories with you!
1662451:
Say, have you tried the new pastries from Jiyilou yet? They are truly, truly exquisite! No, wait, should I say 'they're shockingly delicious'?
A long time ago, I felt something just like this. It was back when I first came to Sunya and tasted mortal sweets for the very first time. I was so, so moved back then. But you see, nowadays eating sweets is just part of my daily routine, and it's rare to feel moved like that anymore.
Since you're always adventuring all over the place, Swordsman, you must encounter lots of rare things, right?
Thinking about it that way... becoming companions to explore the world together with you is truly a wonderful bond!
1662452:
During the next Heavenly Flower Festival, how about we write Peach Blossom talismans under the tree together?
As for what that 'special bond' we felt back then really was... my answer is already decided. If I were to write it on the talisman with my own hands, it would definitely bear your name. Whether that means the same thing as what you're imagining—I'll tell you directly when we meet!
Oh, and last time I told you about a story I didn't like, so this time I'll bring along my absolute favorite reading material. Don't worry, they're all heartwarming stories where everyone ends up happy! Maybe we could even try out a few scenes from it together, you and I... Anyway! I'll tell you all the details when we meet!
1662453:
I am so sorry! When writing down the address at the post office earlier, I accidentally filled in the Starborn's address.
If a package from Roslanth arrives, could you hold onto it for me? You can just hand it to me the next time we meet.
If there is food inside the package, please don't hesitate to enjoy it while it's fresh!
1662454:
When I went out today, I found a bag containing fruit near the tree stump. Beastman children rarely come around here, and they seldom pick vegetables or fruit... so it must have been yours, right? I'm sorry, when my fawn grabbed it, the bag got a little torn.
I mended it, but it couldn't be restored to the way it was.
Allow me to gift you a new bag the next time we meet.
1662455:
Lately, for some reason, my teeth have been hurting. Not only does it affect opening my mouth to talk, it even impacts my meals! It's so frustrating! Even though I can still communicate with you through letters like this without speaking, there's no helping the fact that I can't munch heartily on meat! Oh man, what am I supposed to do!
Teeth are the symbol of a wolf's strength, so I've always taken care of them!
I want to eat that big roasted meat you made before... It was so delicious!
1662456:
Dear Starborn, sending you heartfelt greetings!
Writing words on paper is indeed different from meeting and talking in person.
Having plenty of time to organize one's thoughts allows feelings to be conveyed even better.
Besides, things that cannot be said face-to-face can be communicated through a letter.
Actually, the village children sometimes pull pranks, and at times like that, I hesitate to scold them directly... but perhaps writing down warnings and giving them to their families might be more effective.
1662457:
The rainy season has passed, and lately, clear skies without a single cloud have continued. When taking a walk in the forest at night, the starry sky can be seen clearly.
In the folklore of various lands, it is said that stars are related to souls. Beastman folklore is the same.
It is said that the more brave and passionate a soul is, the brighter and more brilliantly the star to which that person belongs shines.
What kind of connection does the name 'Starborn' have with the stars?
Even if they cannot compare to the stars in the sky, among the countless souls on the ground, you are surely the most brilliant existence.
1662458:
I wasn't very busy today, so I was tidying up my things at home... and happened to find the tools I used when I first became a shaman.
Most of them were gifts from everyone in the village. A polished bone necklace, a pretty pointed hat, a waist ornament adorned with many bells... and the sacred drum passed down through generations in the village.
In the beginning, I couldn't handle the duties of a shaman very well, and when connecting with Aura, I had no choice but to rely on the sound of the kagura drum. However, gradually, I realized that what is important when interacting with all spirits is not performing rituals step-by-step, but directly conveying one's own feelings, and so I gradually stopped relying on the sacred drum.
Today, seeing the sacred drum, I somehow found myself missing that sound.
Starborn, I promised to offer blessings to your journey. Next time we meet, please let me play the sound of departure for you with this sacred drum.
1662459:
You... have been looking so busy in the valley lately, what are you searching for?
Instead of running around alone and wasting time,
wouldn't it be better to consider if there is someone who can help you?
So... well... I happen to be on patrol around that area recently, and if I see anyone in trouble, I have an obligation to help them no matter who they are...
Anyway, you get what I'm trying to say, right?
1662460:
Don't be too surprised when you hear this. Today, while on patrol, I ran into a rampaging Licaumo! It was going crazy all over the place, completely unstoppable, and a really terrifying guy. In the end, I used my lightning arrow to...
Oh, come on! A letter can't convey this at all! You want to hear this story properly too, right?
Next time we meet, I'll let you hear all about my heroic exploits in detail!
1662461:
Today, while helping out with blacksmithing, I suddenly had an inspiration. What if I applied the structure of the Grago shell I saw earlier to equipment... and when I tried it, the effect was surprisingly amazing!
I had only ever thought about walking the path of a warrior, but maybe I have the talent to become an amazing blacksmith?
1662462:
You look awfully busy, don't you? You haven't been to Windhide Rock in a long time.
Are you tangled up in some troublesome matter?
It's not like I'm lonely or anything like that. I was just a little curious. This letter doesn't have any special meaning either. Whenever you feel like dropping by the village, come on over. I won't chase you away.
1662463:
I heard from Luruka that you'll be leaving Charlulu village soon...
Yeah, that's right... You are a guest of Charlulu village, so I knew that someday you would set off on a new journey... Maybe along the way, you might meet my mother. Long ago, my mother pointed at the night sky and said this to me: 'As long as it exists alongside the passage of time, life is forever on an adventure. Flowing forward as it goes is how life ought to be...'
So, I won't ask you to stay.
Maybe... someday, following in your and my mother's footsteps, I might set off on a journey too.
But before that... whenever you return to Charlulu village, you can always come stay at my place! There is always a place for you here!
1662464:
We haven't seen each other in a while.
A merchant ship from the Rosia Empire has entered the port, and the Hakuon family patrol is currently inspecting the cargo. It's like this day after day, and taking a break is like trying to catch a cloud.
I was advised to find an assistant... Lately, my work has piled up, but I can't imagine anyone serving as my assistant other than you.
How about it, Starborn? Do you have any interest in becoming the assistant of this Moren Hakuon? Of course, I will prepare work that lets you make full use of your talents.
1662465:
In the Hakuon family, there is an unwritten rule to present a musical composition to those who newly join us. It carries the meaning of celebrating the opening of a new chapter in that person's life.
However, if I am the one presenting it, wouldn't it be more fitting to play a sword dance rather than pluck a stringed instrument?
Instead of a musical composition, how about offering the Hakuon family's blessing through a sword dance?
By doing so, it will be clear to everyone that this is not just from the Hakuon family, but that 'I' have expectations for you.
Look forward to it, I'll craft the choreography carefully.
1662466:
Have you ever tried a drink called 'After Midnight'? It seems to be the talk of the town in Fleece lately, and caravan members are all raving that you'll regret it if you don't drink it at least once.
As a Starborn who travels the world, you must have tasted plenty of rare drinks that I've never even heard of. I'm truly envious...
If my father hadn't been attacked by fierce beasts... I should have been able to travel like you and weave my own epic. That is very important to high elves, but right now, every day I run around between the clan and numerous factions, and sometimes I don't even have time to enjoy a single drink.
May I have a moment? I've been thinking about it, and having you join the Hakuon family isn't realistic after all. Instead, how about forming an 'alliance' with me? That way, I can entrust many things to you. There aren't many people I can trust, and you are the most suitable candidate.
After official duties are over, let's grab a drink together, just you and me.
1662467:
My birthday is coming soon...
According to Hakuon family customs, every new moon birthday involves many rituals,
and one must follow prescribed manners. Even who can attend is strictly vetted.
However, since I am currently acting head of the family, I have a certain degree of freedom. You can ignore all the past customs. For this new moon's birthday, I am inviting only you.
I will forget that you are a Starborn, and you will forget that I am the heir of the Hakuon family. To me, you are purely '{playerName}', and to you, I am simply 'Moren'.
Right, the season I was born in is perfect for skiing. On that day, let's go together to the ski resort in the Itone Grand Duchy. Don't forget to dress warmly. Even if you catch a cold, there is no one else who can take care of you besides me.
1662468:
Have you been busy lately? Actually, we are planning to hold a mock battle between the swordsmen of the Elven Throne and the knights soon, and I was wondering if you might act as the referee. With your strength, Starborn, I believe you can fairly evaluate the battle situation.
And also...
I think that if I heard your cheers, my fighting spirit would well up even stronger.
1662469:
Lately, I've been reviewing improvements for combat rations. Deliciousness, calories, nutrients, portability... To avoid failing at a critical moment, these are all metrics that should be seriously evaluated and studied.
I've enclosed a few prototypes with this letter,
and I would be delighted if you could taste-test them and share your thoughts.
1662470:
How have you been doing lately?
Triggered by recent events, I've come to rethink the future of Windhide Rock. Preserving tradition does not mean rejecting progress. We should interact with the outside world and listen to various opinions. As the chieftain of the tribe, I must further hone my abilities for communication.
Thinking this way, I suddenly remembered you.
Your thoughts and insights always give me new solutions.
Therefore, I would like to continue corresponding with you regularly from now on, what do you think?
I'm not very good at getting close to people, and this is also the first time I've written a letter. If there are any inappropriate points in my phrasing, I would appreciate it if you could point them out in your reply.
1662471:
How have you been doing lately?
When corresponding like this, what kind of things are correct to write and send?
When I asked a member of the clan, they looked extremely surprised and asked back, 'Are you writing a letter to someone?' Thinking that wasn't an answer to my question, I didn't ask any further.
Lately, everything is going smoothly in Windhide Rock. I'm doing well, and everyone in the clan is too. The weather is good.
Also, today I ate a red chili pepper.
1662472:
Curious about what my weapon shop in the Federation looks like?
Earlier, a customer said, 'The interior decoration of your shop looks just like a gallery,' and I was quite satisfied with that comment myself.
Because essentially, this is a place to display the art I've designed—it just happens that they're weapons.
That's right! If you ever come to Rabe, be sure to come take a look. Whenever I look at you, I feel like new inspirations keep welling up♪
1662474:
Hello. On behalf of the Fleece Lord's Estate, I sincerely welcome your arrival.
As the maid responsible for hosting you and looking after your daily life this time, I will serve you with all my might. If there is anything you need help with, please feel free to command me. As long as your requests are within a reasonable scope, I will resolve all of them.
1662475:
Your reservation for the 'Comprehensive Physical Ability Checkup' has been confirmed. This checkup includes 28 major items and 36 minor items.
Scheduled checkup period: 3 days. Please prepare a change of clothes and come to our clinic early in the morning on the day of the checkup on an empty stomach.
This checkup is provided through a family package purchased for you by our nurse Anis. Nurse Anis's message is as follows:
'You looked a bit pale last time, so I'm very worried about your health. Be sure to arrive right on time. I'll take good care of you.'
1662477:
Today, master taught me how to write a letter. My first letter feels so fresh.
Peipei actually thought about writing to Pompon, but since we meet every day, I don't know what to write.
Since I can't meet Starborn every day, I decided to write a letter.
I'll be waiting for your reply.
Uum... I just need to take it to the post office, right?
I hope it reaches you safely...
1662479:
Did I write the recipient and sender names the wrong way around?
The contents of the letter are what Peipei wants to say. Usually, the name of the person speaking comes first, so I made a mistake.
But when I think about it, a letter is meant for Starborn to read, so Starborn's name goes right at the very front. I've learned it.
Peipei is very happy to learn something new.
1662481:
I ate this the other day, and it was super delicious.
Please try eating it. I thought about having master learn how to make it, but master said that once she learns how to make candy, she'll make too much of it, and if she makes too much, she'll eat too much, and if she eats too much candy, bugs will get in her teeth... so she told me to go buy it outside instead.
However, my allowance for this month is already gone...
1662482:
Since you listened to Peipei's story seriously all this time, I'll let Starborn in on what Peipei is thinking.
There is no size for Pammy in martial arts uniforms. In many martial arts dojos, they won't take Pammy as a disciple.
Pammy has some shortcomings, but she also has amazing points. Peipei can climb to the top of a bamboo stalk, but master can't. Because master ends up breaking the bamboo.
Once I become as strong as master, I'll invent Pammy's martial arts, gather lots of Pammy's disciples,
and open the Pammy Martial Arts Dojo.
1662484:
Thanks to the power of the Jade Bi protected by father and everyone, I am able to survive in this world like this. Earlier, I mentioned that memories of the past sustained me, but actually, I too once lost sight of the path I should walk. What on earth was I surviving for... I simply didn't know. If father had known that, he surely would have deeply regretted it, beating his chest and lamenting in grief.
However, the present me wishes to stand proudly before father together with you and tell him that 'I am doing well'.
The scars of the past still hurt, but the time spent with you has turned into memories more than enough to heal all wounds. And I believe that the meaning of continuing to exist in this world is something we can explore together from now on.
The feeling of being brought back to life—surely, this must be what it feels like, right?
1662485:
Ah! I remember you, nya. I'm sure I saw you at both the Adventurer's Guild and the Kibo Fight Association.
You're a super enthusiastic newcomer, nya! Since you just arrived, there must be lots of things you don't know yet. Don't hesitate to ask me anything, nya!
Maple is the receptionist at the Adventurer's Guild and the guide for the Kibo Fight Association, so guiding newcomers onto the right path is Maple's most important job, nya!
1662486:
I've been seeing you often at the Adventurer's Guild and the Kibo Fight Association lately, nya.
Having passion is a good thing, but please take care of your body and get plenty of rest, nya. If you break your body, you won't be able to do what you love!
If there's anything you need help with, don't hesitate to tell Maple. Solving everyone's troubles is Maple's job, nya.
1662487:
Thank you for helping Maple yesterday and stopping those persistent, bad fighters.
Actually, those guys are totally notorious in Fleece, nya. Many participants' Kibos have been bullied by them too... But since they were punished by an adventurer, I'm sure they won't come around to cause trouble for a while, nya.
You really are a dependable adventurer, nya! By now, you've got lots of fans at the Adventurer's Guild and the Kibo Fight Association, nya. So come visit us again!
1662488: <actionkeyhold>MainInput/MainPetSkillRoulette</actionkeyhold> to <color=#96F9FF>hold</color> and select other Kibos' skills from the Kibo wheel
1662489: <actionkey>MainInput/MainPetSkillRoulette</actionkey> to <color=#96F9FF>press</color> and select other Kibos' skills from the Kibo wheel
1662490:
Tana is Luruka's primary partner. Although somewhat wild-tempered, Tana is very smart and more loyal than anyone else.
A hundred moons ago, Tana came from the northern cold regions to Sprout Valley. Here, Tana met Luruka and they became close partners.
Ever since, Finwolf has also put down roots in this land.
1662491:
Bron's brown fur is covered by a large, hard shell. This carapace, which wraps around its streamlined back, provides high defense, making its young and still-soft skeletal structure less susceptible to damage.
Bron has a gentle personality, occasionally emitting a rockfall-like sound of 'Bron-bron'. This is actually caused by the resonance of its chest cavity, which is also the origin of its name.
1662492:
Bromor's movements are relatively swift among Kibos of the same build. When entering combat stance, it launches rapid charges multiple times in a short burst to break defenses and follow up before the opponent can recover their footing.
It also excels in load capacity, and by taking on cargo, it can reduce the burden on accompanying companions. However, when facing unexpected situations, it prioritizes protecting its companions over the cargo it carries on its back.
1662493: Lurunephi has a proud and strong sense of justice. Its lyre grows into a bag-like shape, inside which is filled with lightning-elemental astral pulse energy. Whenever it sees the weak being bullied, no matter who the opponent is, it summons lightning to 'uphold its justice' and deliver 'punishment'.
1662494:
Radiva has a calm personality and a mature demeanor. The fact that it maintains high independence even after becoming companions with intelligent races may stem from its proud innate nature. However, its essence is extremely loyal and dependable.
Its lightning-manipulating techniques can be called flawless. Combining powerful attacks with swift movements, it deals heavy damage to enemies, making it a tremendous threat on the battlefield.
1662495: Floating above Sandy's head are two small orbs. These are the main organs for discharging electricity, moving up and down in sync with its movements.
1662496: Teiga has sharp fangs, and its tail condenses faint magical power to create a sharp icicle. Its pure white fur is dotted with grayish-blue patterns, giving it an even more lithe and slender physique. Its claws and other parts are still in the growth stage, but it already displays agile footwork and excellent hunting skills.
1662497:
The willpower of the wolf pack descended, and Ulu underwent significant growth.
Its body became notably larger, and its fur color became even richer and more splendid. Through its howl, it can summon phantoms of its fellow wolf kin to join in combat. When the resonance of the entire pack reaches its maximum, the power of ice and snow can even change the weather.
Now, Ulu runs across the land where its ancestors lived. Its heartbeat overlaps with the wolf pack, and thoughts transcending time have finally taken shape in this land.
1662498: Frogley is very confident and can manipulate the flow of surrounding sound waves to create a powerful sonic field. Within this sonic field, no one else's generated sound can drown out Frogley's sound—it always uses this bold method to let everyone around know of its arrival!
1662499: Azaley showed unique potential different from other Rafau since childhood. Unlike other Rafau who relied on the protection of adults and withdrew immediately upon sensing danger, Azaley possessed strong pride from an early age and an instinct to dominate its own territory. Moren gave this Kibo the name "Azaley", meaning "King of the Heavenly Thunder".
1662500: Upon reaching maturity, the sapling guarded by Foley grows into a giant tree piercing the heavens. It builds a simple wooden hut at the top of the tree it guards, spending most of its time there. From this vantage point, it observes and guards the surrounding forest. Foley prefers a quiet environment and has a gentle disposition, but reacts with fierce anger toward those who intentionally destroy the environment. It hangs such offenders from tree branches with thorn vines and refuses to lower them until they admit their wrongdoing.
1662501: Heidi fluttered down unexpectedly beside Lily in her time of hardship, like a soft snowflake. No matter what new thing it lays eyes on, it cocks its head in curious observation, and even when facing difficulties, it never gets down, quickly recovering its vitality. Despite being a young beast, its protective instinct has already awakened. It does not drop its guard even while sleeping, immediately waking Lily up upon sensing any sound. "As white as snow, as warm as down, as beautiful as a flower" — that is why Lily named her Heidi.
1662502: Meewolf has long fur that covers its eyes and claws. Due to the dangerous aura emanating from its body, many Kibo are afraid to approach it. When night falls, Meewolf reveals its true form, its long silky fur standing on end with fierce eyes and sharp claws exposed. Its claw strikes are terrifying, and prey marked by it has almost no chance of survival. Strangely enough, even though Meewolf is this ferocious, it never attacks the Claudime packs near its habitat.
1662504: The Azure Kitsune cub is small with soft fur. The pink flame-like tuft of fur at the tip of its tail is its most prominent feature. During its juvenile stage, the Azure Kitsune cub is at its most active and mischievous stage. Playful and a big foodie, whether it is slowly falling peach blossom petals or steaming baozi in a steamer basket, it immediately fixes its eager gaze upon them. If the Magnificent Spirit Fox or Dream Nine-Tails are not keeping a close eye on it, it will cause one commotion after another in no time.
1662505: Sapitz is small, active, and mischievous in nature, with a fondness for ores. It is always digging around in the ground with its small claws searching for fragments. Its mining technique is still clumsy and leaves it covered in mud, but it gets wildly excited just finding the tiniest speck of mineral. Sometimes it even digs a small hole around an ore to fall asleep in, trying to blend into the environment like an ore itself.
1662506: Sapyra loves digging for ores. With the pads of its front paws, it can sense underground minerals through rock strata and independently explore new mineral veins. It possesses an extraordinary intuition for spotting brittle areas in rock structures, often locating veins faster than human miners. It has already mastered basic rotary mining techniques: rolling its body into a sphere and spinning at high speed to shatter the ore along with the rock wall, acquiring fragments from within.
1662507: Flammy grew up alongside Mity and is very sensitive to her emotions. Whenever Mity is suffering, it flaps its wings frantically and scatters sparks, trying to drive away the dark clouds in her heart. Flammy has a stronger-than-average desire to protect Mity. If anyone approaches when she is feeling down or vulnerable, it immediately fluffs its feathers, spreads its wings, and emits sparks as a warning.
1662508: Normally, Sugarbirds always travel in flocks, but Chuchu has a poor sense of direction and cannot keep up with its kin, often getting separated. However, it does not seem anxious about this at all, leisurely drinking flower nectar, and once its stomach is full, falling over in the grass to sleep soundly. It has quite a bold nerve, and its curiosity about other species outweighs its caution. And very fortunately, it has never encountered real danger or natural predators so far.

1663956: An individual that was the pack leader before being eroded. Even after turning into a feral beast, it continues to lead the Mistelf in frantic hunts. Deigarm often uses a single Mistelf as a vanguard for scouting and as bait to lure enemies, waiting in the shadows for the moment to launch a surprise attack.
1663957: Kiramy are mostly active at night, and their primary goal is to gather as much starlight as possible. The absorbed starlight is stored in the chest jewel, serving as a source of magic power. However, because Kiramy's jewel is still small, the starlight it can store is slight, and its magic power runs out quickly. Even so, starlight helps with growth, not only smoothing their fur but eventually making their tails glow.
1663958:
Fidro are common elemental creatures whose appearance resembles a brazier.
Gentle Fidro are prized among travelers as natural lighting... Just be careful not to get too close to the curious ones and accidentally burn yourself.
1663959: Rayjerk are powerful, possessing sharp fins and strong hind legs. They swim extremely fast and look majestic. They love the feeling of speeding through the water, and sometimes, get so carried away that they crash into ships on the water, piercing holes in them with their iron-like heads. They aren't deliberately ramming boats out of playful mischief like they did when they were young, but it still causes massive damage to those traveling on the water.
1663960:
Cook are shy and easily startled, but also possess a strong curiosity. They often hide in the shadows to secretly observe, but scurry away quickly if spotted.
Though they have large eyes, their eyesight is not very good, and they gather information by sensing odors with their split tongues.
1663961: Will-o'-wisps constantly drift around Fungenbo. They have a whimsical and free-spirited personality, loudly criticizing anyone who opposes them. Their voice sounds like a bustling mixture of various sounds. As long as you can hear the noise, you can tell they're around even from afar.

1664169: Only by eliminating mental hesitation can one control the momentum of 'Oboro-Kage'.
1664170:
Someone is wandering around the roadside looking frustrated and muttering to themselves. "This isn't it... Not this either... Can someone help me!"
――It's the forgetful Chris. Because she always forgets her keys whenever she goes out, she used to hide a spare key under the rock in front of her house, but this time she's forgotten which rock she hid it under.
Surely, the future Immortal Fox wouldn't just pretend not to notice in a situation like this.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Courage] checks. Please prepare before challenging）</color>
1664171:
The Colorful Parade Troupe has introduced an entertainment attraction called the 'Haunted House'. Apparently... it can significantly train participants' <color=#bd5576>'Courage'</color>.
Standing at the entrance of the haunted house, the future Immortal Fox faced a dilemma. What kind of preparations should be made before going inside?
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Courage] test）</color>
1664172:
Shiroro's path was blocked.
The opponents were two mercenaries as sturdy as castle gates.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight], [Courage], and [Bonding] checks. Handling this appropriately may increase your bond value with 'Shiroro'）</color>
1664173:
Crispy cake――crispy cake――
Lured by the calls, Xiaoyu went over to investigate, only to find it wasn't the cake stall owner hawking their wares after all...
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Bonding] checks. Handling this well may increase your bond with others）</color>
1664174:
Similar complaints are constantly being sent to the Adventurer's Guild. Apparently, Automit likes to gather up grass emitting an intensely foul odor and drape it all over its body. Whichever farmland it sets foot on, the owners invariably make the same request――drive it away as soon as possible.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] check. Handling this successfully may increase your bond value with 'Automit'）</color>
1664175:
A heartbreaking cry echoes from the forest. Looking toward the sound, Xiaoyu sees a woman dressed in Jinghua Cape attire covering her face and weeping bitterly. Words slip from her lips like, "What should I do... It's so painful... I can't go back anymore..."
It seems the woman is troubled by matters of the heart. Xiaoyu is confident in solving such problems. Let's hurry over and say hello!
<color=#bd5576>（Includes a [Bonding] check. Handling this well may increase your bond with others）</color>
1664176:
Staring intently at the surface of Meltlake, Xiaoyu had a bold idea――could that Frogure who appeared holding three fans perhaps be the lake god often featured in stories?
If it truly is the lake god, throwing something in is bound to get you even more things in return... We have to try it!
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase [Dharma] and [Bonding] attribute values, and raise bond values with 'Starborn'）</color>
1664177:
A request was posted by Carnon Sanatorium. They asked for an event to be planned to help soothe the minds of those suffering from illness.
<color=#bd5576>（Includes [Insight] and [Matchmaking] checks. Increases [Insight] and [Bonding] attribute values）</color>
1664178:
Through interacting with people of different personalities, learning how to converse according to your partner――this is also one of the ways to train the ability of 'Matchmaking'.
<color=#bd5576>（Can increase bond value with 'Maple'）</color>

1664197: Xiaoyu heard a story told by the elder Pammy about a Jinghua Cape student who neglected studies and got the lowest score on an exam... It was the scariest story Xiaoyu had ever heard!
1664198: Xiaoyu ran all over the streets and suburbs of Fleece all night long, resolving the troubles of the remaining few residents and Kibo who had fallen out. By the time dawn broke, she was finally able to relax her shoulders. At least... she gave it her all!
1664199: That wasn't all. During the dance, she showcased numerous astounding arts. Even that knowledgeable Starborn was left mesmerized and dumbfounded.
1664200: ――It's the forgetful Chris. Because she always forgets her keys whenever she goes out, she used to hide a spare key under the rock in front of her house, but this time she's forgotten which rock she hid it under.
1664201: Standing at the entrance of the haunted house, the future Immortal Fox faced a dilemma. What kind of preparations should be made before going inside?
1664202: It's way too scary... Hero, I'm too scared to rest alone tonight...
1664203: N-No... There's no way I can stand against chains with mere fists... Hero, I can't do it...!
1664204: What's more, right above the crispy cake found there, countless 'bonds' were connected. Presumably, Cecilia wasn't the only passerby tricked by this little one into giving food and drinks or petting it...
1664205: The crispy cake yawned and showed Cecilia an exceptionally cute smile.
1664206: The culprit behind these pranks is Waokey!
1664207: After only a brief observation, Xiaoyu was overwhelmed by the intense stench of the 'suspicious object with a strange smell' and fainted in the Starborn's arms...
1664208: The address given by your pen pal is... not here?
1664209: The charges listed by the girl seem a bit off. There's definitely more to this...
1664210: Henrietta ordered Xiaoyu to cheer up her childhood friend. If he falls sick from hunger...
1664211: Xiaoyu asked Henrietta what the other party was dissatisfied with, and advised her to admit her faults and make amends.
1664212: Henrietta stood frozen in place, frowning in deep thought. In the end, no one knew whether she accepted Xiaoyu's advice or not...
1664213: The girl reconciles with her friend shortly after. But further down the road of the future, they are bound to experience even more tumultuous and fateful encounters and partings...
1664214: I-I was just spacing out and thinking about something!
1664215: Xiaoyu tried to probe the bonds, but because Katarina's mind was filled with various speculations, the truth could not be uncovered...
1664216: Did something happen to Starmi's body?
1664217: Prompted by Xiaoyu's remark, Claire finally remembered. A blue-haired girl used to live next door during her childhood. That girl was clumsy and caused trouble at every turn, and Claire would kindly clean up her messes.
1664218: Xiaoyu secretly observed the blue-haired girl's daily behavior, but couldn't find a single thing resembling Starmi's traits. On the contrary, her behavior...
1664219: Following the bond, Xiaoyu naturally found the owner nearby. Having returned the Uni, a delighted Xiaoyu seemed to have a great appetite for dinner!
1664220: Hiding inside was――Trango! Xiaoyu is confused, and the woman is extremely excited!
1664221: Hiding inside was Trango! Xiaoyu is confused. It seems she got it wrong...
1664222: Recently, Xiaoyu has been working hard on her training at Melt Lake. Amidst this, today she was unusually taking a break and having a picnic by the lakeside with the Starborn. The lake breeze was cool, the fragrance of grass and flowers drifted in the air, and the atmosphere was simply wonderful.
1664223: Xiaoyu returned to her original small fox form, curling up small in the Starborn's arms. Come on, let's protect Xiaoyu well and dash back home in one breath!
1664224: After conducting repeated investigations and analyses by the shores of Melt Lake with Xiaoyu, Komugi finally uncovered the truth: recently, people visiting Melt Lake for picnics and camping had been endless, and some even carelessly threw garbage into the lake when leaving.
1664225: Hearing that Xiaoyu was a celestial fox skilled in matchmaking, the author Amy specially came to ask for guidance. Amy is currently drafting a story about a man and woman who fall in love at first sight after a chance encounter. To express the bond of "fate" between the two, what kind of staging should be used...?
1664226: Xiaoyu mentioned that she had once seen a pair of people whose meeting was described as "cooperating with each other during the process of studying Kibo habits, cultivating trust, and gaining both love and research results." Hearing Xiaoyu's story, Amy gained inspiration and thanked her repeatedly.
1664227: Xiaoyu recalled a pair of fated individuals she had once helped. "The reason contact was temporarily cut off was actually because the girl was secretly preparing a surprise confession." Hearing Xiaoyu's story, Amy gained inspiration and thanked her repeatedly.
1664228: Amy nodded repeatedly. The Starborn must surely be a master of romance with hidden prowess! If she ever has anything she doesn't understand about writing in the future, she'll definitely come back to ask Xiaoyu and the Starborn for guidance!
1664229: Following everyone's requests, Xiaoyu divided the patients into groups and arranged different events for each. The very next day, a total of 72 flags and banners praising Xiaoyu were delivered to the Adventurer's Guild.
1664230: Xiaoyu had the client pull out the letters her ancestor had written home to her hometown before passing away, and examined them in detail. Finally, she found the passage where her ancestor described a beautiful scenery somewhere in Melt Lake. If possible, after death, she wished to be buried in this land—that way, she would have no regrets left at all.
1664231: The Adventurer's Guild is an important place for issuing quests, not a place for dining. The street vendor nodded repeatedly in admission of fault and vowed never to do such a thing again.
1664232: Upon seeing the stuffed toy, the burly mercenary was deeply moved. It was the stuffed toy he had cherished more than anything else when he was a child. After all, he had chosen the profession of a mercenary precisely to protect this cute, fragile stuffed toy. He expressed his heartfelt gratitude to Xiaoyu for retrieving the stuffed toy! Even something that looks like worthless junk can become an irreplaceable treasure to someone.
1664233: Xiaoyu's agile footwork left a strong impression on the Starborn, but it seemed it didn't lead to a development like in stories where sharing something brings each other's hearts closer...
1664234: A truly brave hunter hones themselves in actual combat!
1664235: Encouraged by such words, Xiaoyu signed up to participate in the Kibo Fight. The moment she stood at the entrance of the Fight Center, Xiaoyu realized a crucial fact for the first time...
1664236: Terara, an elite hunter, has brought back many mysterious mushrooms from outside! Shall we try one...?
1664237: The color of the mushroom soup looked quite suspicious, but the taste was surprisingly exquisite. Nothing happened even after drinking it all... and so... they lived happily ever after!
1664238: Xiaoyu thought back to the Fleece residents she had recently gotten to know. But she couldn't think of any experts in that field... As expected, she'd better stop eating this mushroom...
1664239: She wasn't very familiar with mushrooms, but based on Xiaoyu's observation, there were several mushrooms that were being eaten by animals and bugs. Surely, those must be edible!
1664240: Terara says that a brave hunter should wield weapons that are easy to handle. But Xiaoyu already has her own dedicated fan... yet Terara insists that lacks presence!
1664241: In the bustling street, a boy with a flushed face blocked Terara's path, muttering things like, "You can't even speak Common..." and "You're of low status..." Terara could only look bewildered upon hearing this. Could he be here to pick a fight?
1664242: There's no use thinking too much about this and that. As a man, the best thing to do is charge right in and shout at the top of your lungs!
1664243: Komugi told the boy that, in fact, the moment he asked Terara for help, he had already found the answer himself. The boy probably realized that what was lacking was simply the courage to take that first step.
1664244: Symphoria had recently spotted several strange couples in the cafeteria. She vaguely sensed the complex and incomprehensible emotional entanglements between them, but didn't know how to advise them. Just then, Komugi introduced Xiaoyu to her to solve this difficult problem!
1664245: ...In other words, this person named "A-Zhen" is pining for "A-Qiang" from Gondoro, while A-Qiang has feelings for his fellow townsman "Feng Qingqing." Feng Qingqing fell in love at first sight with a wandering doctor named "Xu Xian" who came from the Chen Dynasty, and that "Xu Xian" is actually courting "A-Zhen"!
1664246: I want to issue a request. I'd like Xiaoyu to investigate the truth of this matter.
1664247: If you eat something sweet in the morning, you'll be in a good mood all day long.
1664248: Master Xiaoyu, what do you think would be good for the young lady's breakfast?
1664249: Cathbelle seemed extremely satisfied with Xiaoyu's answer and shared her pancakes with her. A fluffy, sweet aroma drifted in the air, making it a very delicious dish!
1664250: Nanacha seemed extremely satisfied with Xiaoyu's answer and shared a sandwich with Xiaoyu. It had a savory and umami flavor, making it a very delicious dish!
1664251: Recently, a rumor has been flying around the streets of Fleece. The contents of stories published just the other day by two romance novelists from Fleece and Jinghua Cape are strikingly similar. What on earth is going on here? Did one of them plagiarize the other?
1664252: Hanging at the entrance of Louisa's house is some homemade salted fish. One day when she returned home, she found a fruit-flavored salted fish recipe left behind by a kind-hearted person. When Louisa tried the recipe, it turned out far more delicious than her own recipe!
1664253: Louisa vowed to return the favor. She had to find that kind-hearted person no matter what and express her gratitude in person!
1664254: Tracing the ties surrounding the salted fish, Xiaoyu found Hommy hiding up in a tree. That Hommy was hugging half of the salted fish, and while eating it, cast a reluctant look...
1664255: Xiaoyu saw right through it all. All the nourishing ingredients soaked in the medicinal wine had actually been carved out of "Crimson Radishes"! Surprisingly, that diviner had quite a remarkable talent for carving.
1664256: A crowd had gathered at the market. When Xiaoyu pushed through the crowd to take a peek inside—there was a mercenary frantically stuffing spicy roasted meat into his mouth in front of a food stall. Even though tears wouldn't stop streaming from his eyes due to the spiciness, his hand feeding him meat didn't stop for even a single second.
1664257: That must be a scam! The mercenary realized the situation and tried to catch the swindler diviner—but while he was busy stuffing his cheeks with roasted meat, that diviner had long since vanished...
1664258: Xiaoyu observed earnestly for a while, but in the end she couldn't tell whether the mercenary's expression was one of joy or sorrow. Human emotions truly are diverse...
1664259: The mercenary held roasted meat in his right hand, and in his left hand... a bundle resembling a suspicious amulet. Xiaoyu didn't hesitate to approach the mercenary and ask him about it!
1664260: The mercenary is holding roasted meat in his right hand. And right next to that stall, they sell Peach Blossom Pastries! Hey, swordsman, could you go buy two for me?
1664261: Xiaoyu dashed behind the waterfall at Melt Lake and found a natural hollow there. The waterfall happened to conceal the entrance, making it completely invisible from the outside.
1664262: No... you must have already known I was hiding here, Symphoria!
1664263: Symphoria searched thoroughly behind the waterfall, in the bushes, up in the trees, and even behind the rocks, but her harvest was zero. She wore a pleased expression and declared that Xiaoyu was already fully grown up.
1664264: Thanks to having you here, swordsman, we found the best hiding spot!
1664265: Terara took a deep breath and let out a beast-like howl toward the waterfall: "Awooo—". Her voice echoed long and far, momentarily drowning out even the sound of the waterfall.
1664266: Xiaoyu closed her eyes and sharpened her senses. A faint bond stretched far into the distance, finally vanishing into the skies of Fleece. Xiaoyu didn't know the reason why, but perhaps that Kibo hadn't left Fleece just yet...

1664483:
We live in a world of "substances". However, mystery is by no means distant. For instance, last night or the night before, prayers to Tana were likely offered somewhere in this land. Ancestral prayers are still passed down as everyday sorcery... but these never reach the true realm. Elements are the root of all things and the driving force of the world. As flowing energy, elements are in constant change. In the world of tangible things, elements flow, circulate, and interact to break the silence of life and form the order governing the world.

Through communion with nature, souls, and spirits, we have perceived the elements of water, fire, ice, earth, lightning, wind, and grass. Vegetation speaks not, resisting the raging winds with branches and roots. Yet, it cannot withstand severe ice and snow or raging wildfires. The earth supports all things, swallowing oncoming lightning and wildfires effortlessly in distant mountains and hills, but it struggles against violent gales and floods. Gales whip soil into dust, and floods soak soil into mud. Fierce fire melts ice, and the melting water extinguishes the fire... Such phenomena prove that nature possesses the wisdom to maintain equilibrium amidst the contact, fusion, separation, and destruction of elements, generously displaying its mysteries.

As for light and darkness, they are considered an organic force distinct from these seven elements. They are constantly poured down from the heavens as opposing, complementary forces.

In the natural world, there are also entities that originate from none of the known elements and possess weaknesses to none of them. Thus, we have classified them as the "Null" element. Perhaps one day, we will unravel the source of that power and lift the veil of mystery.
1664484: Those Who Ignited a Flame Unquenched in the Dark NightFarman Chacha, the primal beast of plunder, brought the unending "Disaster of the Dark Night". Farman Chacha climbed high mountain peaks to devour Uru, shrouding the land in darkness. Within the darkness, the beast of plunder grew stronger. Unless Farman Chacha was defeated and forced to disgorge Uru, light would never return to the land. However, lost in the dark, the beastkin lost their bearings, suffering heavy injuries from the beast of plunder's assaults before they could locate Farman Chacha. Tauric gathered to save them, igniting an unquenched flame that illuminated the dark night like day, using that fire to guide their path forward. Yet, the beast of plunder used the fire as a beacon to attack Tauric and his kin. One after another, the Tauric fell into the darkness, torn to pieces by the beast of plunder. The flame overhead flickered, and once a reliable pack of Tauric, they dwindled down to a tiny ember. Even so, they did not retreat. The last Tauric led the others to the mountain peak, defeating Farman Chacha with his own flame before fading away as a small spark. Only a very young Momo remained in the Tauric pack. Before fleeing, the defeated Farman Chacha spat out Uru. However, Uru's power had already been completely sapped, turning into a blackened, hollow shell devoid of any power. The last remaining Momo burrowed inside Uru, relighting Uru's fire with its own faint flame. The dead Tauric also ascended as aura toward Uru. Thus, the land regained its light once more. Those Who Made Their Own Bodies a Dike Amidst the Waters of the DeadThe wicked beast of plunder, Farman Chacha, had not given up on destroying the land even in defeat. Farman Chacha brought the "Disaster of Floods" to the land once again. A massive flood surged violently, swallowing the land. At first, the water-loving Biliver rejoiced greatly, but that was only until they noticed the saltiness mixed in the water—those were the tears of beastkin who had lost families in the flood. Disliking this taste and mindful of the beastkin's suffering, Biliver began building dikes alongside them. However, the flood was far fiercer than they imagined, and no matter how diligently the Biliver gnawed wood to build dikes, even greater waves crashed down. Amidst this, a Biliver dived underwater and discovered the cause of the flood—a large hole in the subterranean floor torn open by Farman Chacha. Because the boundary between the living world above and the underworld below was torn apart, all the water of "Puche" was pouring in. The waters of the dead world would swallow all the living and eventually turn the surface into a wasteland of nihilism. Mere wood and stone could not fill that hole. Mastiff led Biliver and Waver to dive underwater, plugging the hole with their own bodies. It was their ultimate architectural masterpiece and a testament to their solidarity. Once the hole was plugged and the waters of the underworld stopped flowing to the surface, Uru evaporated the excess water, restoring the boundary between land and river. The dikes built by the Biliver still stood proudly on the land, but the Biliver themselves were nowhere to be seen. Those Who Made Flowers Bloom on the Path of PermafrostOnce, the land enjoyed a natural cycle of Jinshuo and Fengshuo. Plants would sleep in the earth during Fengshuo, sprout and blossom in Jinshuo, and then bear fruit to fill the land in the next Jinshuo. However, Farman Chacha brought the "Disaster of Frost", using its breath to lay thick, unmelting ice across the land. Fearing the cold, surface plants buried deep underground and refused to sprout again. Thus, Jinshuo ceased to come. Sozanka asked the Spirit: "How can we shatter that ice and reclaim warm days?" The Spirit replied: "Only the power of sprouting can break the ice." Sozanka spoke to the plants, but only silence answered. At that moment, the mischievous Kloneck let out a cry. Kloneck told Sozanka that the plants were not refusing to sprout; they had simply lost their strength from being locked in ice for so long. Kloneck shared its own power with the deeply buried seeds, speaking softly to comfort them. At last, the seeds gained strength, trembling as they broke through the soil, pushing upward and shattering the ice. Then Kloneck led Leafro and Frater along the long path of permafrost. They spoke gently to every plant they encountered, sharing their own power and helping them regain the strength and courage to break through the soil and live once more. The ice gradually shattered, but Kloneck and companions grew steadily weaker. Even so, Kloneck kept encouraging them until the very last seed sprouted. When Jinshuo returned once again, the land regained the breath of a gentle breeze. Kloneck and its pack lay upon the soft meadow, falling into eternal sleep with happy smiles upon their lips.
1664485:
Procedures for Dragon King Worship

The day before worship, participants bathe before sunset and change into clean clothes.
The priest checks the quantity and types of offerings. Offerings include grains, meat, Astral Glowing Ore, and more.
On the day of the event, participants gather before dawn. Everyone wears plain robes, goes barefoot, and carries no weapons or unnecessary items. Designated individuals transport the offerings.
Order in the procession is determined by age and status, placing the elderly and children in front, and youths and adults in the rear.
Conversation, looking back, and leaving the procession are strictly prohibited along the way. When passing roadside stone carvings or ancient steles, everyone must stop, bow, and pay respects.
Upon arriving at the outer courtyard of the temple, participants first line up outside the gates. After the priest rechecks the offerings, they lead everyone inside.
After entering, everyone prostrates three times toward the throne. The priest chants a prayer, and participants in turn present offerings such as grains, meat, and Astral Glowing Ore.
Once the offerings are arranged, everyone waits quietly until the Dragon King announces the end of the ceremony. Standing up or staring directly at the throne is strictly prohibited.
